diseases.name: Zoster sine herpete
diseases.definition: Herpes zoster but without eruption of vesicles. Patients exhibit the characteristic pain minus the skin rash, sometimes making diagnosis difficult.

diseases.name: Zebra body myopathy
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder

diseases.name: Young-onset parkinson disease
diseases.definition: A form of Parkinson disease (PD) characterized by an age of onset between 21-45 years, rigidity, painful cramps followed by tremor, bradykinesia, dystonia, gait complaints and falls, and other non-motor symptoms. A slow disease progression and a more pronounced response to dopaminergic therapy are also observed in most YOPD forms.

diseases.name: Yolk sac tumor
diseases.definition: A non-seminomatous malignant germ cell tumor composed of primitive germ cells. It is the most common malignant germ cell tumor in the pediatric population. It occurs in the infant testis, ovary, sacrococcygeal region, vagina, uterus, prostate, abdomen, liver, retroperitoneum, thorax, and pineal/third ventricle. The tumor mimics the yolk sac of the embryo and produces alpha-fetoprotein (AFP). Tr...

diseases.name: Yellow nail syndrome
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|cardiovascular disorder|immune system disorder
diseases.definition: A very rare syndromic disorder characterized by the variable triad of characteristic yellow nails, chronic respiratory manifestations, and primary lymphedema.

diseases.name: Yellow fever
synonyms: Yellow fever virus disease or disorder
Yellow fever virus caused disease or disorder
diseases.definition: Yellow fever (YF), caused by YF virus, is a zoonotic disease characterized by fever and constitutional symptoms, with the potential to progress to severe and fatal viral hemorrhagic fever with shock and multi-organ system failure.

diseases.name: Xerosis and growth failure with immune and pulmonary dysfunction syndrome
Xerophthalmia
diseases.group: syndromic disease|inflammatory disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Dryness of the eye due to inadequate production of tears. Causes include vitamin A deficiency, Sjogren syndrome, rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and scleroderma.

diseases.name: Xeroderma pigmentosum-cockayne syndrome complex
diseases.definition: Xeroderma pigmentosum/Cockayne syndrome complex (XP/CS complex) is characterized by the cutaneous features of xeroderma pigmentosum (XP) together with the systemic and neurological features of Cockayne syndrome (CS).

diseases.name: Xeroderma pigmentosum variant type
synonyms: xeroderma pigmentosum with normal DNA repair rates
diseases.definition: Xeroderma pigmentosum variant is a milder subtype of xeroderma pigmentosum (XP), a rare genetic photodermatosis characterized by severe sun sensitivity and an increased risk of skin cancer.

diseases.name: Xeroderma pigmentosum group g
synonyms: xeroderma pigmentosum, complementation group type G
xeroderma pigmentosum caused by mutation in ERCC5
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Any xeroderma pigmentosum in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ERCC5 gene.

diseases.name: Xeroderma pigmentosum group f
synonyms: xeroderma pigmentosum, complementation group type F
xeroderma pigmentosum caused by mutation in ERCC4
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|metabolic disease
diseases.definition: Any xeroderma pigmentosum in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ERCC4 gene.

diseases.name: Xeroderma pigmentosum group e
synonyms: xeroderma pigmentosum, group E, DDB-negative subtype
xeroderma pigmentosum, complementation group type E
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive genetic disorder caused by mutations in the DDB2 gene. This disease exhibits the mildest degree of sun sensitivity of all xeroderma pigmentosum complementation groups, although individuals are at high risk for skin cancer.

diseases.name: Xeroderma pigmentosum group d
synonyms: xeroderma pigmentosum, complementation group type D
xeroderma pigmentosum caused by mutation in ERCC2
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|metabolic disease
diseases.definition: Any xeroderma pigmentosum in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ERCC2 gene.

diseases.name: Xeroderma pigmentosum group c
synonyms: xeroderma pigmentosum, complementation group type C
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive inherited disorder caused by mutations in the XPC gene. This disease is characterized by increased sensitivity to sunlight with the development of carcinomas at an early age and is caused by a defect in nucleotide excision repair.

diseases.name: Xeroderma pigmentosum group b
synonyms: xeroderma pigmentosum, complementation group type B
xeroderma pigmentosum caused by mutation in ERCC3
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|metabolic disease
diseases.definition: Any xeroderma pigmentosum in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ERCC3 gene.

diseases.name: Xeroderma pigmentosum group a
synonyms: xeroderma pigmentosum, complementation group type a
xeroderma pigmentosum caused by mutation in XPA
diseases.definition: Any xeroderma pigmentosum in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the XPA gene.

diseases.name: Xeroderma pigmentosum
diseases.definition: Xeroderma pigmentosum (XP) is a rare genodermatosis characterized by extreme sensitivity to ultraviolet (UV)-induced changes in the skin and eyes, and multiple skin cancers. It is subdivided into 8 complementation groups, according to the affected gene: classical XP (XPA to XPG) and XP variant (XPV).

diseases.name: Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|reproductive system disorder|infectious disease|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Chronic, destructive infection of the kidney characterized by lipid-laden macrophages in the setting of obstruction secondary to infected renal stones, most commonly caused by Proteus or Escherichia coli.

diseases.name: Xanthogranulomatous cholecystitis
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Cholecystitis that is characterized by nodules containing lipid.

diseases.name: Xanthinuria type ii
synonyms: xanthine dehydrogenase and xanthine aldehyde oxidase dual deficiency
xanthine dehydrogenase and aldehyde oxidase, combined deficiency of
diseases.definition: Type II xanthinuria, a type of classical xanthinuria, is a rare autosomal recessive disorder of purine metabolism characterized by the deficiency of both xanthine dehydrogenase and aldehyde oxidase, leading to the formation of urinary xanthine urolithiasis and leading, in some patients, to kidney failure. Other less common manifestations include arthropathy, myopathy and duodenal ulcer, while s...

diseases.name: Xanthinuria type i
diseases.definition: A rare autosomal recessive disorder of purine metabolism characterized by the isolated deficiency of xanthine dehydrogenase, causing hyperxanthinemia with low or absent uric acid and xanthinuria, leading to urolithiasis, hematuria, renal colic and urinary tract infections, while some patients are asymptomatic and others suffer from kidney failure. Less common manifestations include arthropathy,...

diseases.name: Wrinkly skin syndrome
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A type of cutis laxa that is characterized by wrinkling of the skin of the dorsum of the hands and feet, an increased number of palmar and plantar creases, wrinkled abdominal skin, multiple skeletal abnormalities (joint laxity and congenital hip dislocation), late closing of the anterior fontanel, microcephaly, pre- and postnatal growth retardation, developmental delay and facial dysmorphism (a...

diseases.name: Wound botulism
diseases.definition: Botulism that is caused by toxin that is produced in a wound contaminated with Clostridium botulinum.

diseases.name: Wormian bone-multiple fractures-dentinogenesis imperfecta-skeletal dysplasia
diseases.definition: Skeletal dysplasia with wormian bone-multiple fractures-dentinogenesis imperfecta is a skeletal disorder, reported in three patients to date, characterized clinically by multiple fractures, wormian bones of the skull, dentinogenesis imperfecta and facial dysmorphism (hypertelorism, periorbital fullness). Although the signs are very similar to osteogenesis imperfecta, characteristic cortical def...

diseases.name: Wooly hair-palmoplantar keratoderma syndrome
synonyms: keratoderma with wooly hair type IV
keratoderma with woolly hair type IV
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Woolly hair-palmoplantar keratoderma syndrome is a very rare, hereditary epidermal disorder characterized by hypotrichosis/wooly scalp hair, sparse body hair, eyelashes and eyebrows, leukonychia, and striate palmoplantar keratoderma (more severe on the soles than the palms), which progressively worsens with age. Pseudo ainhum of the fifth toes was also reported. Although wooly hair-palmoplantar...

diseases.name: Wooly hair-hypotrichosis-everted lower lip-outstanding ears syndrome
synonyms: wooly hair-hypotrichosis-everted lower lip-outstanding ears syndrome

diseases.name: Wooly hair, autosomal recessive 3
synonyms: wooly hair (disease) caused by mutation in KRT25
woolly hair (disease) caused by mutation in KRT25
diseases.definition: Any wooly hair in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the KRT25 gene.

diseases.name: Wooly hair, autosomal recessive 1, with or without hypotrichosis
Wooly hair nevus
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Woolly hair nevus (WHN) is a rare non-familial hair anomaly characterized by kinky, tightly coiled, and hypopigmented fine hair with an average diameter of 0.5 cm, noted, since birth or during the first two years of life, in a localized circumscribed distribution on the scalp. Occasionally, WHN grows in areas observed to be alopecic in the neonatal period. WHN can be associated with features li...

diseases.name: White sponge nevus 2
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: White sponge nevus 1
synonyms: hereditary mucosal leukokeratosis caused by mutation in KRT4
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Any hereditary mucosal leukokeratosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the KRT4 gene.

diseases.name: White platelet syndrome
diseases.definition: White platelet syndrome (WPS) is is a platelet granule disorder characterized by thrombocytopenia, increased mean platelet volumes, decreased platelet responsiveness to aggregating agents, and significant defects in platelet ultrastructural morphology leading to prolonged bleeding times and bleeding.

diseases.name: White piedra
diseases.definition: A superficial mycosis due to T beigelii that is characterized by a soft, friable, beige nodule of the distal ends of hair shafts.

diseases.name: White matter hypoplasia-corpus callosum agenesis-intellectual disability syndrome
diseases.definition: White matter hypoplasia-corpus callosum agenesis-intellectual disability syndrome is a very rare neurological condition. The few patients described in the medical literature were characterized by brain anomalies; an unusual face with broad nasal root, wide spaced eyes (hypertelorism) and a very small chin (micrognathia); failure to thrive; severe intellectual disability ;and lack of muscle tone...

diseases.name: White forelock with malformations
diseases.group: cardiovascular disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: White forelock with malformations is a multiple congenital anomalies syndrome characterized by poliosis, distinct facial features (epicanthal folds, hypertelorism, posterior rotation of ears, prominent philtrum, high-arched palate) and congenital anomalies/malformations of the eye (blue sclera), cardiopulmonary (atrial septal defect, prominent thoracic and abdominal veins), and skeletal (clinod...

diseases.name: White fibrous papulosis of the neck
diseases.definition: White fibrous papulosis of the neck (WFPN) is a rare, acquired, dermal elastic tissue disorder characterized by multiple, 2-3 mm sized, non-confluent, asymptomatic, white or pale-colored, non-follicular, firm papular lesions occurring predominantly on the lateral or posterior aspects of the neck. Other, rarely reported sites include inferior axillae, central mid-back and upper sternal region.

diseases.name: Whistling face syndrome, recessive form
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Wet macular degeneration
synonyms: exudative senile macular degeneration of retina
diseases.group: hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: A form of RETINAL degeneration in which abnormal CHOROIDAL NEOVASCULARIZATION occurs under the RETINA and MACULA LUTEA, causing bleeding and leaking of fluid. This leads to bulging and or lifting of the macula and the distortion or destruction of central vision.

diseases.name: Western equine encephalitis
synonyms: Western equine encephalitis virus infectious encephalitis
Western equine encephalitis virus caused infectious encephalitis
diseases.definition: An acute arboviral infection caused by an alphavirus of the Togaviridae family transmitted by an infected mosquito, that more frequently affects children and that is characterized by the presence of mild flulike symptoms (fever, chills, headache, nausea, vomiting, and anorexia) but that can progress to weakness, altered mental status, photophobia, mental confusion, seizures, somnolence, coma an...

diseases.name: Well-differentiated thymic neuroendocrine carcinoma
diseases.group: immune system disorder|endocrine system disorder|hematologic disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Well-differentiated papillary mesothelial tumour of the pleura
Well-differentiated liposarcoma
synonyms: well differentiated liposarcoma of deep soft tissue
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A locally aggressive malignant neoplasm composed of mature adipocytes showing cell size variation and nuclear atypia. It is often associated with the presence of hyperchromatic multinucleated stromal cells, and varying numbers of lipoblasts. There are three histologic subtypes, sclerosing, inflammatory, and spindle cell liposarcoma. These tumors do not usually metastasize unless they undergo de...

diseases.name: Well-differentiated fetal adenocarcinoma of the lung
synonyms: pulmonary endodermal tumour resembling foetal lung
pulmonary endodermal tumor resembling fetal lung
diseases.group: respiratory system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Well-differentiated fetal adenocarcinoma (WDFA) of the lung is a rare, primary, low-grade, bronchopulmonary neoplasm characterized by a well-circumscribed, usually large, pulmonary mass that is histologically composed of glycogen-rich neoplastic glands and tubules that resemble fetal lungs at 10 to 16 weeks of gestation and benign adjacent stroma. It typically presents with chest pain, cough, d...

diseases.name: Weinstein kliman scully syndrome
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|metabolic disease|endocrine system disorder

diseases.name: Water-clear cell adenoma
diseases.definition: A rare parathyroid gland adenoma composed of neoplastic cells with abundant cytoplasm. The cytoplasm of the neoplastic cells is usually not entirely clear, and is often variably vacuolated, foamy, and granular.

diseases.name: Water intoxication
diseases.definition: A condition resulting from the excessive retention of water with sodium depletion.

diseases.name: Warty dyskeratoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare, usually solitary, benign epithelial tumor of the skin that appears to arise from a hair follicle. It usually develops in the head and neck region as a nodular lesion with a central keratotic plug.

diseases.name: Warty carcinoma of the penis
synonyms: warty squamous cell carcinoma of the penis
warty squamous cell carcinoma of penis
squamous cell carcinoma of the penis, warty type
squamous cell carcinoma of the penis, condylomatous type
squamous cell carcinoma of penis, warty type
squamous cell carcinoma of penis, condylomatous type
condylomatous squamous cell carcinoma of the penis
condylomatous squamous cell carcinoma of penis
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the penis. It is characterized by a papillary growth pattern, hyperkeratosis and parakeratosis. Koilocytotic atypia is present. Human papillomavirus types 16 and 6 have been identified in some cases.

diseases.name: Warts-immunodeficiency-lymphedema-anogenital dysplasia syndrome
synonyms: disseminated warts-impaired cell-mediated immunity-primary lymphedema-anogenital dysplasia syndrome
diseases.definition: A rare primary lymphedema characterized by extensive, multisegmental lymphedema, associated with persistent, widespread infections with various genital high- and low-risk human papillomaviruses, resulting in multifocal anogenital dysplasia. Laboratory examination shows abnormalities in lymphocyte subsets, in particular CD4+ T-cells. Epidermal nevi and capillary malformations have also been repo...

diseases.name: Wandering spleen
diseases.definition: A condition characterized by an abnormal spleen position due to loss, weakness, or malformation of one or more of the ligaments that hold the spleen in its normal position in the left upper abdomen. It may present as a birth defect or follow injuries or pregnancy. Signs and symptoms include abdominal discomfort and splenomegaly.

diseases.name: Vulvovaginitis, allergic seminal
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|immune system disorder|inflammatory disease

diseases.name: Vulvovaginal candidiasis
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|reproductive system disorder|infectious disease|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Infection of the vulva and vagina with a fungus of the genus CANDIDA. It is a disease associated with HIV infection.

diseases.name: Vulvodynia
diseases.definition: Vulvodynia is a chronic pain syndrome that affects the vulvar area and occurs without an identifiable cause. Symptoms typically include a feeling of burning or irritation. For the diagnosis to be made symptoms must last at least 3 months.

diseases.name: Vulvar trichoepithelioma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the presence of nests of monomorphic basaloid cells forming small cysts that contain keratin.

diseases.name: Vulvar syringoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm that arises from eccrine ducts in the vulva and is characterized by the presence of tubules and cysts which are lined by epithelial cells in the densely fibrotic dermis.

diseases.name: Vulvar squamous cell carcinoma
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the vulva
epidermoid cell carcinoma of the vulva
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An invasive squamous cell carcinoma arising from the vulva. Risk factors include the human papilloma virus and cigarette smoking. Precursor lesions include the vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia, lichen sclerosus with associated squamous cell hyperplasia, and chronic granulomatous vulvar disease such as granuloma inguinale. Symptoms include vulvar pruritus or irritation, discharge, bleeding, and ...

diseases.name: Vulvar sebaceous carcinoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that arises from the vulva. It is characterized by the presence of malignant basaloid glandular epithelial cells that resemble sebaceous epithelium and are arranged in cords and nests.

diseases.name: Vulvar proximal-type epithelioid sarcoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An epithelioid sarcoma of the proximal type involving the vulva.

diseases.name: Vulvar non-keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the absence of keratin pearls.

diseases.name: Vulvar nodular hidradenoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm that arises from sweat glands in the vulva and is characterized by the presence of lobules composed of epithelial cells with clear cytoplasm.

diseases.name: Vulvar melanoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A usually pigmented, nodular or polypoid malignant neoplasm that originates from melanocytes and arises from the vulva. It presents with bleeding and dysuria.

diseases.name: Vulvar liposarcoma
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the vulva.

diseases.name: Vulvar lichen sclerosus
synonyms: mammalian vulva lichen sclerosus et atrophicus
lichen sclerosus et atrophicus of mammalian vulva
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: A chronic inflammatory disorder of unknown etiology that affects the vulva. It is characterized by the development of white elevated plaques in the vulva. Histologically there is marked subepithelial fibrosis. Clinical manifestations include pruritus, dysuria, and dyspareunia.

diseases.name: Vulvar leiomyosarcoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the vulva. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

diseases.name: Vulvar leiomyoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the vulva. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

diseases.name: Vulvar keratoacanthoma-like carcinoma
synonyms: vulvar squamous cell carcinoma, keratoacanthoma type
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rapidly growing squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva. It is self-limited and is characterized by the presence of a central crater that contains squamous cells. The proliferating squamous cells infiltrate the dermis below and produce keratin masses that are pushed towards the surface of the tumor.

diseases.name: Vulvar keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the presence of keratin pearls.

diseases.name: Vulvar inverted follicular keratosis
synonyms: inverted follicular keratosis of mammalian vulva
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Seborrheic keratosis that arises from follicular structures in the vulva. It is characterized by the presence of prominent squamous eddies.

diseases.name: Vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Intraepithelial neoplasia of the vulvar squamous epithelium. There is no evidence of invasion. This category includes vulvar high grade squamous intraepithelial lesion and vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia, differentiated type.

diseases.name: Vulvar granular cell tumor
synonyms: granular cell tumour of mammalian vulva
granular cell tumor of mammalian vulva
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A usually benign granular cell tumor that arises from the vulva.

diseases.name: Vulvar eccrine porocarcinoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An eccrine porocarcinoma that arises from the sweat glands in the vulva.

diseases.name: Vulvar clear cell hidradenocarcinoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A vulvar sweat gland carcinoma characterized by the presence of clear cells.

diseases.name: Vulvar childhood botryoid-type embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
synonyms: childhood sarcoma Botryoides of the vulva
childhood botryoid-type embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of the vulva
childhood botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma of mammalian vulva
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in female children. The neoplasm arises from the vulva. It is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules with an abundant myxoid stroma.

diseases.name: Vulvar carcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the mammalian vulva

diseases.name: Vulvar benign neoplasm
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the vulva. Representative examples include cellular angiofibroma, melanocytic nevus, nodular hidradenoma, and Bartholin gland adenoma.

diseases.name: Vulvar basaloid squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the presence of nests of malignant basaloid cells with a scant amount of cytoplasm.

diseases.name: Vulvar apocrine adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An apocrine adenocarcinoma that arises from the sweat glands in the vulva.

diseases.name: Vulvar angiokeratoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|cardiovascular disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An uncommon benign lesion in the vulva. It manifests with multiple papular lesions which are purple in color. They are usually asymptomatic. Histologically, there is hyperkeratosis, papillomatosis, and dilated blood vessels in the papillary dermis.

diseases.name: Vulvar alveolar soft part sarcoma
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An alveolar soft part sarcoma arising from the vulva.

diseases.name: Vulvar adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the vulva. Representative examples include Bartholin gland adenocarcinoma, eccrine adenocarcinoma, apocrine adenocarcinoma, and sebaceous carcinoma.

diseases.name: Vulval varices
diseases.definition: A varicose disease that involves the mammalian vulva.

diseases.name: Vulval paget disease
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An uncommon intraepithelial malignant neoplasm of eccrine or apocrine origin, arising from the vulva. It usually affects post-menopausal women. In approximately 10-20% of the cases there is an associated anorectal, or urothelial carcinoma or a skin appendage adenocarcinoma identified. It presents as a red, eczematous lesion. Microscopically, it is characterized by the presence of the typical Pa...

diseases.name: Vulva verrucous carcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A highly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva. It is characterized by the presence of a warty and hyperkeratinized surface, malignant cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, minimal cytologic atypia, and absence or rarity of mitotic figures. The tumor infiltrates the underlying stroma with a pushing border.

diseases.name: Vulva fibroepithelial polyp
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A polypoid lesion that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the presence of fibrovascular stroma lined by squamous epithelium. There is no evidence of epithelial atypia.

diseases.name: Vulva basal cell carcinoma
synonyms: skin basal cell carcinoma of mammalian vulva
mammalian vulva skin basal cell carcinoma
basal cell carcinoma of the vulva
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A slow growing, locally infiltrating carcinoma that arises from the vulva. It is characterized by the presence of malignant cells that resemble the basal cells that are present in the epidermis.

diseases.name: Voyeurism
diseases.definition: A disorder characterized by recurrent sexual urges, fantasies, or behaviors involving observing an unsuspecting person who is naked, disrobing, or engaging in sexual activity.

diseases.name: Von willebrand disease type 2n
diseases.definition: Type 2N von Willebrand disease (type 2N VWD) is a subtype of type 2 VWD characterized by a bleeding disorder associated with a marked decrease in the affinity of the Willebrand factor (von Willebrand factor; VWF) for factor VIII (FVIII).

diseases.name: Von willebrand disease type 2m
diseases.definition: A subtype of type 2 VWD characterized by a bleeding disorder associated with a decrease in the affinity of the Willebrand factor (von Willebrand factor; VWF) for platelets and the subendothelium in the absence of any deficiency of high molecular weight VWF multimers.

diseases.name: Von willebrand disease type 2b
diseases.definition: A subtype of type 2 VWD characterized by a bleeding disorder associated with an increase in the affinity of the Willebrand factor (von Willebrand factor; VWF) for platelets. This anomaly results in spontaneous binding of high molecular weight VWF multimers to platelets leading to rapid clearance of both the platelets (increasing the risk of thrombocytopenia) and the high molecular weight VWF mu...

diseases.name: Von willebrand disease type 2a
diseases.definition: Type 2A von Willebrand disease (type 2A VWD) is a subtype of type 2 VWD characterized by a bleeding disorder associated with a decrease in the affinity of the Willebrand factor (von Willebrand factor; VWF) for platelets and the subendothelium caused by a deficiency of high molecular weight VWF multimers.

diseases.name: Von willebrand disease 3
diseases.definition: Type 3 von Willebrand disease (type 3 VWD) is the most severe form of VWD characterized by a bleeding disorder associated with a total or near-total absence of Willebrand factor (von Willebrand factor; VWF) in the plasma and cellular compartments, also leading to a profound deficiency of plasmatic factor VIII (FVIII).

diseases.name: Von willebrand disease 2
diseases.definition: Type 2 von Willebrand disease (type 2 VWD) is a form of VWD characterized by a bleeding disorder associated with a qualitative deficiency and functional anomalies of the Willebrand factor (von Willebrand factor; VWF).

diseases.name: Von willebrand disease 1
diseases.definition: Type 1 von Willebrand disease (type 1 VWD) is a form of VWD characterized by a bleeding disorder associated with a partial quantitative plasmatic deficiency of an otherwise structurally and functionally normal Willebrand factor (von Willebrand factor; VWF).

diseases.name: Von Willebrand disease
diseases.definition: Hereditary or acquired coagulation disorder characterized by a qualitative or quantitative deficiency of the von Willebrand factor. The latter plays an important role in platelet adhesion. Signs and symptoms include bruises, nose bleeding, gum bleeding following a dental procedure, heavy menstrual bleeding, and gastrointestinal bleeding.

diseases.name: Von voss-cherstvoy syndrome
diseases.definition: Von Voss-Cherstvoy syndrome is a very rare disorder with phocomelia of upper limbs, encephalocele, variable brain anomalies, urogenital abnormalities, and thrombocytopenia.

diseases.name: Von hippel-lindau disease
diseases.definition: An autosomal dominant disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the VHL gene, leading to an increased risk of various benign and malignant tumors, including hemangioblastomas, retinal hemangiomas, endolymphatic sac tumors, renal cell carcinoma, and pheochromocytomas.

diseases.name: Von hippel anomaly

diseases.name: Volvulus of midgut

diseases.name: Voice disorders

diseases.definition: Deficiency of vitamin K. It may lead to bleeding, manifested with ecchymoses, petechiae, and hematomas. In infants it may cause hemorrhagic disease of newborn with intracranial and retroperitoneal bleeding.

Vitamin a deficiency

diseases.name: Visual snow syndrome
diseases.definition: Visual snow syndrome is described as a persistent visual problem characterized by seeing snow-like dots. Migraines are a common symptom. Many people also see drifting blobs of varying size and shape (floaters), visual effects (entopic phenomenon), glare, halos, starbursts, trails, odd colors and shapes, and may have persistent recurrence of a visual image (palinopsia) and double vision. Additio...

It has been described in two siblings (brother and sister) born to consanguineous parents. The girl also had microcephaly and multicystic kidneys. The boy had a...

diseases.name: Visceral neuropathy, familial, 1, autosomal recessive
diseases.definition: A form of chronic intestinal pseudoobstruction caused by a developmental failure of the enteric neurons to differentiate or migrate properly and manifests as a bowel obstruction.

diseases.name: Visceral leishmaniasis
diseases.definition: A severe form of leishmaniasis characterized by irregular bouts of fever, substantial weight loss, swelling of the spleen and liver, and anemia (which may be serious). If left untreated it may lead to death. Two species of Leishmania are known to give rise to the visceral form of the disease. The species commonly found in East Africa and the Indian subcontinent is L. donovani and the species fo...

diseases.name: Visceral heterotaxy
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|cardiovascular disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A rare, genetic disorder in which symptoms are generally secondary to the abnormal location of the organs within the thoracic, abdominal, or peritoneal cavities. Anatomic and functional problems can include cardiac defects, intestinal malrotation leading to volvulus, biliary atresia, and various defects of the central nervous system, urinary tract, and skeleton.

diseases.name: Visceral calciphylaxis
diseases.definition: Visceral calciphylaxis is a rare, life-threatening, non-inflammatory vasculopathy disorder characterized by diffuse precipitation of calcium in viscera (mainly in the heart or lungs, but also in the stomach or kidneys) leading to fibrosis and thrombosis, which eventually cause necrotic ulcerations of the tissue. Patients may present with dyspnea, cough and respiratory failure or acute heart blo...

diseases.name: Visceral botryomycosis
diseases.definition: A botryomycosis that involves internal organs such as lungs, liver, or brain. It is a rare disease and has been described mainly in patients with underlying diseases such as diabetes mellitus, cystic fibrosis, or HIV infection. It is most commonly affecting the lungs, although involvement of other organs including liver, spleen, kidney, and brain has also been described.

diseases.name: Virus-associated trichodysplasia spinulosa
diseases.definition: Virus-associated trichodysplasia spinulosa is a rare infectious skin disease characterized by the development of follicular papules with keratin spicules in various parts of the body, predominantly in the face (e.g. nose, eyebrows, auricles), that is due to polyomavirus infection in immunocompromized patients.

diseases.name: Viral dilated cardiomyopathy

diseases.name: Vibratory urticaria
diseases.definition: This very rare form of angioedema develops in reply to contact with vibration. In vibratory angioedema, symptoms develop within two to five minutes after contact with vibration and dissolve after about an hour. Patients with this disorder do not suffer from dermographism or pressure urticaria. Vibratory angioedema is diagnosed by holding a vibrating device such as a laboratory vortex machine ag...

diseases.name: Vibratory angioedema
diseases.definition: Vibratory angioedema is a rare, inherited or sporadic, urticaria characterized by localized, typically long-lasting (hours to days), initially pruritic, painful, normocutaneous or erythematous, mucosal and/or cutaneous edema which is triggered by vibration. Laryngeal snoring-induced swelling may be life-threatening.

diseases.group: auditory system disorder|nervous system disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Idiopathic inflammation of the vestibular nerve, characterized clinically by the acute or subacute onset of vertigo; nausea; and imbalance. The cochlear nerve is typically spared and hearing loss and tinnitus do not usually occur. Symptoms usually resolve over a period of days to weeks. (Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p304)

vasoproliferative tumor of the ocular fundus

diseases.definition: Vasoproliferative tumor of the retina is a rare, benign, retinal vascular disease characterized by solitary or multiple, unilateral or bilateral, intra-retinal tumor(s), usually located in the peripheral infero-temporal quadrant, and often associated with sub- and intraretinal exudates, epiretinal membranes, exudative retinal detachment and cystoid macular edema, as well as, occasionally, retin...

diseases.name: Vasomotor rhinitis
diseases.group: immune system disorder|respiratory system disorder|inflammatory disease|otorhinolaryngologic disease
diseases.definition: Inflammation in the nasal cavity mucosa that results from the abnormal regulation of the blood flow in the nose. It may be caused by temperature fluctuations, air pollution, strong odors, and tobacco smoke. It results in chronic nasal congestion, sneezing, and running nose.

diseases.name: Vasculogenic impotence
diseases.definition: Inability to achieve and maintain an erection (erectile dysfunction) due to defects in the arterial blood flow to the penis, defect in venous occlusive function allowing blood drainage (leakage) from the erectile tissue (corpus cavernosum penis), or both.

diseases.name: Vasculitis, lymphocytic, nodular
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|cardiovascular disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Lymphocytic vasculitis is one of several skin conditions which are collectively referred to as cutaneous vasculitis. In lymphocytic vasculitis, white blood cells (lymphocytes) cause damage to blood vessels in the skin. This condition is thought to be caused by a number of factors, but the exact cause of most cases is not known. This disease can present with a variety of symptoms, depending on t...

diseases.name: Vascular parkinsonism
diseases.definition: A Parkinsonism that is characterized by postural instability, a broad-based gait with the absence of tremors of vascular origin.

diseases.name: Vascular hyalinosis
synonyms: retinal ischemic syndrome-digestive tract small vessel hyalinosis-diffuse cerebral calcifications syndrome
retinal ischaemic syndrome-digestive tract small vessel hyalinosis-diffuse cerebral calcifications syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by progressive hyalinosis involving capillaries and often arterioles and small veins of the digestive tract, kidneys, and idiopathic cerebral calcifications. It has been described in three sisters born to non-consanguineous parents. All three patients also had poikilodermia and graying hair, as well as severe diarrhea, rectal bleeding, malabsorption and subarachnoid hem...

diseases.name: Vascular disorder of penis
diseases.definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the blood vessels of the penis. Representative examples include atherosclerosis, venous leak, and hemangioma.

diseases.name: Vascular dementia
diseases.definition: A degenerative vascular disorder affecting the brain. It is caused by the blockage of the blood supply to the brain. It is manifested with decline of memory and cognitive functions.

diseases.name: Vascular brain injury
diseases.definition: Damage to the blood vessels of the brain

diseases.name: Vas deferens, congenital unilateral aplasia of
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Vas deferens, congenital bilateral aplasia of, x-linked
synonyms: vas deferens, congenital bilateral aplasia of, X-linked
vas deferens, congenital bilateral aplasia of, X-linked
congenital bilateral absence of vas deferens, X-linked
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Variola minor infection
diseases.definition: A orthopoxvirus that causes a milder clinical syndrome than smallpox.

diseases.name: Variegate porphyria, childhood-onset
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|metabolic disease|endocrine system disorder

diseases.name: Variegate porphyria
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|metabolic disease|endocrine system disorder
diseases.definition: Variegate porphyria is a form of acute hepatic porphyria characterized by the occurrence of neuro-visceral attacks with or without the presence of cutaneous lesions.

diseases.name: Varicose disease
diseases.definition: A vascular disease characterized by the presence of enlarged and tortuous veins.

diseases.name: Varicocele
diseases.definition: A condition characterized by the dilated tortuous veins of the spermatic cord with a marked left-sided predominance. Adverse effect on male fertility occurs when varicocele leads to an increased scrotal (and testicular) temperature and reduced testicular volume.

diseases.name: Variant creutzfeldt-jakob disease
diseases.definition: A form of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease that is most commonly contracted after consuming meat from an animal suffering from bovine spongiform encephalopathy.

diseases.name: Variant abeta2m amyloidosis
diseases.definition: A rare form of amyloidosis characterized by accumulation and extensive visceral deposition of anamyloidogenic variant of beta 2 microglobulin leading to progressive gastrointestinal dysfunction, Sjögren syndrome and autonomic neuropathy.

diseases.name: Variable-age onset idiopathic generalized epilepsy syndrome
diseases.definition: Any idiopathic generalized epilepsy syndrome that has a variable-age onset.

diseases.name: Vanishing lung syndrome
diseases.definition: A rare form of irreversible damage to the pulmonary parenchyma often due to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It is associated with a spectrum of clinical manifestations, including worsening dyspnea, cough, declining pulmonary function, and occasionally spontaneous pneumothorax due to ruptured bullae.

diseases.name: Van der woude syndrome 2
synonyms: van der Woude syndrome caused by mutation in GRHL3
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any van der Woude syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the GRHL3 gene.

diseases.name: Van der woude syndrome 1
synonyms: van der Woude syndrome caused by mutation in IRF6
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any van der Woude syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the IRF6 gene.

diseases.name: Van der woude syndrome
synonyms: cleft lip/palate with mucous cysts of lower lip
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Van der Woude syndrome (VWS) is a rare congenital genetic dysmorphic syndrome characterized by paramedian lower-lip fistulae, cleft lip with or without cleft palate, or isolated cleft palate.

diseases.name: Van den ende-gupta syndrome
diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Van den Ende-Gupta syndrome is a very rare syndrome characterized by blepharophimosis, arachnodactyly, joint contractures, and characteristic dysmorphic features.

diseases.name: Van den bosch syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by intellectual deficit, choroideremia, acrokeratosis verruciformis, anhidrosis, and skeletal deformities. It has been observed in a single kindred. The syndrome is transmitted as an X-linked recessive trait and may be caused by a small X-chromosome deletion.

diseases.name: Van maldergem syndrome 2
synonyms: van Maldergem syndrome caused by mutation in FAT4
diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any van Maldergem syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the FAT4 gene.

diseases.name: Van maldergem syndrome 1
synonyms: van Maldergem syndrome caused by mutation in DCHS1
diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any van Maldergem syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the DCHS1 gene.

diseases.name: Van maldergem syndrome
diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A rare multiple congenital anomalies syndrome characterized by mild to severe intellectual disability, a distinctive facial gestalt (blepharophimosis, maxillary hypoplasia, telecanthus, microtia and atresia of the external auditory meatus) as well as skeletal and articular abnormalities (e.g. camptodactyly of the fingers, cutaneous syndactyly, talipes equinovarus, flexion contractures of the pr...

diseases.name: Valvar pulmonary stenosis
diseases.group: cardiovascular disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A congenital cardiovascular malformation of the pulmonary valve in which there is narrowing or stricture (obstruction to flow).

diseases.name: Vallecula cancer
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|respiratory system disorder|otorhinolaryngologic disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A cancer involving a epiglottic vallecula.

diseases.name: Vagus nerve paraganglioma
diseases.group: hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|endocrine system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign or malignant extra-adrenal parasympathetic paraganglioma arising from paraganglia in the vagus nerve. Patients may present with a slow growing, painless mass in the neck, hoarseness, vocal cord paralysis, and dysphagia.

diseases.name: Vaginismus
diseases.definition: Tightness of the vaginal wall during vaginal penetration including sexual intercourse. It is caused by involuntary spasm of the pelvic floor muscles, and results in painful intercourse or failure to have intercourse. It may due to psychological conditions, trauma in the vaginal area, or vaginal infection.

diseases.name: Vaginal yolk sac tumor
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare yolk sac tumor that arises from the vagina. Patients present with abnormal vaginal bleeding or bloody discharge.

diseases.name: Vaginal villous adenoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An adenoma that arises from the vagina and is characterized by a villous architectural pattern.

diseases.name: Vaginal tubulovillous adenoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An adenoma that arises from the vagina and is characterized by a tubulovillous architectural pattern.

diseases.name: Vaginal squamous papilloma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign papillary neoplasm that arises from the vagina and is characterized by the presence of a fibrovascular stalk lined by normal squamous epithelium. There is no evidence of atypia or relation to human papillomavirus.

diseases.name: Vaginal squamous cell carcinoma
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the vagina
epidermoid cell carcinoma of the vagina
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma arising from the vagina. Human papillomavirus infection is associated with the development of vaginal intraepithelial neoplasia and invasive squamous cell carcinoma. Signs and symptoms include painless bleeding, postcoital bleeding, and urinary tract symptoms. Morphologically it resembles squamous cell carcinomas in other anatomic sites. Radiation therapy is the prefer...

diseases.name: Vaginal rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm with skeletal muscle differentiation arising from the vagina.

diseases.name: Vaginal mullerian papilloma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign papilloma that arises from the vagina in infants and young women.

diseases.name: Vaginal melanoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A primary malignant neoplasm of the vagina composed of malignant melanocytes.

diseases.name: Vaginal leiomyoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the vagina. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

diseases.name: Vaginal germ cell malignant tumor
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant germ cell tumor that involves the vagina.

diseases.name: Vaginal fibroepithelial polyp
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A superficial polypoid lesion that arises from the vagina. It is characterized by the presence of a fibroblastic stroma which is often myxoid, covered by squamous epithelial cells.

diseases.name: Vaginal carcinosarcoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An aggressive mixed epithelial and mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the vagina and is characterized by the presence of a malignant epithelial component and a malignant mesenchymal component.

diseases.name: Vaginal carcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A carcinoma arising from the vaginal epithelium. The majority of vaginal carcinomas are squamous cell carcinomas.

diseases.name: Vaginal atresia
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Vaginal adenosarcoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant mixed epithelial and mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the vagina and is characterized by the presence of a malignant mesenchymal component and a benign or atypical mullerian-type epithelial component.

diseases.name: Vaginal adenoid cystic carcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An adenoid cystic carcinoma that arises from the vagina. Myoepithelial cells are usually not present.

diseases.name: Vagina leiomyosarcoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the vagina. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

diseases.name: Vaccinia
diseases.definition: The cutaneous and occasional systemic reactions associated with vaccination using smallpox (variola) vaccine.

diseases.name: Uvulitis
diseases.definition: Inflammation of the uvula.

diseases.name: Uvula cancer
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|respiratory system disorder|otorhinolaryngologic disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the palatine uvula.

diseases.name: Uveoparotid fever
diseases.definition: A manifestation of sarcoidosis marked by chronic inflammation of the parotid gland and the uvea.

diseases.name: Uveal melanoma
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|disorder of visual system|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A melanoma derived from melanocytes of the uveal tract. It is the most common primary intraocular tumor in the United States and Western Europe. Similar to melanoma of the skin, it is rare in Africa and Asia. Diagnostic procedures include ophthalmoscopic exam, fluorescein angiography and ultrasound. Treatment includes: surgical excision of the eye, iridocyclectomy and tumor resection. Recent tr...

diseases.name: Uveal coloboma-cleft lip and palate-intellectual disability
synonyms: uveal coloboma-cleft lip and palate-intellectual disability
diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Uveal coloboma-cleft lip and palate-intellectual disability is characterized by coloboma of the iris, bilateral cleft lip and palate, and intellectual deficiency of varying degree. A wide variability in clinical expression is observed. Some patients also present with microphthalmia, cataract, glaucoma, ptosis, sensorineural hearing loss and haematuria. To date, 12 cases have been described from...

diseases.name: Uterus intravascular leiomyomatosis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare benign neoplasm characterized by the presence of smooth muscle cells growing within the veins of the uterine corpus. The intravascular neoplasm growth occurs outside the confines of an adjacent leiomyoma.

diseases.name: Uterus interstitial leiomyoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Uterine polyp
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign protruding lesion arising either from the endometrial cavity (endometrial polyp) or the endocervix (endocervical polyp). It may occasionally recur following complete resection.

diseases.name: Uterine ligament serous adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the uterine ligament.

diseases.name: Uterine ligament papillary cystadenoma associated with von hippel-lindau disease
synonyms: uterine ligament papillary cystadenoma associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign mesonephric neoplasm that arises from the uterine ligament and occurs in women with von Hippel-Lindau disease. It is a cystic lesion characterized by the presence of multiple papillary excrescences.

diseases.name: Uterine ligament mucinous adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare mucinous adenocarcinoma that arises from the uterine ligament.

diseases.name: Uterine ligament endometrioid adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare endometrioid adenocarcinoma that arises from the uterine ligament. Some of the reported cases were associated with endometriosis.

diseases.name: Uterine ligament clear cell adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A clear cell adenocarcinoma of the uterine ligament composed mainly of clear or hobnob cells. The clear cells are large, bizarre, and multinucleated.

diseases.name: Uterine ligament adenosarcoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An extremely rare adenosarcoma that arises from the uterine ligament.

diseases.name: Uterine inversion
diseases.definition: A complication of obstetric labor in which the corpus of the uterus is forced completely or partially through the uterine cervix. This can occur during the late stages of labor and is associated with immediate postpartum hemorrhage.

diseases.name: Uterine hypoplasia
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Uterine corpus rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare malignant heterologous neoplasm with skeletal muscle differentiation arising from the uterine corpus. It usually manifests with vaginal bleeding. The prognosis is poor.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus perivascular epithelioid cell tumor
synonyms: uterine corpus perivascular epithelioid cell tumor
body of uterus neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation arising from the uterine corpus wall.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus myxoid leiomyosarcoma
synonyms: myxoid leiomyosarcoma of body of uterus
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma arising from the uterus corpus. It is characterized by the presence of cellular pleomorphism, malignant cells with large nuclei, and a myxoid stroma.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus myxoid leiomyoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by extensive myxoid degeneration of the neoplasm connective tissue stroma.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus lipoleiomyoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by the presence of scattered islands of mature adipocytes within the smooth muscle neoplasm.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus leiomyoma
synonyms: leiomyoma of the body of uterus
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the body of the uterus. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus epithelioid leiomyosarcoma
synonyms: epithelioid leiomyosarcoma of body of uterus
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma arising from the uterine corpus. It is characterized by the presence of epithelioid round cells with eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus epithelioid leiomyoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by the presence of round or polygonal epithelioid smooth muscle cells forming clusters.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus endometrial stromal sarcoma
synonyms: endometrioid stromal sarcoma of body of uterus
body of uterus endometrioid stromal sarcoma
body of uterus endometrial stromal sarcoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A uterine corpus sarcoma originating from the endometrial stroma. It is further subdivided into low grade and high grade endometrial stromal sarcoma.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma
synonyms: endometrial carcinoma (disease) of body of uterus
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A endometrial carcinoma (disease) that involves the body of uterus.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus dissecting leiomyoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma. Macroscopically, it is characterized by large, fungating, and multinodular neoplasm masses arising from the uterine corpus, and extending into the broad ligament or the peritoneal cavity. Microscopically, it shows neoplastic smooth muscle cells infiltrating the myometrium. The neoplastic cells are arranged in a micronodular pattern. Hydrop...

diseases.name: Uterine corpus diffuse leiomyomatosis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An unusual condition characterized by the presence of numerous small benign smooth muscle neoplasms located throughout the body of the uterus.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus choriocarcinoma
synonyms: gestational choriocarcinoma of body of uterus
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor|obstetric disorder
diseases.definition: An aggressive malignant tumor arising from trophoblastic cells in the uterus during pregnancy. Approximately half of the cases develop from a complete hydatidiform mole. There is often marked elevation of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in the blood. Choriocarcinomas disseminate rapidly through the hematogenous route; the lungs are most frequently affected.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus cellular leiomyoma
synonyms: cellular leiomyoma of body of uterus
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic variant of leiomyoma arising from the uterine corpus. It is characterized by a dense cellular infiltrate composed of spindle or round cells with scant cytoplasm and a less obvious interlacing fascicle pattern.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus carcinofibroma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An uncommon malignant neoplasm arising from the uterine corpus. It is characterized by the presence of a malignant epithelial component and a benign mesenchymal (usually fibrous) component.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus bizarre leiomyoma
synonyms: uterine corpus leiomyoma with bizarre nuclei
bizarre leiomyoma of body of uterus
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by significant cytologic atypia. The atypical cells are large with pleomophic hyperchromatic nuclei.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus atypical polypoid adenomyoma
synonyms: body of uterus atypical polypoid adenomyoma
atypical polypoid adenomyoma of body of uterus
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An adenomyoma that arises from the uterine corpus and is characterized by the presence of marked glandular architectural complexity. It may recur following excision.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus apoplectic leiomyoma
synonyms: uterine corpus leiomyoma with apoplectic change
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by zones of hemorrhagic infarction surrounded by hypercellular areas. It usually develops in women of childbearing years, particularly those that are pregnant, post-partum, or taking oral contraceptives.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus adenosarcoma
synonyms: adenosarcoma of the body of uterus
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A primary polypoid malignant neoplasm of the uterine corpus characterized by the presence of a sarcomatous mesenchymal component and a benign epithelial component. Patients usually present with abnormal vaginal bleeding. It is considered a low grade malignant neoplasm and may recur following resection.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus adenomatoid tumor
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign mesothelial tumor of the serosal surface of the uterine body and myometrium. It is characterized by the presence of gland-like structures.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus adenofibroma
synonyms: adenofibroma of the body of uterus
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A usually polypoid, benign neoplasm that arises from the endometrial cavity. It is characterized by the presence of a mesenchymal core component and an epithelial component that forms a lining on the mesenchymal core.

diseases.name: Uterine corpus adenocarcinofibroma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A adenocarcinofibroma that involves the body of uterus.

diseases.name: Uterine cervix leukoplakia
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: The presence of whitish patches on the mucosal surface of the cervix. Histologic examination reveals hyperkeratosis. In a minority of cases, underlying dysplasia or carcinoma in situ is present.

diseases.name: Uterine cervix carcinoma in situ

uterine cervix carcinoma in situ aJCC v6
uterine cervix Severe dysplasia aJCC v6
severe dysplasia of uterine cervix aJCC v6

diseases.name: Uterine cervical aplasia and agenesis
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Usual ductal breast hyperplasia
synonyms: ductal breast hyperplasia of usual type
diseases.definition: A neoplastic ductal proliferative lesion of the breast characterized by the formation of secondary lumens and prominent intraductal proliferation of a heterogeneous cellular population that may include epithelial cells, myoepithelial cells, or metaplastic apocrine cells.

diseases.name: Urticaria, aquagenic
diseases.definition: Aquagenic urticaria is a rare condition in which urticaria (hives) develop rapidly after the skin comes in contact with water, regardless of its temperature. It most commonly affects women and symptoms often start around the onset of puberty. Some patients report itching too. It is a form of physical urticaria . The exact underlying cause of aquagenic urticaria is currently unknown. Due to the ...

diseases.name: Urothelial dysplasia
synonyms: transitional cell dysplasia of the urinary tract
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic finding indicating the presence of dysplastic changes in the transitional cell epithelium of the urinary tract.

diseases.name: Urofacial syndrome 2
synonyms: Ochoa syndrome caused by mutation in LRIG2
diseases.definition: Any Ochoa syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the LRIG2 gene.

diseases.name: Urocanic aciduria
diseases.definition: Encephalopathy due to urocanase deficiency is an extremely rare histidine metabolism disorder characterized by urocanic aciduria and other variable manifestations including intellectual deficit and intermittent ataxia in the 4 cases reported to date.

diseases.name: Urinary schistosomiasis
diseases.definition: A bladder infection that occurs as a manifetation of a systemic infection with one or more species of the parasitic worms of the Schistosoma type; this can progress to bladder cancer in time.

diseases.name: Urinary bladder, atony of
synonyms: bladder dysfunction, autonomic, with impaired pupillary reflex and secondary CAKUT

diseases.name: Urinary bladder villous adenoma
synonyms: villous adenoma of the urinary bladder
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An exophytic glandular neoplasm of the bladder, morphologically similar to its intestinal counterpart. It often coexists with in situ or infiltrating bladder adenocarcinoma.

diseases.name: Urinary bladder tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A tuberculosis that involves the urinary bladder.

diseases.name: Urinary bladder small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
synonyms: small cell/neuroendocrine carcinoma of urinary bladder
small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of urinary bladder
small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the urinary bladder
small cell carcinoma of urinary bladder
small cell carcinoma of the urinary bladder
poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinoma of the bladder
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A highly aggressive carcinoma, histologically resembling small cell lung carcinoma. In most cases it is associated with carcinoma in situ.

diseases.name: Urinary bladder posterior wall cancer
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of posterior wall of urinary bladder
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Urinary bladder inverted papilloma
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A neoplasm of the bladder in which the epithelial cells grow downward into the underlying supportive tissue, which often causes hematuria.

diseases.name: Urinary bladder cancer
synonyms: malignant tumour of the urinary bladder
malignant tumor of the urinary bladder
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the bladder.

diseases.name: Urinary bladder anterior wall cancer
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of anterior wall of urinary bladder
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Urethral villous adenoma
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An epithelial neoplasm of the urethra, which is morphologically characterized by the presence of a villous architectural pattern.

diseases.name: Urethral verrucous carcinoma
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A verrucous carcinoma that involves the urethra.

diseases.name: Urethral obstruction sequence
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Urethral calculus
diseases.definition: A concretion in the urethra.

diseases.name: Urethra leiomyoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the urethra. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

diseases.name: Urethra inverted papilloma
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A neoplasm of the urethra in which the epithelial cells grow downward into the underlying supportive tissue.

diseases.name: Urethra clear cell adenocarcinoma
synonyms: clear cell adenocarcinoma of the urethra
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic variant of urethral adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of tubulocystic or papillary structures lined with clear cuboidal or hobnail cells.

diseases.name: Urethra cancer
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the urethra

diseases.name: Ureterolithiasis
diseases.definition: The presence of a calculus in the ureter of the kidney; this is most often composed of mineral salts and proteins.

diseases.name: Ureterocele
diseases.definition: A cystic and dysplastic dilation of the distal ureter within the bladder that may extend into the bladder neck and urethra.

diseases.name: Ureteritis
diseases.definition: An acute or chronic inflammatory process affecting the ureter.

diseases.name: Ureteric orifice cancer
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of ureteric orifice of urinary bladder
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the ureteral orifice.

diseases.name: Ureteral obstruction
diseases.definition: Blockage in any part of the ureter causing obstruction of urine flow from the kidney to the urinary bladder. The obstruction may be congenital, acquired, unilateral, bilateral, complete, partial, acute, or chronic. Depending on the degree and duration of the obstruction, clinical features vary greatly such as hydronephrosis and obstructive nephropathy.

diseases.name: Ureteral lymphoma
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|hematologic disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A lymphoma that involves the ureter.

diseases.name: Ureter tuberculosis
diseases.definition: A tuberculosis that involves the ureter.

diseases.name: Ureter squamous cell carcinoma
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the ureter
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the ureter.

diseases.name: Ureter small cell carcinoma
synonyms: small cell carcinoma of the ureter
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare carcinoma that arises from the ureter. It is characterized by the presence of small neuroendocrine cells. The prognosis is poor.

diseases.name: Ureter leiomyoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the ureter. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

diseases.name: Ureter inverted papilloma
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A neoplasm of the ureter in which the epithelial cells grow downward into the underlying supportive tissue, which often causes hematuria.

diseases.name: Ureter cancer
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the ureter

diseases.name: Ureter benign neoplasm
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Cancer or tumors of the ureter which may cause obstruction leading to hydroureter, hydronephrosis, and pyelonephritis. hematuria is a common symptom.

diseases.name: Ureter adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the ureter

diseases.name: Uremic neuropathy
diseases.definition: Neuropathy resulting from uremia.

diseases.name: Urban-rogers-meyer syndrome
synonyms: intellectual disability-short stature-hand contractures-genital anomalies syndrome
diseases.definition: This syndrome is characterized by intellectual deficit, short stature, obesity, genital abnormalities, and hand and/or toe contractures. It has been described in two brothers and in one isolated case. The patients also present with generalized osteoporosis and a history of frequent fractures. This syndrome is similar to Prader-Willi syndrome, but the hand contractures and osteoporosis, together...

diseases.name: Urachus cancer
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the urachus.

diseases.name: Urachal sinus
diseases.definition: Urachal sinus is a type of congenital urachal anomaly resulting from the failure of the umbilical end of the urachus to close, without continuity to the bladder, and that is usually asymptomatic but can present with continuous cloudy umbilical discharge, tender midline infraumbilical mass and fever when infected.

diseases.name: Urachal diverticulum
diseases.definition: Urachal diverticulum is the rarest type of congenital urachal anomaly resulting from the failure of the distal urachus to close at its point of connectivity to the bladder that is usually asymptomatic but can be associated with recurrent urinary tract infections and other complications.

diseases.name: Urachal cyst
diseases.definition: Urachal cyst is a congenital urachal anomaly characterized by a failure of complete closure of the urachus, in which both ends are closed but the central lumen remains patent. It is typically asymptomatic but may become clinically significant when infected, presenting as a mass in the umbilical region accompanied by abdominal pain and fever.

diseases.name: Upper thoracic spina bifida cystica
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Upper thoracic spina bifida aperta
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Upper lip cancer
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the upper lip.

diseases.name: Upper limb mononeuronitis
diseases.definition: A disease affecting a single peripheral nerve of the upper limb.

diseases.name: Upper limb mesomelic dysplasia
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
