diseases.definition: A chromosomal disorder consisting of the partial duplication of chromosome 21.

diseases.name: Partial retinal vein occlusion
diseases.group: cardiovascular disorder|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system

diseases.name: Partial optic atrophy
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system

diseases.name: Partial motor epilepsy
diseases.definition: A simple partial seizure consisting of clonus or spasm of a muscle or muscle group; it may be single or in a continuous and repetitive series or may spread to adjacent muscles.

diseases.name: Partial lipodystrophy, congenital cataracts, and neurodegeneration syndrome
synonyms: partial lipodystrophy, congenital cataracts, and neurodegeneration syndrome

diseases.name: Partial hydatidiform mole
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor|obstetric disorder
diseases.definition: Partial hydatiform mole is a type of hydatiform mole characterized by abnormal hyperplastic trophoblasts and hydropic villi due to fertilization of a normal ovocyte by two spermatozoa or one abnormal spermatozoon (allowing for some fetal development), and that manifests with vaginal bleeding accompanied by nausea and frequent vomiting, hyperemesis gravidarum, hyperthyroidism and risk of spontan...

diseases.name: Partial fetal alcohol syndrome
diseases.definition: A fetal alcohol spectrum disorder that results in most, but not all, of the growth deficiency and/or craniofacial features of fetal alcohol syndrome including central nervous system dysfunction due to prenatal alcohol exposure.

diseases.name: Partial duplication of the long arm of chromosome 12
diseases.definition: Chromosome 12q duplication is a chromosome abnormality that occurs when there is an extra copy of genetic material on the long arm (q) of chromosome 12. The severity of the condition and the signs and symptoms depend on the size and location of the duplication and which genes are involved. Features that often occur in people with chromosome 12q duplication include developmental delay, intellect...

diseases.name: Partial corpus callosum agenesis-cerebellar vermis hypoplasia with posterior fossa cysts syndrome
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A rare, hereditary, cerebral malformation with epilepsy syndrome characterized by severe global developmental delay with no ability to walk and no verbal language, intractable epilepsy, partial agenesis of the corpus callosum and cerebellar vermis hypoplasia with posterior fossa cysts.

diseases.name: Partial circumpapillary choroid dystrophy
diseases.group: cardiovascular disorder|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system

diseases.name: Partial chromosome y deletion
synonyms: Male sterility due to chromosome Y deletion
diseases.definition: A genetic male infertility characterized by azoospermia or oligozoospermia due to chromosome Y microdeletion.

diseases.name: Partial central choroid dystrophy
diseases.group: hereditary disease|cardiovascular disorder|disorder of visual system

diseases.name: Partial atrioventricular canal
diseases.group: hereditary disease|cardiovascular disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Partial atrioventricular canal (PAVC) is a congenital heart malformation characterized by an atrial septal defect (ASD; ostium primum), clefts of mitral and occasionally tricuspid valves, two separate atrioventricular (AV) valve annuli and an intact ventricular septum. The typical symptoms of PAVC are impaired exercise capacity and exertional dyspnea.

diseases.name: Partial arterial retinal occlusion
diseases.group: cardiovascular disorder|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: A partial occlusion of the retinal artery.

diseases.name: Partial androgen insensitivity syndrome
synonyms: androgen insensitivity, partial, with or without breast cancer, X-linked recessive
androgen insensitivity, partial, with or without breast cancer
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Partial androgen insensitivity syndrome (PAIS) is a disorder of sex development (DSD) distinct from complete AIS (CAIS) characterized by the presence of abnormal genital development in a 46,XY individual with normal testis development and partial responsiveness to age-appropriate levels of androgens.

diseases.name: Pars planitis
synonyms: pars plana of ciliary body inflammation
inflammation of pars plana of ciliary body
diseases.definition: An inflammatory disorder of the cilliary body in the uvea that affects healthy, younger individuals who are often asymptomatic. It has a long clinical course with relapses and remissions. Symptoms include mildly decreased vision and floaters. It may be associated with autoimmune disorders.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal nonkinesigenic dyskinesia 2
diseases.definition: A dystonia characterized by autosomal dominant inheritance of attacks of dystonic or choreathetotic movements precipitated by stress, fatigue, coffee or alcohol intake or menstruation that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 2q31.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal nonkinesigenic dyskinesia 1
synonyms: paroxysmal dyskinesia caused by mutation in PNKD
diseases.definition: Paroxysmal nonkinesigenic dyskinesia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the PNKD gene.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal nonkinesigenic dyskinesia
diseases.definition: Paroxysmal non-kinesigenic dyskinesia (PNKD) is a form of paroxysmal dyskinesia, characterized by attacks of dystonic or choreathetotic movements precipitated by stress, fatigue, coffee or alcohol intake or menstruation.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria 2
synonyms: paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria caused by mutation in PIGT
paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria 2, autosomal dominant, somatic mutation
diseases.definition: Any paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the PIGT gene.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria 1
synonyms: paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria caused by mutation in pIgA
paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria caused by mutation in PIGA
diseases.definition: Any paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the PIGA gene.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria
diseases.definition: Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) is an acquired clonal hematopoietic stem cell disorder characterized by corpuscular hemolytic anemia, bone marrow failure and frequent thrombotic events.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal familial ventricular fibrillation
synonyms: idiopathic ventricular fibrillation, non Brugada type
diseases.definition: A rare, genetic, cardiac rhythm disease characterized by ventricular fibrillation in the absence of any structural or functional heart disease, or known repolarization abnormalities. The presence of J waves is associated with a higher risk of nocturnal ventricular fibrillation events and a higher risk of recurrence.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal extreme pain disorder
diseases.definition: Paroxysmal extreme pain disorder is a rare disorder of abnormal pain sensation.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal dyskinesia
diseases.definition: Paroxysmal dyskinesia (PD) is a rare heterogenous group of movement disorders manifesting as abnormal involuntary movements that recur episodically and last only a brief time. PD includes paroxysmal kinesigenic dyskinesia (PKD), paroxysmal non-kinesigenic dyskinesia (PNKD), paroxysmal exertion-induced dyskinesia (PED) and a variant form of PKD, infantile convulsion and choreoathetosis (ICCA syn...

diseases.name: Paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria
diseases.definition: Paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria (PCH) is a very rare subtype of autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA), caused by the presence of cold-reacting autoantibodies in the blood and characterized by the sudden presence of hemoglobinuria, typically after exposure to cold temperatures.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
diseases.definition: An atrial fibrillation disorder characterized by intermittent atrial fibrillation that lasts less than seven days from onset.

diseases.name: Paroxysmal hemicrania
diseases.definition: Paroxysmal hemicrania (PH) is a primary headache disorder characterized by multiple attacks of unilateral pain that occur in association with cranial autonomic symptoms. The hallmarks of this syndrome are the relative shortness of the attacks and the complete response to indomethacin therapy.

diseases.name: Parovarian cyst
diseases.definition: A cyst (cysts) near the ovary, derived from anomalies of the fallopian tubes or the broad ligament. The paramesonephric type consists of ciliated cells similar to the oviduct epithelium. The mesonephric type consisted of an epithelium with minimally surface structures. They can be found on the thin oviduct (paratubal cysts) or near its fimbriated end (hydatid of Morgagni).

diseases.name: Parotitis
diseases.definition: Inflammation of the parotid glands.

diseases.name: Parotid salivary glands, polycystic dysgenetic disease of
Parotid gland squamous cell carcinoma
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the parotid gland
squamous cell carcinoma of the parotid
squamous cell carcinoma of parotid gland
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|otorhinolaryngologic disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An invasive squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the parotid gland. It usually affects elderly patients and presents as a rapidly enlarging tumor mass, often associated with pain.

diseases.name: Parotid gland carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma
synonyms: parotid gland carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma
carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma of the parotid gland
carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma of the parotid
carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma of parotid gland
carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma of parotid
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that arises from a pleomorphic adenoma in the parotid gland. Patients usually present with a history of a long-standing tumor mass which grew rapidly in the past few months. Patients with non-invasive or minimally invasive carcinoma have an excellent prognosis. In cases where there is invasion of the surrounding tissues, the clinical course is aggressive.

diseases.name: Parotid gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
synonyms: adenoid cystic carcinoma of the parotid gland
adenoid cystic carcinoma of the parotid
adenoid cystic carcinoma of parotid gland
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An aggressive carcinoma that arises from the parotid gland. It is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial and myoepithelial cells forming cribriform, tubular, and solid patterns. It usually presents as a slow growing mass. Patients develop pain because of the tendency of these carcinomas to invade perineural tissues.

diseases.name: Parotid gland acinic cell carcinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma with serous acinar cell differentiation that arises from the parotid gland. Patients usually present with a slow growing mass in the parotid area.

diseases.name: Parkinsonism-dystonia, infantile
diseases.definition: Infantile dystonia-parkinsonism (IPD) is an extremely rare inherited neurological syndrome that presents in early infancy with hypokinetic parkinsonism and dystonia and that can be fatal.

diseases.name: Parkinsonism with dementia of guadeloupe
diseases.definition: Parkinsonism with dementia of Guadeloupe is characterized by symmetrical bradykinesia, predominantly axial rigidity, postural instability with early falls and cognitive decline with prominent features of frontal lobe dysfunction.

diseases.name: Parkinsonism due to atp13a2 deficiency
diseases.group: psychiatric disorder|hereditary disease|metabolic disease|nervous system disorder

diseases.name: Parkinsonian-pyramidal syndrome
synonyms: autosomal recessive early-onset Parkinson disease type 15
diseases.definition: A Parkinson's disease that has material basis in mutation in the FBXO7 gene on chromosome 22q12.3.

diseases.name: Parietal lobe ependymal tumor
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An ependymal tumor affecting the parietal lobe of the brain.

diseases.name: Parietal lobe cancer
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the parietal lobe

diseases.name: Parietal foramina with cleidocranial dysplasia
diseases.definition: Parietal foramina with clavicular hypoplasia is a rare genetic bone development disorder characterized by parietal foramina in association with hypoplasia of the clavicles (short abnormal clavicles with tapering lateral ends, with or without loss of the acromion). Additional features may include mild craniofacial dysmorphism (macrocephaly, broad forehead and frontal bossing). No dental abnormal...

diseases.name: Parietal foramina 3
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Parietal foramina 2
synonyms: parietal foramina caused by mutation in ALX4
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any parietal foramina in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ALX4 gene.

diseases.name: Parietal foramina 1
synonyms: parietal foramina caused by mutation in MSX2
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any parietal foramina in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the MSX2 gene.

diseases.name: Parietal foramina
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Enlarged parietal foramina (EPF) is a developmental defect, characterized by variable intramembranous ossification defects of the parietal bones, which is either asymptomatic, symptomatic (headaches, nausea, vomiting, intellectual disability) or associated with other pathologies.

diseases.name: Parietal encephalocele
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Parenteral nutrition-associated cholestasis
diseases.definition: A rare hepatic disease characterized by intrahepatic cholestasis and deterioration of liver function in patients receiving parenteral nutrition for extended periods of time (signs may appear as early as within the first two weeks of initiation of parenteral nutrition). The condition commonly occurs in neonates and usually resolves with transition to enteral feeding, although severe cases may pr...

diseases.name: Parenchymatous neurosyphilis
diseases.definition: A tertiary neurosyphilis that results when chronic meningoencephalitis causes destruction of cortical parenchyma. The infection has symptom irritability, has symptom difficulty concentrating, has symptom deterioration of memory, has symptom defective judgment, has symptom headaches, has symptom insomnia, has symptom fatigue, and has symptom lethargy.

diseases.name: Paratyphoid fever
diseases.definition: A condition resembling typhoid fever that is caused by infection by Salmonella enterica serovar Parathyphi.

diseases.name: Parathyroid oncocytic adenoma
diseases.group: endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A parathyroid gland adenoma composed predominantly or entirely of neoplastic cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm.

diseases.name: Parathyroid hyperplasia
diseases.group: endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A hyperplasia that involves the parathyroid gland.

diseases.name: Parathyroid gland clear cell adenoma
synonyms: transitional clear cell adenoma of the parathyroid gland
transitional clear cell adenoma of the parathyroid
transitional clear cell adenoma of parathyroid gland
transitional clear cell adenoma of parathyroid
parathyroid gland transitional clear cell adenoma
clear cell adenoma of the parathyroid gland
clear cell adenoma of the parathyroid
clear cell adenoma of parathyroid gland
diseases.group: endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A parathyroid gland adenoma composed predominantly of neoplastic cells with clear cytoplasm.

diseases.name: Parathyroid gland carcinoma
diseases.group: hereditary disease|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A very rare, slow-growing, clinically serious endocrine tumor that generally develops in mid-adulthood. PRTC presents as a palpable painless mass in the neck and causes severe hypercalcemia and related symptoms, non-specific gastrointestinal manifestations, as well as renal and bone complications related to primary hyperparathyroidism (nephrolithiasis, impaired renal function, osteoporosis, bon...

diseases.name: Paratesticular adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Paratenonitis with tendinosis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Paratenonitis associated with intratendinous degeneration.

diseases.name: Parastremmatic dwarfism
diseases.definition: Parastremmatic dwarfism is a very rare chondrodysplasia characterized by severe dwarfism, kyphoscoliosis, stiffness of large joints and distortion of lower limbs.

diseases.name: Parasomnia, sleepwalking type
diseases.definition: A disorder in which a series of complex behaviors are initiated during slow-wave (non-REM) sleep and result in walking during sleep. It is a parasomnia, defined as a clinical disorder resulting in undesirable physical phenomena that occur predominantly during sleep. Parasomnias are not abnormalities of the processes responsible for sleep and wake states. Sleepwalking is more common in childhood...

diseases.name: Parasitemia
diseases.definition: The presence of parasites (especially malarial parasites) in the blood. (Dorland, 27th ed)

diseases.name: Parasagittal meningioma
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A meningioma that affects the superior sagittal sinus and invades the parasagittal angle.

diseases.name: Paraquat poisoning
diseases.definition: Paraquat poisoning is a rare intoxication with paraquat (a non-selective bipyridilium herbicide that has been banned in Europe), usually occurring through ingestion of the poison, and that presents with caustic injury of the oral cavity and pharynx, as well as nausea, vomiting, epigastric pain, lethargy, loss of consciousness and fever. Patients may develop potentially life-threatening complica...

diseases.name: Paraplegia-intellectual disability-hyperkeratosis syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome characterized by intellectual deficit, spasticity in the lower limbs (spastic paraplegia), pes cavus deformity of both feet, an abnormal gait, and palmar and plantar hyperkeratosis. It has been reported in four brothers. The mother of the affected boys had normal intelligence, plantar hyperkeratosis and a strong facial resemblance to her retarded sons. Her three daughters were normal...

diseases.name: Paraplegia
diseases.definition: Complete paralysis of the lower half of the body including both legs, often caused by damage to the spinal cord.

diseases.name: Paraphimosis
diseases.definition: A condition in which the foreskin of an uncircumcised male is retracted and cannot be pulled back over the glans penis. It results in painful swelling of the glans penis and, if is not corrected, may lead to gangrene.

diseases.name: Parapharyngeal meningioma
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Paraparetic variant of guillain-barre syndrome
diseases.group: syndromic disease|immune system disorder|nervous system disorder
diseases.definition: Paraparetic variant of Guillain-Barré syndrome is a rare variant of Guillain-Barré syndrome characterized by isolated leg weakness, areflexia and radicular leg pain that may simulate a cauda equina or spinal cord syndrome. The arms, ocular, facial, and oropharyngeal muscles are spared, and sphincteric function is normal.

diseases.name: Paranoid schizophrenia
diseases.definition: A subtype of schizophrenia characterized by prominent delusions (typically persecutory or grandiose) or hallucinations in the context of a relative preservation of cognitive functioning and affect.

diseases.name: Paranoid personality disorder
diseases.definition: A disorder characterized by an enduring pattern of behavior based on the pervasive belief that the motives of others are malevolent and that they should not be trusted.

diseases.name: Paraneoplastic uveitis
diseases.group: cardiovascular disorder|inflammatory disease|disorder of visual system

diseases.name: Paraneoplastic rheumatic syndrome
diseases.definition: Paraneoplastic syndrome that involves the joints, bones, muscles, and/or connective tissue.

diseases.name: Paraneoplastic polyneuropathy
diseases.group: syndromic disease|nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A diffuse or multifocal peripheral neuropathy caused by the effects of a distant neoplasm. It may be attributed, in part, to the immune response to neoplasm-elaborated proteins. The neuropathy may be sensory, motor, mixed or autonomic. It may be the initial presentation of an occult neoplasm. Detection and resection of the neoplasm may result in cure.

diseases.name: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|syndromic disease|immune system disorder|inflammatory disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Pemphigus is a group of chronic autoimmune skin diseases characterized by blisters formation on the outer layer of the skin and the mucous membranes. Three clinical forms have been characterized, of which paraneoplastic pemphigus is extremely rare.

diseases.name: Paraneoplastic gastrointestinal syndrome
diseases.definition: Paraneoplastic syndrome that involves the digestive system.

diseases.name: Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration
diseases.group: syndromic disease|nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare, immune-mediated disorder characterized by cerebellar degeneration due to the presence of an often undetected malignancy (usually carcinoma or lymphoma) in an anatomic site other than the cerebellum. Signs and symptoms include progressive ataxia, dysarthria, and nystagmus.

diseases.name: Paranasal sinus squamous cell carcinoma
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the paranasal sinus
squamous cell carcinoma of the nasal cavity and sinuses
squamous cell carcinoma of paranasal sinus
epidermoid carcinoma of the paranasal sinus
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|nervous system disorder|respiratory system disorder|otorhinolaryngologic disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the mucosal epithelial surface of the ethmoid, frontal, maxillary, or sphenoid sinus. Patients may present with nasal fullness, obstruction, and/or epistaxis.

diseases.name: Paranasal sinus sarcoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|nervous system disorder|respiratory system disorder|otorhinolaryngologic disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the paranasal sinus.

diseases.name: Paranasal sinus mucoepidermoid carcinoma
synonyms: mucoepidermoid carcinoma of the paranasal sinus
mucoepidermoid carcinoma of the accessory sinus
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|nervous system disorder|respiratory system disorder|otorhinolaryngologic disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare carcinoma that arises from the paranasal sinus. It is characterized by the presence of epidermoid cells, mucus producing cells, and cells of intermediate type.

diseases.name: Paranasal sinus lymphoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|nervous system disorder|respiratory system disorder|hematologic disorder|otorhinolaryngologic disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A lymphoma that arises from the paranasal sinus. Representative examples include diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

diseases.name: Paramyotonia congenita of von eulenburg
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder
diseases.definition: Paramyotonia congenita of Von Eulenburg is characterized by exercise- or cold-induced myotonia and muscle weakness. Prevalence is unknown. The syndrome is nonprogressive and is transmitted as an autosomal dominant trait. It is caused by mutations in the gene encoding the alpha subunit of the type IV voltage-gated sodium channel (SCN4A; 17q23.3).

diseases.name: Parametrium malignant neoplasm
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm involving the parametrium.

diseases.name: Parametritis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Inflammation of the parametrium, the connective tissue of the pelvic floor, extending from the subserous coat of the uterus laterally between the layers of the broad ligament.

diseases.name: Parameningeal embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.definition: An embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma located in the parameningeal region.

diseases.name: Paramedian nasal cleft
synonyms: isolated cleft of the ala nasi
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis|otorhinolaryngologic disease
diseases.definition: Paramedian nasal cleft is a rare developmental defect during embryogenesis characterized by a unilateral or bilateral coloboma of the nose, ranging in severity from a small notch, resulting in minor deviation of the nasal septum, to variable-sized clefts of the nasal ala which may be associated with small cysts or sinuses in the nasal midline. Defect may be isolated or may occur in association ...

diseases.name: Paralytic ileus
diseases.definition: An ileus caused by abdominal or pelvic surgery, infections, disorders that affect the muscles and nerves, and medications. Signs and symptoms include those of intestinal obstruction.

diseases.name: Parainfluenza virus type 4 infectious disease
synonyms: infection due to human parainfluenza virus 4
infection caused by human parainfluenza virus 4
diseases.definition: A disease caused by infection with parainfluenza virus type 4.

diseases.name: Parainfluenza virus type 2 infectious disease
synonyms: infection due to human parainfluenza virus 2
infection caused by human parainfluenza virus 2
diseases.definition: A disease caused by infection with parainfluenza virus type 2.

diseases.name: Parainfluenza virus type 1 infectious disease
synonyms: infection due to human parainfluenza virus 1
infection caused by human parainfluenza virus 1
diseases.definition: A disease caused by infection with parainfluenza virus type 1.

diseases.name: Paragonimiasis
synonyms: Paragonimus westermani caused disease or disorder
diseases.definition: A parasitic infection caused by trematodes of the Paragonimus genus. Humans are infected from ingestion of raw or undercooked food. It results in chronic lung infection and eosinophilia.

diseases.name: Paracoccidioidomycosis
diseases.definition: A systemic fungal infection caused by Paracoccidioides brasiliensis that is most often seen in immunocompromised patients. It affects the mucous membranes, lymph nodes, lungs and bones.

diseases.name: Parachute tricuspid valve
diseases.group: cardiovascular disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Parachute tricuspid valve is a rare congenital heart malformation defined as an insertion of the chordal apparatus into a single papillary muscle or a muscle group, making a pathognomonic 'pear' shape sign in the four-chamber echocardiographic view with the atrium forming the larger base of the pear and the leaflets the apex. Isolated parachute tricuspid valve may be asymptomatic or present wit...

diseases.name: Papular xanthoma
diseases.definition: Papular xanthoma is a form of non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis characterized by cutaneous presentation of solitary or disseminated yellow to orange-brown papular or papulonodular, noncoalescent, asymptomatic skin lesions located predominantly on the head, neck, trunk and extremities (rarely on oral mucosa), in the presence of normolipidemia. Microscopically, the lesions consist of monomorphous...

diseases.name: Papular mucinosis of infancy
diseases.definition: Papular mucinosis of infancy is a rare pediatric non progressive form of localized lichen myxedematosus characterized by the development of firm opalescent mucinous papules on the upper arms and the trunk.

diseases.name: Papular elastorrhexis
diseases.definition: An acquired form of collagenoma that appears in childhood. It is characterized by discrete, firm, skin-colored, and slightly elevated cutaneous papules, nodules or plaques that may be generalized, or found on the trunk and the extremities.

diseases.name: Papillomatosis, florid, of nipple
diseases.definition: A rare benign neoplasm that arises in the area of the nipple. Clinically, it usually presents as a tender erythematous crusting lesion with hardening of the nipple. Morphologically, there is proliferation of ducts lined with epithelial and myoepithelial cells and focal erosion of the epidermis.

diseases.name: Papilloma of eyelid
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A papilloma that involves the eyelid.

diseases.name: Papilloma of buccal mucosa
diseases.definition: A papilloma that involves the buccal mucosa.

diseases.name: Papillary urothelial hyperplasia
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A type of hyperplasia that is characterized by variable thickening of the urinary tract epithelium and a slight papillary growth. The latter is not associated with the presence of fibrovascular cores. There is no evidence of atypia. The relationship between this lesion and papillary urothelial neoplasia is not clear. -- 2003

diseases.name: Papillary tumor of the pineal region
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Papillary tumor of the pineal region (PTPR) is a very rare neoplasm of the pineal region that is thought to arise from the specialized ependymocytes of the subcommissural organ and that manifests with visual disturbances, headaches, loss of coordination and balance, nausea and vomiting due to obstructive hydrocephalus.

diseases.name: Papillary thyroid microcarcinoma
synonyms: papillary Microcarcinoma of the thyroid gland
diseases.group: hereditary disease|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A papillary carcinoma of the thyroid gland measuring 10mm or less in diameter. The survival rates of patients with this type of carcinoma are the same with those of the normal population.

diseases.name: Papillary thymic adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: immune system disorder|endocrine system disorder|hematologic disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare primary thymic adenocarcinoma, characterized by a papillary growth pattern. There are only a few published cases, and no good data regarding prognosis.

diseases.name: Papillary serous cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A malignant cystic serous epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells forming papillary structures. Stromal invasion is present.

diseases.name: Papillary renal cell carcinoma
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare subtype of renal cell carcinoma, arising from the renal tubular epithelium and showing a papillary growth pattern, which typically manifests with hematuria, flank pain, palpable abdominal mass or nonspecific symptoms, such as fatigue, weight loss or fever. Symptoms related to metastatic spread, such as bone pain or persistent cough, are frequently associated since early diagnosis is not ...

diseases.name: Papillary meningioma of the cerebellum
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A papillary meningioma that affects the cerebellum.

diseases.name: Papillary lung adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: respiratory system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A morphologic variant of lung adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of papillary structures.

diseases.name: Papillary hidradenoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm arising from the sweat glands. It presents as a slow growing cystic nodular lesion most often in the skin of the vulva and the perianal region. It is characterized by the presence of cystic and large papillary structures. The papillary structures contain connective tissue and are covered by two layers of epithelium. Complete excision is curative.

diseases.name: Papillary glioneuronal tumor
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A WHO grade I, indolent and relatively circumscribed brain tumor. Morphologically it is characterized by the presence of astrocytes that line vascular and hyalinized pseudopapillae. In between the pseudopapillae aggregates of neurocytes, large neurons, and ganglioid cells are present.

diseases.name: Papillary extrahepatic bile duct adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Papillary ependymoma
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare variant of ependymoma characterized by well formed papillae. Tumor cell processes abutting capillaries are usually GFAP-positive. Differential diagnoses include choroid plexus papilloma, papillary meningioma and metastatic papillary carcinoma. (Adapted from WHO)

diseases.name: Papillary craniopharyngioma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A craniopharyngioma composed of sheets of squamous epithelium which separate to form pseudopapillae. This variant typically lacks nuclear palisading, wet keratin, calcification, and cholesterol deposits. Clinically, endocrine deficiencies are more often associated with papillary craniopharyngioma than with the adamantinomatous type. (Adapted from WHO)

diseases.name: Papillary carcinoma of the corpus uteri
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A papillary carcinoma that involves the body of uterus.

diseases.name: Papillary carcinoma of the cervix uteri
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A papillary carcinoma that involves the uterine cervix.

diseases.name: Papillary adenofibroma
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A biphasic polypoid neoplasm characterized by the presence of papillary projections that are lined by epithelial cells and fibrotic stroma.

diseases.name: Panuveitis
diseases.definition: A disorder characterized by inflammation of the entire uvea which includes the iris, ciliary body, and choroid. Causes include systemic infections, sarcoidosis, and cancers.

diseases.name: Pantothenate kinase-associated neurodegeneration
synonyms: neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation type 1
diseases.group: psychiatric disorder|hereditary disease|metabolic disease|nervous system disorder
diseases.definition: Pantothenate kinase-associated neurodegeneration (PKAN) is the most common type of neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation (NBIA), a rare neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive extrapyramidal dysfunction (dystonia, rigidity, choreoathetosis), iron accumulation on the brain and axonal spheroids in the central nervous system.

diseases.name: Panostotic fibrous dysplasia
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|immune system disorder|hematologic disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Panophthalmitis
diseases.group: infectious disease|inflammatory disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Acute suppurative inflammation of the inner eye with necrosis of the sclera (and sometimes the cornea) and extension of the inflammation into the orbit. Pain may be severe and the globe may rupture. In endophthalmitis the globe does not rupture.

diseases.name: Panniculitis and localized lipodystrophy
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|connective tissue disorder|metabolic disease|inflammatory disease

diseases.name: Panner disease
synonyms: aseptic necrosis of the capital humerus
diseases.definition: Panner's disease is an osteochondrosis of the capitellum of the humerus, characterized by involvement of the dominant upper limb and onset before the age of 10 years. It results from lateral compression injuries of the elbow typically occurring in children practicing sports such as baseball and throw. It should be distinguished from osteochondritis dissecans of the capitellum, occurring later, ...

diseases.name: Panic disorder without agoraphobia
diseases.definition: A disorder in which an individual experiences recurrent, unexpected panic attacks and persistent concern about having additional panic attacks. Agoraphobia is not a component of this disorder.

diseases.name: Panic disorder with agoraphobia
diseases.definition: A disorder in which an individual experiences recurrent, unexpected panic attacks and persistent concern about having additional panic attacks. Agoraphobia is a component of this disorder.

diseases.name: Panic disorder
diseases.definition: An anxiety disorder characterized by multiple unexpected panic attacks with persistent concern of recurring attacks. Panic disorder may or may not be accompanied by agoraphobia.

diseases.name: Panhypopituitarism, x-linked
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|nervous system disorder|endocrine system disorder

diseases.name: Panhypopituitarism
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|nervous system disorder|endocrine system disorder
diseases.definition: Insufficient production of all the anterior pituitary hormones.

diseases.name: Panhypophysitis
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|immune system disorder|nervous system disorder|endocrine system disorder|inflammatory disease

diseases.name: Pancytopenia-developmental delay syndrome
synonyms: Trilineage bone marrow failure-developmental delay syndrome
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|immune system disorder|hematologic disorder

diseases.name: Pancytopenia due to ikzf1 mutations
synonyms: syndrome with combined immunodeficiency caused by mutation in IKZF1
combined immunodeficiency due to IKAROS deficiency
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|immune system disorder|hematologic disorder
diseases.definition: Any syndrome with combined immunodeficiency in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the IKZF1 gene.

diseases.name: Pancytopenia
diseases.definition: A finding of low numbers of red and white blood cells and platelets in the peripheral blood.

diseases.name: Pancreatoblastoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Pancreatoblastoma is a rare malignant epithelial pancreatic neoplasm, most often found in children, which usually presents with the non-specific symptoms of a palpable mass, vomiting abdominal pain, jaundice, and weight loss/failure to thrive, and is characterized histologically by multiple lines of differentiation (acinar, ductal, mesenchymal, neuroendocrine) and the presence of squamoid nests.

diseases.name: Pancreatitis, sclerosing cholangitis, and sicca complex
synonyms: pancreatitis, sclerosing cholangitis, and sicca complex

diseases.name: Pancreatic vasoactive intestinal peptide producing tumor
synonyms: pancreatic vasoactive intestinal peptide producing tumor
pancreatic vasoactive intestinal peptide producing neoplasm
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A usually malignant pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor producing vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP). It may or may not be associated with inappropriate secretion of VIP and an associated clinical syndrome.

diseases.name: Pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase deficiency
diseases.group: hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|metabolic disease|endocrine system disorder
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive disorder caused by mutation(s) in the PNLIP gene, encoding pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase. The condition is characterized by absent or reduced pancreatic lipase.

diseases.name: Pancreatic somatostatinoma
synonyms: pancreatic delta cell somatostatin producing neoplasm
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A neuroendocrine tumor arising from the delta cells of the pancreas. It is characterized by inappropriate secretion of somatostatin and associated with diabetes mellitus, hypochlorhydria, gallbladder disease, diarrhea, steatorrhea, anemia, and weight loss.

diseases.name: Pancreatic small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
synonyms: small cell carcinoma of endocrine pancreas
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An aggressive, high-grade and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the pancreas. It is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells.

diseases.name: Pancreatic signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
synonyms: signet Ring cell carcinoma of the pancreas
signet Ring cell carcinoma of pancreas
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with poor prognosis. It is characterized by the presence of malignant signet ring cells infiltrating the pancreatic parenchyma in an individual cell pattern.

diseases.name: Pancreatic serous cystadenoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign, non-metastasizing cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. It is composed of glycogen-rich epithelial cells which produce a watery fluid. Signs and symptoms include abdominal mass, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and weight loss.

diseases.name: Pancreatic serous cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A metastasizing, slow-growing malignant epithelial neoplasm that arises from the exocrine pancreas. It is characterized by the presence of cysts and is composed of glycogen-rich malignant epithelial cells which produce a watery fluid. Signs and symptoms include upper gastrointestinal bleeding, weight loss, jaundice, and abdominal pain.

diseases.name: Pancreatic non-invasive mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A non-invasive malignant cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. It occurs almost exclusively in women. Small tumors are usually found incidentally. Larger tumors usually produce symptoms related to compression of the adjacent structures. It is characterized by the presence of columnar, mucin-producing epithelial cells which often form papillary projections with irregular...

diseases.name: Pancreatic non-functioning delta cell tumor
synonyms: nonfunctional Pancreatic Delta cell Neuroendocrine tumour
nonfunctional Pancreatic Delta cell Neuroendocrine tumor
non-functional pancreatic Delta cell neuroendocrine tumour
non-functional pancreatic Delta cell neuroendocrine tumor
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A usually malignant neuroendocrine tumor arising from the delta cells of the pancreas. It is not associated with a hormonal syndrome.

diseases.name: Pancreatic mucinous-cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
synonyms: pancreatic mucinous-cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A cystic epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of columnar mucin-producing epithelial cells, ovarian-type stroma formation, and a focal or extensive invasive carcinomatous component.

diseases.name: Pancreatic mucinous-cystic neoplasm
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A non-invasive or invasive cystic epithelial neoplasm that affects almost exclusively females. It is characterized by the presence of columnar mucin-producing epithelial cells and ovarian-type stroma formation.

diseases.name: Pancreatic mucinous cystadenoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A non-metastasizing cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. It is composed of columnar, mucin-producing epithelial cells. It occurs almost exclusively in women. Large tumors are often accompanied by a palpable abdominal mass.

diseases.name: Pancreatic lymphoma, familial
diseases.group: hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|hematologic disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An instance of pancreas lymphoma that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome.

diseases.name: Pancreatic lipomatosis duodenal stenosis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Pancreatic large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
synonyms: large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of pancreas
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An aggressive, high-grade and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the pancreas. It is characterized by the presence of malignant large cells.

diseases.name: Pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with low grade dysplasia
synonyms: pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with Low grade dysplasia
pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm with Low grade dysplasia
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A non-invasive pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that form a single layer and are well polarized. The neoplastic cells exhibit small and uniform nuclei, mild pleomorphism, and rare mitotic figures.

diseases.name: Pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with high grade dysplasia
synonyms: pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with high grade dysplasia
pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm with high grade dysplasia
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A non-invasive pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that exhibit loss of polarity, nuclear stratification, hyperchromasia, and pleomorphism. There is severe architectural atypia and frequent mitotic figures present.

diseases.name: Pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
synonyms: pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm characterized by the presence of a focal or multifocal invasive carcinomatous component. The invasive carcinoma is either colloid or ductal adenocarcinoma.

diseases.name: Pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous carcinoma
synonyms: intraductal papillary mucinous carcinoma of pancreas
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant glandular neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. Microscopically it is characterized by the presence of mucoid stroma formation, papillary patterns, and cystic changes. It has been associated with KRAS and Tp53 gene mutations.

diseases.name: Pancreatic insulinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An insulin-producing neuroendocrine tumor arising from the beta cells of the pancreas. Patients exhibit symptoms related to hypoglycemia due to inappropriate secretion of insulin.

diseases.name: Pancreatic insulin-producing neuroendocrine tumor
synonyms: insulin-producing tumour of the islet cells
insulin-producing tumor of the islet cells
beta cell tumour of the pancreas
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An insulin-producing neuroendocrine tumor arising from the beta cells of the pancreas. It may or may not be associated with inappropriate secretion of insulin and an associated clinical syndrome.

diseases.name: Pancreatic insufficiency-anemia-hyperostosis syndrome
synonyms: pancreatic insufficiency, dyserythropoietic anemia, calvarial hyperostosis syndrome
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|metabolic disease|endocrine system disorder|hematologic disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|mitochondrial disease
diseases.definition: A rare syndromic mitochondrial disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the COX4I2 gene. It is characterized by exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, dyserythropoietic anemia, and calvarial hyperostosis.

diseases.name: Pancreatic hypoplasia-diabetes-congenital heart disease syndrome
diseases.definition: A rare, syndromic diabetes mellitus characterized by partial pancreatic agenesis, diabetes mellitus, and heart anomalies (including transposition of the great vessels, ventricular or atrial septal defects, pulmonary stenosis, or patent ductus arteriosis).

diseases.name: Pancreatic gastrinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A neuroendocrine tumor arising from the pancreas. It is characterized by inappropriate secretion of gastrin and associated with Zollinger Ellison syndrome. The latter is characterized by the presence of peptic ulcer, gastroesophageal reflux disease, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and malabsorption.

diseases.name: Pancreatic foamy gland adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of adenocarcinoma cells with foamy cytoplasm.

diseases.name: Pancreatic endocrine carcinoma
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of islets of Langerhans
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An aggressive, high-grade and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the pancreas. The mitotic count is more than 20 per 10 HPF. According to the size of the malignant cells, the prominence of the nucleoli, and the amount of cytoplasm, it is classified either as small or large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma.

diseases.name: Pancreatic colipase deficiency
diseases.group: hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|metabolic disease|endocrine system disorder

diseases.name: Pancreatic cholera
synonyms: watery diarrhea, hypokalemia, and achlorhydria syndrome
diseases.definition: A rare syndrome characterized by severe watery diarrhea, hypokalemia, and achlorhydria. It is caused by the oversecretion of vasoactive intestinal peptide from the pancreatic islet cells.

diseases.name: Pancreatic carcinoma with mixed differentiation
synonyms: mixed exocrine-endocrine carcinoma of the pancreas
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare carcinoma with a poor prognosis, characterized by the presence of a mixture of exocrine and neuroendocrine malignant epithelial cells in both the pancreas and metastatic sites. Symptoms include jaundice, abdominal pain, and weight loss.

diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|cancer or benign tumor

synonyms: pancreatic beta cell agenesis with neonatal diabetes mellitus

diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any pancreatic agenesis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the PDX1 gene.

diseases.name: Pancreatic agenesis
diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Partial agenesis of the pancreas is characterized by the congenital absence of a critical mass of pancreatic tissue.

diseases.name: Pancreatic adenosquamous carcinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that arises from the pancreas showing both ductal and squamous differentiation. The squamous component should represent at least 30% of the malignant cellular infiltrate. The prognosis is usually worse than that of ductal adenocarcinoma.

diseases.name: Pancreatic acinar cell cystadenocarcinoma
synonyms: acinar cell cystadenocarcinoma of the pancreas
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A cystic adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of relatively uniform neoplastic cells which produce pancreatic enzymes and are arranged in acinar patterns. Signs and symptoms include abdominal pain, weight loss, nausea, and diarrhea. It usually has an aggressive clinical course.

diseases.name: Pancreatic acinar cell carcinoma
synonyms: acinar cell carcinoma of the pancreas
acinar cell adenocarcinoma of the pancreas
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma arising from the pancreas. It is characterized by the presence of relatively uniform malignant cells which form acinar patterns. It usually occurs during adulthood. Signs and symptoms include abdominal pain, weight loss, nausea, and diarrhea. It may metastasize to regional lymph nodes and the liver. A minority of patients develop lipase hypersecretion syndrome. This syndrome m...

diseases.name: Pancreatic acth-producing neuroendocrine tumor
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant, ectopic ACTH secreting pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor, associated with Cushing's syndrome. The prognosis is usually poor.

diseases.name: Pancreas, dorsal, agenesis of
diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Pancreas sarcoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare malignant soft tissue neoplasm that occurs primarily in the pancreas.

diseases.name: Pancreas disorder
diseases.definition: A non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the pancreas. Representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include pancreatitis and pancreatic insufficiency. Representative examples of neoplastic disorders include cystadenomas, carcinomas, lymphomas, and neuroendocrine neoplasms.

diseases.name: Pancolitis
diseases.group: hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|immune system disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Ulcerative colitis that involves the entire colon.

diseases.name: Palmoplantar pustulosis
synonyms: pustular psoriasis of the palms and/or soles
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|immune system disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: A rare skin disease characterized by chronic eruption of sterile pustules on an erythematous and desquamative background, affecting the palms and soles, sometimes also the lateral aspects of hands and feet. The lesions are usually painful. Nail lesions (such as nail pitting, onycholysis, subungual pustules, and nail dystrophy) are also observed. The condition takes a chronic and relapsing cours...

diseases.name: Palmoplantar keratoderma-esophageal carcinoma syndrome
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: An inherited condition characterized by palmoplantar keratoderma and esophageal cancer. The palmoplantar keratoderma usually begins around age 10, and esophageal cancer may form after age 20. This condition is caused by a mutation in the RHBDF2 gene and is inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern.

diseases.name: Palmoplantar keratoderma-deafness syndrome
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Palmoplantar keratoderma-deafness syndrome is a keratinization disorder characterized by focal or diffuse palmoplantar keratoderma. A patchy distribution is observed with accentuation on the thenars, hypothenars and the arches of the feet. The disease becomes apparent in infancy and is associated with sensorineural hearing loss that shows a variable age of onset. Due to genetic and clinical sim...

diseases.name: Palmoplantar keratoderma-xx sex reversal-predisposition to squamous cell carcinoma syndrome
synonyms: palmoplantar hyperkeratosis-XX sex reversal-predisposition to squamous cell carcinoma syndrome
palmoplantar hyperkeratosis with squamous cell carcinoma of skin and sex reversal
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Palmoplantar keratoderma-XX sex reversal-predisposition to squamous cell carcinoma syndrome is characterized by sex reversal in males with a 46, XX (SRY-negative) karyotype, palmoplantar hyperkeratosis and a predisposition to squamous cell carcinoma. To date, five cases (four of whom were brothers) have been described. The etiology is unknown.

diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.definition: Keratosis, Nagashima-type is a transgressive and nonprogressive palmoplantar keratoderma resembling a mild form of mal de Meleda.

diseases.name: Palmar fibromatosis
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A superficial fibromatosis arising from the soft tissue of the palm. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts, and an infiltrative growth pattern. It predominantly affects adult males.

diseases.name: Palindromic rheumatism
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|connective tissue disorder
diseases.definition: A syndrome that involves sudden and rapidly developing attacks of arthritis with a remission period that results in no joint damage or symptoms.

diseases.name: Pacman dysplasia
diseases.definition: Pacman dysplasia is characterized by epiphyseal stippling and osteoclastic overactivity. It has been described in less than 10 patients but may be underdiagnosed. It is characterized radiographically by severe stippling of the lower spine and long bones, and periosteal cloaking. Patients also have short metacarpals. The syndrome may be inherited as an autosomal recessive trait. This disorder sh...

synonyms: pachyonychia congenita caused by mutation in KRT6B
