diseases.definition: Any pachyonychia congenita in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the KRT6B gene.

diseases.name: Pachyonychia congenita 3
synonyms: pachyonychia congenita caused by mutation in KRT6A
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any pachyonychia congenita in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the KRT6A gene.

diseases.name: Pachyonychia congenita 2
synonyms: pachyonychia congenita caused by mutation in KRT17
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any pachyonychia congenita in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the KRT17 gene.

diseases.name: Pachyonychia congenita 1
synonyms: pachyonychia congenita caused by mutation in KRT16
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any pachyonychia congenita in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the KRT16 gene.

diseases.name: Pachyonychia congenita
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Pachyonychia congenita (PC) is a rare genodermatosis predominantly featuring painful palmoplantar keratoderma, thickened nails, cysts and whitish oral mucosa.

diseases.name: Pachygyria-intellectual disability-epilepsy syndrome
diseases.definition: A rare, genetic neurological disorder characterized by the presence of diffuse pachygyria and arachnoid cysts, psychomotor developmental delay and intellectual disability. Seizures (absence, atonic and generalized tonic-clonic) and, on occasion, headache are also associated.

diseases.name: Pachygyria, microcephaly, developmental delay, and dysmorphic facies, with or without seizures
Oxyphilic endometrial endometrioid adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A primary endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium characterized by the presence of eosinophilic malignant glandular epithelial cells.

diseases.name: Oxoglutaricaciduria
diseases.group: hereditary disease|metabolic disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|mitochondrial disease
diseases.definition: A rare, genetic, inborn error of metabolism disorder characterized by neonatal-onset of developmental delay, hypotonia, hepatomegaly, lactic acidemia, increased creatine kinase levels, elevated alpha-ketoglutaric acid in urine, and a decreased plasma beta-hydroxybutyrate-to-acetoacetate ratio. Pyruvate dehydrogenase deficiency can be associated, leading to hypoglycemia and neurologic anomalies,...

diseases.name: Overlap myositis
diseases.definition: Overlap myositis (OM) is a form of idiopathic inflammatory myopathy (IIM) characterized by myositis with at least one clinical and/or autoantibody overlap feature.

diseases.name: Overhydrated hereditary stomatocytosis
diseases.definition: Overhydrated hereditary stomatocytosis (OHSt) is a disorder of red cell membrane permeability to monovalent cations and is characterized clinically by hemolytic anemia.

diseases.name: Overgrowth syndrome with 2q37 translocation
diseases.definition: A rare overgrowth syndrome with skeletal involvement characterized by long and slim body habitus and multiple skeletal manifestations, such as scoliosis, macrodactyly of the big toes, arachnodactyly of fingers and toes, camptodactyly and clinodactyly, and progressive valgus deformities of the feet. Epimetaphyseal dysplasia, bowing of the tibiae, and dysmorphic facial features (hypertelorism, hi...

diseases.name: Overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in mtor pathway genes
synonyms: overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A disease caused by mosaic gain-of-function (GoF) of several genes in the MTOR pathway (MTOR, PIK3CA, PIK3R2 and AKT3) are functionally the same despite significant phenotypic variability. These GoF variants result in overgrowth due to an over-activation of key genes in this pathway. The phenotypic variability is generally attributed to the mosaic fraction and affected tissue types. For example...

diseases.name: Overactive bladder
diseases.definition: Symptom of overactive detrusor muscle of the urinary bladder that contracts with abnormally high frequency and urgency. Overactive bladder is characterized by the frequent feeling of needing to urinate during the day, during the night, or both. urinary incontinence may or may not be present.

diseases.name: Ovary rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the ovaries.

diseases.name: Ovary leiomyosarcoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the ovary. It is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

diseases.name: Ovarian yolk sac tumor, polyvesicular vitelline pattern
synonyms: ovarian yolk sac tumor, polyvesicular vitelline pattern
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of multiple dilated spaces lined by cells that resemble mesothelial cells. The dilated spaces coexist with columnar epithelial tissues.

diseases.name: Ovarian yolk sac tumor, hepatoid pattern
synonyms: ovarian yolk Sac tumor, hepatoid pattern
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of extensive differentiation into hepatic tissue.

diseases.name: Ovarian yolk sac tumor, glandular pattern
synonyms: ovarian yolk Sac tumor, glandular pattern
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A yolk sac tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of extensive differentiation into endodermal type glandular structures.

diseases.name: Ovarian transitional cell carcinoma
synonyms: transitional cell carcinoma of the ovary
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells that resemble malignant urothelial cells. There is no morphologic evidence of a benign or borderline Brenner tumor component present.

diseases.name: Ovarian thecoma
synonyms: theca cell tumour of the ovary
theca cell tumor of the ovary
theca cell neoplasm of the ovary
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A stromal tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of cells that contain lipid and resemble theca cells. The vast majority of cases are benign.

diseases.name: Ovarian surface papilloma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign serous neoplasm characterized by the presence of papillary proliferations on the surface of the ovary.

diseases.name: Ovarian stromal hyperthecosis
diseases.definition: A non-neoplastic disorder that usually affects postmenopausal women. It is characterized by the leuteinization of ovarian stromal cells. The ovaries are bilaterally involved and enlarged. When it affects women in reproductive age, it causes virilization, high blood pressure, and increased insulin levels.

diseases.name: Ovarian squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A usually high grade squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is not associated with a germ cell tumor. The prognosis is poor.

diseases.name: Ovarian solid teratoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A mature teratoma that arises from the ovary and presents as a large solid mass. It contains multiple cysts that vary in size. Small foci of hemorrhage are also present.

diseases.name: Ovarian small cell carcinoma
synonyms: small cell carcinoma of the ovary
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of small malignant cells. It includes small cell carcinoma, hypercalcemic type and small cell carcinoma, pulmonary type.

diseases.name: Ovarian serous surface papillary adenocarcinoma
synonyms: serous surface papillary carcinoma of the ovary
serous surface papillary carcinoma of ovary
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of a papillary architectural pattern.

diseases.name: Ovarian serous cystadenofibroma
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by serous epithelial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

diseases.name: Ovarian serous cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant serous cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of glandular, papillary, or solid structures. Psammoma bodies may be present. In well differentiated cases the malignant epithelial cells resemble the cells of fallopian tube epithelium. In poorly differentiated cases the malignant epithelial cells show anaplastic features.

diseases.name: Ovarian seromucinous carcinoma
synonyms: mixed epithelial carcinoma of the ovary
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant mixed epithelial neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is composed predominantly of serous and endocervical-type mucinous epithelium.

diseases.name: Ovarian remnant syndrome
diseases.definition: Ovarian remnant syndrome (ORS) is characterized by the presence of residual ovarian tissue after a woman has had surgery to remove one ovary or both ovaries (oophorectomy). Signs and symptoms may include pelvic pain, a pelvic mass, or the absence of menopause after oophorectomy. The condition may be caused by surgical factors leading to incomplete removal of ovarian tissue, including factors th...

diseases.name: Ovarian papillary cystadenoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A serous cystadenoma of the ovary characterized by the presence of small papillary projections in the inner surface of the cysts.

diseases.name: Ovarian myxoid liposarcoma
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A liposarcoma that arises from the ovary and is composed of round to oval mesenchymal cells, small signet ring lipoblasts, and a rich network of capillaries in a myxoid stroma.

diseases.name: Ovarian mucinous cystadenofibroma
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by mucinous columnar epithelial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

diseases.name: Ovarian mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An invasive cystic adenocarcinoma arising from the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells which contain intracytoplasmic mucin. The malignant cells invade the ovarian stroma and the cystic spaces contain mucoid material. In a minority of cases both ovaries are involved by the tumor. The prognosis for stage I tumors is excellent. Patients with metastas...

diseases.name: Ovarian mucinous adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An invasive adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells that contain intracytoplasmic mucin. There is cellular atypia, increased layering of cells, complexity of glands, and papillary formations.

diseases.name: Ovarian mucinous adenocarcinofibroma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm of the ovary with an invasive epithelial component and a fibrotic stroma. The epithelial component is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells with intracytoplasmic mucin. Cystic spaces are also present which contain mucoid material.

diseases.name: Ovarian mixed germ cell neoplasm
synonyms: mixed germ cell tumour of the ovary
mixed germ cell tumour of ovary
mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary
mixed germ cell tumor of ovary
mixed germ cell neoplasm of the ovary
mixed germ cell neoplasm of ovary
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An ovarian malignant germ cell tumor characterized by the presence of at least two different germ cell components. At least one of the germ cell components is primitive. The most common combination of germ cell elements is dysgerminoma and yolk sac tumor.

diseases.name: Ovarian microcystic stromal tumor
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign, unilateral tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of conspicuous microcystic changes, cellular areas, and a fibrous stroma.

diseases.name: Ovarian melanoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A melanoma (disease) that involves the ovary.

diseases.name: Ovarian malignant mesothelioma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare malignant mesothelial neoplasm that usually involves both the ovarian surface and the ovarian stroma. In most cases there is bilateral ovarian involvement.

diseases.name: Ovarian lymphoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|hematologic disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A lymphoma that affects the ovary. Lymphomatous involvement of the ovary is rare and in approximately half of the cases both ovaries are affected.

diseases.name: Ovarian large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
synonyms: non-small-cell type neuroendocrine carcinoma of the ovary
non-small-cell type neuroendocrine carcinoma of ovary
large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the ovary
large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the ovary
large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of ovary
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of large malignant cells exhibiting neuroendocrine differentiation. The prognosis is poor.

diseases.name: Ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder
diseases.definition: A complication of ovulation induction in infertility treatment. It is graded by the severity of symptoms which include ovary enlargement, multiple ovarian follicles; ovarian cysts; ascites; and generalized edema. The full-blown syndrome may lead to renal failure, respiratory distress, and even death. Increased capillary permeability is caused by the vasoactive substances, such as vascular endot...

diseases.name: Ovarian gynandroblastoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare neoplasm arising from the ovary. Although it may occur at any age, it is more often seen in young females. Morphologically, it is characterized by a mixture of two cellular populations: well differentiated Sertoli cells and granulosa cells, with the latter constituting at least ten percent of the neoplasm. The vast majority of cases are stage I lesions at presentation and produce either ...

diseases.name: Ovarian gonadoblastoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is composed of tissues that resemble dysgerminoma or seminoma and are admixed with sex cord tissues. It is found in children or young adults and usually is associated with secondary sex organs abnormalities. The majority of patients present as phenotypic females with virilization. The minority of patients present as phenotypic males with feminization. I...

diseases.name: Ovarian germ cell tumor
synonyms: germ cell tumour of the ovary
germ cell tumor of the ovary
germ cell neoplasm of the ovary
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A neoplasm that arises from the ovary and originates from germ cells. Representative examples include teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and dysgerminoma.

diseases.name: Ovarian fibrothecoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare, benign, sex cord-stromal neoplasm, with a typically unilateral location in the ovary, characterized by mixed features of both fibroma and thecoma. Patients may be asymptomatic or may present with pelvic/abdominal pain and/or distension and, occasionally, with post-menopausal bleeding. Large tumors (10cm) are often associated with pleural effusion and ascites (the Meigs syndrome triad).

diseases.name: Ovarian fibroma
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm arising from soft tissue of the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts.

diseases.name: Ovarian fetiform teratoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare type of teratoma that arises from the ovary and resembles a malformed fetus.

diseases.name: Ovarian endometriosis
diseases.definition: A non-neoplastic disorder characterized by the growth of endometrial tissue in the ovaries. It results in the development of blood filled ovarian cysts (chocolate cysts), and creation of scars and adhesions.

diseases.name: Ovarian endometrioid stromal and related neoplasms
synonyms: ovary endometrioid stromal and related neoplasms
ovarian endometrioid stromal and related neoplasms
endometrioid stromal and related neoplasms of ovary
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A category of rare neoplasms that arise from the ovary. It includes low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated sarcoma.

diseases.name: Ovarian endometrioid cystadenoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by endometrial-type well-differentiated cells.

diseases.name: Ovarian endometrioid cystadenofibroma
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by endometrial-type well-differentiated cells in a fibrotic stroma.

diseases.name: Ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinoma with squamous differentiation
synonyms: ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinoma with squamous differentiation
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An endometrioid adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and exhibits squamous differentiation. The squamous cell component often has a cytologically benign appearance.

diseases.name: Ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An endometrioid adenocarcinoma arising from the ovary. It comprises 10% to 25% of all primary ovarian carcinomas. Grossly, endometrioid carcinoma may present as a cystic or solid mass. Microscopically, the tumor greatly resembles the appearance of the ordinary type of endometrial adenocarcinoma. As a group, endometrioid carcinoma has a prognosis twice as good as that of serous or mucinous carci...

diseases.name: Ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinofibroma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells resembling endometrial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

diseases.name: Ovarian ectopic pregnancy
diseases.definition: An abnormal pregnancy in which the conception is implanted on the ovary.

diseases.name: Ovarian dysgenesis, hypergonadotropic, with short stature and recurrent metabolic acidosis
synonyms: ovarian dysgenesis, hypergonadotropic, with short stature and recurrent metabolic acidosis

diseases.name: Ovarian clear cell malignant adenofibroma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A carcinoma arising from the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells with clear cytoplasm in a fibrotic stroma.

diseases.name: Ovarian clear cell cystadenofibroma
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign neoplasm of glandular epithelium characterized by the presence of clear or hobnail cells within a dense fibrous stroma and cystic structures.

diseases.name: Ovarian clear cell cystadenocarcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant glandular epithelial neoplasm arising from the ovary. It is characterized by the presence of clear and hobnail cells and cystic structures.

diseases.name: Ovarian clear cell adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant glandular epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of clear and hobnail cells. It is highly associated with ovarian endometriosis, pelvic endometriosis and paraendocrine hypercalcemia.

diseases.name: Ovarian carcinosarcoma
synonyms: ovarian malignant mixed mesodermal Müllerian tumour
ovarian malignant mixed mesodermal Müllerian tumor
ovarian malignant mixed mesodermal Müllerian neoplasm
ovarian malignant mixed mesodermal Mullerian tumour
ovarian malignant mixed mesodermal Mullerian tumor
ovarian malignant mixed mesodermal Mullerian neoplasm
ovarian malignant mixed epithelial mesenchymal tumour
ovarian malignant mixed epithelial mesenchymal tumor
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A highly aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the ovary. Morphologically, it is a high grade tumor, composed of carcinomatous and sarcomatous elements.

diseases.name: Ovarian cancer
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the ovary. Most primary malignant ovarian neoplasms are either carcinomas (serous, mucinous, or endometrioid adenocarcinomas) or malignant germ cell tumors. Metastatic malignant neoplasms to the ovary include carcinomas, lymphomas, and melanomas.

diseases.name: Ovarian angiosarcoma
diseases.group: cardiovascular disorder|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant vascular neoplasm arising from the ovary.

diseases.name: Ovarian adenosarcoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A biphasic neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of mullerian-type epithelial tissue in a mesenchymal sarcomatous stroma. The presence of a high grade sarcomatous component is associated with recurrences and metastases.

diseases.name: Ovarian adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary. It is the most common type of ovarian carcinoma. It includes the serous adenocarcinoma, mucinous adenocarcinoma, clear cell adenocarcinoma, and endometrioid adenocarcinoma.

diseases.name: Ovarian wilms tumor
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An embryonal neoplasm arising from the ovary with morphologic features resembling Wilms tumor of the kidney. It occurs during the reproductive age and may present as a rapidly growing adnexal mass.

diseases.name: Ovalocytosis, hereditary hemolytic, with defective erythropoiesis
synonyms: ovalocytosis, hereditary hemolytic, with defective erythropoiesis

diseases.name: Otospondylomegaepiphyseal dysplasia, autosomal recessive

diseases.definition: A rare, genetic, multiple congenital anomalies/dysmorphic syndrome characterized by craniofacial dysmorphism (midface hypoplasia, depressed nasal bridge, small nose with upturned tip, cleft palate, Pierre Robin sequence), bilateral, pronounced sensorineural hearing loss, and skeletal/joint anomalies (including spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia, arthralgia/arthropathy), in the absence of ocular abnor...

diseases.name: Otospondylomegaepiphyseal dysplasia
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: An inborn error of cartilage collagen formation characterized by sensorineural hearing loss, enlarged epiphyses, skeletal dysplasia with disproportionately short limbs, vertebral body anomalies and a characteristic facies.

diseases.name: Otosalpingitis
diseases.definition: An inflammatory disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the pharyngotympanic tube.

diseases.name: Otopalatodigital syndrome type 2
synonyms: otopalatodigital syndrome, type II, X-linked dominant
Otopalatodigital Syndrome Type I and II
diseases.definition: A severe form of otopalatodigital syndrome spectrum disorder, and is characterized by dysmorphic facies, severe skeletal dysplasia affecting the axial and appendicular skeleton, extraskeletal anomalies (including malformations of the brain, heart, genitourinary system, and intestine) and poor survival.

diseases.name: Otopalatodigital syndrome type 1
synonyms: otopalatodigital syndrome, type I, X-linked dominant
diseases.definition: The mildest form of otopalatodigital syndrome spectrum disorder that is characterized by a generalized skeletal dysplasia, mild intellectual disability, conductive hearing loss, and typical facial anomalies.

diseases.name: Otoonychoperoneal syndrome

diseases.name: Otofaciocervical syndrome 2
synonyms: otofaciocervical syndrome caused by mutation in PAX1
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any otofaciocervical syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the PAX1 gene.

diseases.name: Otofaciocervical syndrome 1
synonyms: otofaciocervical syndrome caused by mutation in EYA1
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Any otofaciocervical syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the EYA1 gene.

diseases.name: Otofaciocervical syndrome
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A rare, genetic developmental defect during embryogenesis characterized by distinct facial features (long triangular face, broad forehead, narrow nose and mandible, high arched palate), prominent, dysmorphic ears (low-set and cup-shaped with large conchae and hypoplastic tragus, antitragus and lobe), long neck, preauricular and/or branchial fistulas and/or cysts, hypoplastic cervical muscles wi...

diseases.name: Otodental syndrome
diseases.group: chromosomal disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Otodental syndrome is a very rare inherited condition characterized by grossly enlarged canine and molar teeth (globodontia) associated with sensorineural hearing loss.

diseases.name: Otitis media with effusion
diseases.definition: Otitis media associated with accumulation of fluid in the middle ear.

diseases.name: Otitis externa
diseases.group: auditory system disorder|infectious disease|inflammatory disease|otorhinolaryngologic disease
diseases.definition: Inflammation of the anatomical structures of the outer ear and ear canal secondary to an infectious process. Bacterial etiology is most common, but fungal infection is also possible. Symptoms include erythema, edema, and pain.

diseases.name: Ostertagiasis
diseases.definition: A disease of herbivorous mammals, particularly cattle and sheep, caused by stomach worms of the genus ostertagia.

diseases.name: Osteosclerotic plasma cell myeloma
diseases.group: immune system disorder|hematologic disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A plasma cell neoplasm associated with osteosclerotic and fibrotic changes in the bone trabeculae. Often, the lymph nodes show changes resembling the plasma cell variant of Castleman disease. It is often part of POEMS syndrome which is characterized by polyneuropathy, organomegaly, endocrinopathy, monoclonal gammopathy, and skin changes.

diseases.name: Osteosclerotic chondrodysplasia, lethal, with intracellular inclusions
synonyms: osteosclerotic chondrodysplasia, lethal, with intracellular inclusions

diseases.name: Osteosclerosis-ichthyosis-premature ovarian failure syndrome
synonyms: sclerosing dysplasia of bone-ichthyosis-premature ovarian failure syndrome
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder
diseases.definition: This syndrome is characterized by sclerosing bone dysplasia, ichthyosis vulgaris and premature ovarian failure. The bone disorder affects all metaphyseal-diaphyseal regions of the long bones, the skull, and the metacarpals.

diseases.name: Osteosclerosis-developmental delay-craniosynostosis syndrome
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: This newly described syndrome is characterized by osteosclerosis, developmental delay and craniosynostosis.

diseases.name: Osteosarcoma arising in bone paget disease
synonyms: osteosarcoma arising in osseous Paget's disease
osteosarcoma arising in bone Paget's disease
osteosarcoma arising in bone Paget disease
osteosarcoma arising in Paget's disease of bone
osteosarcoma arising in Paget disease of bone
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A sarcomatous transformation of pre-existing Paget disease of the bone. Osteosarcomas arising from Paget disease of the bone are high grade lesions and usually have a poor prognosis.

diseases.name: Osteoporosis-pseudoglioma syndrome
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|cardiovascular disorder|nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Osteoporosis pseudoglioma syndrome is a very rare autosomal recessive disorder characterized by congenital or infancy-onset blindness and severe juvenile-onset osteoporosis and spontaneous fractures.

diseases.name: Osteoporosis-oculocutaneous hypopigmentation syndrome
diseases.definition: Osteoporosis-oculocutaneous hypopigmentation syndrome is characterized by osteoporosis and congenital oculocutaneous hypopigmentation. Three cases have been described in the literature. The mode of inheritance appears to be autosomal recessive.

diseases.name: Osteoporosis-macrocephaly-blindness-joint hyperlaxity syndrome
diseases.definition: Osteoporosis-macrocephaly-blindness-joint hyperlaxity syndrome is characterized by osteoporosis, macrocephalus, brachytelephalangy, and hyperextensibility of the joints. Congenital amaurosis and intellectual deficit have also been reported. This syndrome has been described in three members of one family.

diseases.name: Osteoporosis, childhood- or juvenile-onset, with developmental delay
Osteoporosis
synonyms: bone mineral density variation QTL, osteoporosis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A condition of reduced bone mass, with decreased cortical thickness and a decrease in the number and size of the trabeculae of cancellous bone (but normal chemical composition), resulting in increased fracture incidence. Osteoporosis is classified as primary (Type 1, postmenopausal osteoporosis; Type 2, age-associated osteoporosis; and idiopathic, which can affect juveniles, premenopausal women...

diseases.name: Osteopetrosis, autosomal recessive 9
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of visual system

diseases.name: Osteopetrosis
diseases.definition: Osteopetrosis, also known as marble bone disease, is a descriptive term that refers to a group of rare, heritable disorders of the skeleton characterized by increased bone density on radiographs.

diseases.name: Osteopenia-myopia-hearing loss-intellectual disability-facial dysmorphism syndrome
diseases.definition: Osteopenia-myopia-hearing loss-intellectual disability-facial dysmorphism syndrome is characterized by severe hypertelorism, brachycephaly, abnormal ears, sloping shoulders, enamel hypoplasia, osteopaenia with frequent fractures, severe myopia, mild to moderate sensorineural hearing loss and mild intellectual deficit. It has been described in two brothers born to first-cousin parents. No chromo...

diseases.name: Osteopenia-intellectual disability-sparse hair syndrome
diseases.definition: Kaler-Garrity-Stern syndrome is a rare syndrome, described in two sisters of Mennonite descent, characterized by sparse hair, osteopenia, intellectual disability, minor facial abnormalities, joint laxity and hypotonia. There have been no further descriptions in the literature since 1992.

diseases.name: Osteopathia striata-pigmentary dermopathy-white forelock syndrome
diseases.definition: Osteopathia striata-pigmentary dermopathy-white forelock syndrome is characterized by the association of osteopathia striata (longitudinal striations through most of the long bones) with a macular, hyperpigmented dermopathy and a white forelock.

diseases.name: Osteopathia striata with cranial sclerosis
synonyms: Osteopathia striata with cranial sclerosis, X-linked dominant
diseases.definition: Osteopathia striata with cranial sclerosis (OS-CS) is a bone dysplasia characterized by longitudinal striations of the metaphyses of the long bones, sclerosis of the craniofacial bones, macrocephaly, cleft palate and hearing loss.

diseases.name: Osteonecrosis of the jaw
diseases.definition: An area of necrotic bone in the mandible or maxilla.

diseases.name: Osteomesopyknosis
diseases.definition: Osteomesopyknosis is a very rare benign bone disorder characterized by bone dysplasia manifested by patchy sclerosis of the axial skeleton and increased bone mineral content.

diseases.name: Osteomas of mandible
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Osteoid osteoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A small, benign, bone-forming neoplasm that can arise from any bone but more frequently affects the long bones. The central portion of the neoplasm (nidus) contains differentiated osteoblasts which produce osteoid and sometimes bone. The lesion is usually surrounded by hypervascular sclerotic bone and has limited growth potential. Clinical signs and symptoms include pain and localized tendernes...

diseases.name: Osteoglophonic dysplasia
diseases.definition: A rare skeletal disorder characterized by dwarfism, severe craniofacial abnormalities and multiple unerupted teeth.

diseases.name: Osteogenesis imperfecta-retinopathy-seizures-intellectual disability syndrome
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Osteogenesis imperfecta-retinopathy-seizures-intellectual disability syndrome is characterized by osteogenesis imperfecta, wormian bones, optic atrophy, retinopathy, seizures and severe developmental delay. It has been described in two sibs born to consanguineous parents.

diseases.definition: Osteogenesis imperfecta type XVIII (OI18) is characterized by congenital bowing of the long bones, wormian bones, blue sclerae, vertebral collapse, and multiple fractures in the first years of life ({1:Doyard et al., 2018}).

synonyms: osteogenesis imperfecta caused by mutation in IFITM5
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Osteogenesis imperfecta type V is a moderate type of osteogenesis imperfecta (OI), a genetic disorder characterized by increased bone fragility, low bone mass and susceptibility to bone fractures with variable severity. OI type V is characterized by mild to moderate short stature, dislocation of the radial head, mineralized interosseous membranes, hyperplasic callus, white sclera and no dentino...

diseases.name: Osteogenesis imperfecta type 4
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Osteogenesis imperfecta type IV is a moderate type of osteogenesis imperfecta (OI), a genetic disorder characterized by increased bone fragility, low bone mass and susceptibility to bone fractures. Patients with type IV have moderately short stature, mild to moderate scoliosis, grayish or white sclera, and dentinogenesis imperfecta (DI).

diseases.name: Osteogenesis imperfecta type 3
synonyms: progressively deforming osteogenesis imperfecta with normal sclera
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Osteogenesis imperfecta type III is a severe type of osteogenesis imperfecta (OI), a genetic disorder characterized by increased bone fragility, low bone mass and susceptibility to bone fractures. The main signs of type III include very short stature, a triangular face, severe scoliosis, grayish sclera, and dentinogenesis imperfecta (DI).

diseases.name: Osteogenesis imperfecta type 2
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Osteogenesis imperfecta type II is a lethal type of osteogenesis imperfecta (OI), a genetic disorder characterized by increased bone fragility, low bone mass and susceptibility to bone fractures. Patients with type II present multiple rib and long bone fractures at birth, marked deformities, broad long bones, low density on skull X-rays, and dark sclera.

synonyms: osteogenesis imperfecta caused by mutation in SPARC
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: An osteogenesis imperfecta that has material basis in contiguous gene deletion on chromosome 11p11.

diseases.definition: Osteogenesis imperfecta type I is a mild type of osteogenesis imperfecta (OI), a genetic disorder characterized by increased bone fragility, low bone mass and susceptibility to bone fractures.

diseases.name: Osteogenesis imperfecta and a reduction of bone mineral density.
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A skeletal dysplasia characterized by osteogenesis imperfecta and decreased bone density.

diseases.name: Osteogenesis imperfecta
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Osteogenesis imperfecta (OI) comprises a heterogeneous group of genetic disorders characterized by increased bone fragility, low bone mass, and susceptibility to bone fractures with variable severity.

diseases.name: Osteofibrous dysplasia
synonyms: tibia, bowing of, with pseudarthrosis and pectus excavatum
diseases.definition: A benign, usually self-limited fibro-osseous lesion of the bone that affects infants and children. It usually arises from the cortical bone of the anterior mid-shaft of the tibia. Patients usually present with swelling or painless bowing of the tibia. Progression to adamantinoma has been reported in some cases.

diseases.name: Osteodysplasty, precocious, of danks, mayne, and kozlowski
synonyms: osteodysplasty, precocious, of Danks, Mayne, and Kozlowski

diseases.name: Osteocraniostenosis
diseases.definition: A lethal skeletal dysplasia characterized by a cloverleaf skull anomaly, facial dysmorphism, limb shortness, splenic hypo/aplasia and radiological anomalies including thin tubular bones with flared metaphyses and deficient calvarial mineralization.

diseases.name: Osteochondrodysplatic nanism-deafness-retinitis pigmentosa syndrome
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Osteochondrodysplatic nanism-deafness-retinitis pigmentosa syndrome is characterized by severe dwarfism, progressive scoliosis and bilateral dislocation of the hip, associated with sensorineural deafness and retinitis pigmentosa. Radiographs show diffuse osteoporosis, severe bone-age delay and dysplasia of the femoral head. It has been described in two patients. Transmission is autosomal domina...

diseases.name: Osteochondrodysplasia, rhizomelic, with callosal agenesis, thrombocytopenia, hydrocephalus, and hypertension
synonyms: osteochondrodysplasia, rhizomelic, with callosal agenesis, thrombocytopenia, hydrocephalus, and hypertension

diseases.name: Osteochondrodysplasia, brachydactyly, and overlapping malformed digits
Osteochondritis of tarsal/metatarsal bone
synonyms: aseptic necrosis of the tarsal bone
diseases.definition: A rare bone disease characterized by avascular necrosis of the navicular bone in children. Patients present with sudden unexplained foot pain, inability to bear weight, and limping. Radiographic features include flattening, fragmentation, and patchy sclerosis of the navicular bone. Soft tissue swelling may be associated. The condition is most commonly unilateral and self-limiting. Boys are more...

diseases.name: Osteochondritis dissecans
diseases.definition: A rare bone disease characterized by an acquired idiopathic necrotic lesion of subchondral bone with the formation of a sequestrum, which may detach to form loose bodies in joints. OCD mainly affects the knee, ankle and elbow joints and can lead to pain, functional limitations and secondary osteoarthritis.

diseases.name: Osteoblastoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare benign bone-forming neoplasm usually arising from the spine. It is a well-circumscribed lytic tumor that varies in size. The tumor is composed of woven bone trabeculae and shares similar histologic characteristics with the osteoid osteoma. Surgical curettage is the treatment of choice. The prognosis is excellent.

diseases.name: Osteoblastic osteosarcoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A conventional osteosarcoma characterized by the predominance of osteoid matrix.

diseases.name: Osteoarthritis, toe
diseases.definition: Osteoarthritis of the foot generally affects the joint at the base of your big toe. It can cause your toe to: - become stiff over time, which can make it difficult and painful to walk – this is called hallux rigidus - become bent, which can lead to painful bunions (bony lumps at the base of your big toe) – this is called hallux valgus. Osteoarthritis of the mid-foot is also quite common, especi...

diseases.name: Osteoarthritis, spine
diseases.definition: A degenerative joint disease involving the spine. It is characterized by progressive deterioration of the spinal articular cartilage (cartilage, articular), usually with hardening of the subchondral bone and outgrowth of bone spurs (osteophyte).

diseases.name: Osteoarthritis, knee
diseases.definition: Noninflammatory degenerative disease of the knee joint consisting of three large categories: conditions that block normal synchronous movement, conditions that produce abnormal pathways of motion, and conditions that cause stress concentration resulting in changes to articular cartilage. (Crenshaw, Campbell's Operative Orthopaedics, 8th ed, p2019)

diseases.name: Osteoarthritis, hip
diseases.definition: Noninflammatory degenerative disease of the hip joint which usually appears in late middle or old age. It is characterized by growth or maturational disturbances in the femoral neck and head, as well as acetabular dysplasia. A dominant symptom is pain on weight-bearing or motion.

diseases.name: Osteoarthritis, hand
diseases.definition: Osteoarthritis of the hands usually happens as part of nodal osteoarthritis (a form of osteoarthritis that runs in families). This mainly affects women and often starts in your 40s or 50s, around the menopause (the time when menstruation ends and it’s no longer possible to have children).

diseases.name: Osteitis fibrosa
diseases.definition: A disorder that is characterized by bone cysts and fractures, resulting from hyperparathyroidism.

diseases.name: Ossifying fibromyxoid tumor
diseases.definition: A rare soft tissue tumor of uncertain lineage characterized by the presence of neoplastic spindle to round cells forming cords in a fibromyxoid stroma. The lesions are associated with the formation of metaplastic bone. Most patients present with painless subcutaneous masses. Recurrences have been reported in a minority of patients.

diseases.name: Ossification of the posterior longitudinal ligament of the spine
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder
diseases.definition: A disorder characterized by benign depositions of calcium in the posterior longitudinal ligament. Signs and symptoms result from the compression of nerve roots and include motor and sensory disturbances in the lower and upper extremities, and pain in the neck and arms.

diseases.name: Ossification anomalies-psychomotor developmental delay syndrome
diseases.definition: Ossification anomalies-psychomotor developmental delay syndrome is characterized by hypomineralisation of the cranial bones, thoracic dystrophy, hypotonia, and abnormal and slender long bones due to an alteration in remodeling during ossification.

diseases.name: Osmotic diarrheal disease
diseases.definition: A diarrhea that results from the presence of osmotically active, poorly absorbed solutes in the bowel lumen that inhibit normal water and electrolyte absorption.

diseases.name: Orthostatic hypotension 1
synonyms: orthostatic hypotension 1, due to DBH deficiency
diseases.definition: A very rare primary monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis disorder with norepinephrine and adrenaline deficiency that leads to young-onset severe orthostatic hypotension and eyelid ptosis.

diseases.name: Orthostatic hypotension
diseases.definition: Sudden fall of the blood pressure of at least 20/10 mm Hg when a person stands up.

diseases.name: Orotic aciduria
diseases.definition: An extremely rare autosomal recessive inherited disorder caused by mutations in the UMPS gene. It is characterized by deficiency of the activity of the pyrimidine pathway enzyme uridine 5'-monophosphate (UMP) synthase. Clinical manifestations include growth retardation, anemia, and increased excretion of orotic acid in the urine.

diseases.name: Oropharynx squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|respiratory system disorder|otorhinolaryngologic disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that involves the oropharynx.

diseases.name: Oropharyngeal anthrax
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|respiratory system disorder|infectious disease|otorhinolaryngologic disease
diseases.definition: A anthrax infection that involves the oropharynx.

diseases.name: Oromandibular dystonia
diseases.definition: Oromandibular dystonia (OMD) is a form of focal dystonia, affecting the lower part of the face and jaws. It is characterized by sustained or repetitive involuntary jaw and tongue movements and facial grimacing caused by involuntary spasms of the masticatory, facial, pharyngeal, lingual, and lip muscles.

diseases.name: Orofaciodigital syndrome type ii
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Oral-facial-digital (OFD) type 2 is characterized by hand and feet deformities, facial deformities, midline cleft of the upper lip and tongue hamartomas.

diseases.definition: Orofaciodigital syndrome type 11 is an extremely rare, sporadic form of Orofaciodigital syndrome (OFDS) with only a few reported cases, and characterized by facial (blepharophimosis, bulbous nasal tip, broad nasal bridge, downslanting palpebral fissures and low set ears) and skeletal (post-axial polydactyly and fusion of vertebrae) malformations along with severe intellectual disability, deafne...

diseases.definition: Oral-facial-digital syndrome, type 8 is characterized by tongue lobulation, hypoplasia of the epiglottis, median cleft upper lip, broad or bifid nasal tip, hypertelorism or telecanthus, bilateral preaxial and postaxial polydactyly, abnormal tibiae and/or radii, duplication of the halluces, short stature, and mild intellectual deficit.

diseases.definition: Oral-facial-digital syndrome, type 5 is characterized by median cleft of the upper lip, postaxial polydactyly of hands and feet, and oral manifestations (duplicated frenulum).

diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|respiratory system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Oral-facial-digital syndrome, type 4 is characterized by lingual hamartoma, postaxial polysyndactyly of hands and feet, and mesomelic shortening of the legs with supinate equinovarus feet.

diseases.name: Orofaciodigital syndrome i
diseases.definition: A rare neurodevelopmental disorder in the ciliopathy group that is lethal in males and characterized by variable anomalies including external malformations (craniofacial and digital), and possible involvement of the central nervous system (CNS) and of viscera (kidneys, pancreas and ovaries) in females.

diseases.name: Orofacial cleft 1
diseases.definition: Cleft lip with or without cleft palate mapped to chromosome 6p24.

diseases.name: Ornithosis
diseases.definition: Disease caused by the Chlamydophila psittaci bacteria, usually transmitted from birds to humans.

diseases.name: Ornithine translocase deficiency
diseases.definition: A rare, genetic disorder of urea cycle metabolism characterized by either a neonatal-onset with manifestations of lethargy, poor feeding, vomiting and tachypnea or, more commonly, presentations in infancy, childhood or adulthood with chronic neurocognitive deficits, acute encephalopathy and/or coagulation defects or other chronic liver dysfunction.

diseases.name: Ornithine carbamoyltransferase deficiency
diseases.definition: Ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency (OTCD) is a disorder of urea cycle metabolism and ammonia detoxification characterized by either a severe, neonatal-onset disease found almost exclusively in males, or later-onset (partial) forms of the disease. Both present with episodes of hyperammonemia that can be fatal and which can lead to neurological complications.

diseases.name: Ornithine aminotransferase deficiency
synonyms: hyperornithinemia-gyrate atrophy of choroid and retina syndrome
gyrate atrophy of the choroid and/or retina
gyrate atrophy of choroid and retina with or without ornithinemia
diseases.group: hereditary disease|cardiovascular disorder|metabolic disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: A very rare inherited retinal dystrophy characterized by progressive chorioretinal atrophy, myopia and early cataract.

diseases.name: Orgasm-induced seizures
diseases.definition: Orgasm-induced seizures is a rare neurologic disease characterized by complex partial seizures with or without secondary generalization, or idiopathic primarily generalized epilepsy, triggered by sexual orgasm. Seizures usually start immediately, shortly after or a few hours after the achievement of orgasm, last a few seconds or minutes, and are followed, in very rare cases, by intense migraine.

diseases.name: Organophosphate-induced delayed polyneuropathy
diseases.definition: An inflammatory and toxic neuropathy that is characaterized by a collection of neuropsychological symptoms associated with repeated organophosphate pesticide exposure as well as nerve agent exposure. Symptoms can appear weeks after exposure and include muscle weakness, anxiety, depression, psychosis as well as cognitive and memory deficits.

diseases.name: Organophosphate poisoning
diseases.definition: A poisoning that is caused by exposure to organophosphate.

diseases.name: Orchitis
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Inflammation of one or both testes due to viral or bacterial infections. Signs and symptoms include enlargement or tenderness of the affected testis, inguinal lymphadenopathy, blood in the semen, and pain during urination, intercourse, or ejaculation.

diseases.name: Orbital pseudotumor
diseases.definition: A nonspecific tumor-like inflammatory lesion in the orbit of the eye. It is usually composed of mature lymphocytes; plasma cells; macrophages; leukocytes with varying degrees of fibrosis. Orbital pseudotumors are often associated with inflammation of the extraocular muscles (orbital myositis) or inflammation of the lacrimal glands (dacryoadenitis).

diseases.name: Orbital periostitis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|inflammatory disease

diseases.name: Orbital myositis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|inflammatory disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: A rare form of myositis that affects only the orbital muscles.

diseases.name: Orbital leiomyoma
diseases.group: disorder of visual system|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Orbital leiomyoma is a rare benign smooth muscle tumor arising from the walls of orbital vessels characterized by its slow growth and well encapsulated nature. It is usually located in an extraconal position, commonly manifesting with painless proptosis. The tumor is composed of spindle cells arranged in a fibrous stroma rich in dilated sinusoidal capillaries. The nuclei of tumor cells are oval...

diseases.name: Orbital granuloma
diseases.definition: A granuloma located on the orbit of the eye.

diseases.name: Orbital dermoid cyst
diseases.group: disorder of development or morphogenesis|otorhinolaryngologic disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign congenital tumor that affects the orbit. It is one of the most common orbital tumors. It is characterized by the presence of a cystic structure that is lined by keratinizing epithelium and contains adnexal structures. Complete surgical excision is curative.

diseases.name: Orbital cellulitis
diseases.definition: Inflammation of the eye tissues posterior to the orbital septum, and generally secondary to an infection spread from adjacent sinuses. Signs and symptoms of the affected eye include sudden loss of vision, erythema, edema, decreased eye movement, and pain. Treatment is conducted via intravenous antibiotics, observation, and surgical intervention when necessary.

diseases.name: Orbital cancer
synonyms: malignant neoplasm of orbit of skull
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the orbit.

diseases.name: Orbit lymphoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A lymphoma that arises from the structures of the orbit. Representative examples include mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, and diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

diseases.name: Orbit embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the orbit. It is characterized by the presence of skeletal muscle tissue exhibiting embryonic features.

diseases.name: Orbit alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that arises in the orbit. It is characterized by the presence of round cells with myoblastic differentiation and a fibrovascular stroma.

diseases.name: Oral tuberculosis
diseases.definition: Tuberculosis of the mouth, tongue, and salivary glands.

diseases.name: Oral submucous fibrosis
synonyms: oral submucosal fibrosis, including of tongue
diseases.definition: Oral submucous fibrosis (OSMF) is a chronic, progressive disease that alters the fibroelasticity of the oral submucosa, prevalent in India and Southeast Asia but rare elsewhere, and characterized by burning and pain in the oral cavity, loss of gustatory sensation, the presence of blanched fibrous bands and stiffening of the oral mucosa and oro-pharynx (leading to trismus and a progressive reduc...

diseases.name: Oral rhabdomyosarcoma
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rhabdomyosarcoma located in the oral cavity.

diseases.name: Oral leukoedema
diseases.definition: A disorder of the buccal mucosa resembling early leukoplakia, characterized by the presence of filmy opalescence of the mucosa in the early stages to a whitish gray cast with a coarsely wrinkled surface in the later stages, associated with intracellular edema of the spinous or malpighian layer. (Dorland, 27th ed)

diseases.name: Oral hairy leukoplakia
synonyms: hairy leukoplakia of the oral mucosa
diseases.definition: An epithelial hyperplasia of the oral cavity mucosa associated with Epstein-Barr virus and found almost exclusively in persons with HIV infection. The lesion consists of a white patch that is often corrugated or hairy.

diseases.name: Oral fibroma
diseases.group: connective tissue disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A non-metastasizing oral neoplasm arising from fibrous tissue characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts.

diseases.name: Oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma
synonyms: squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity
squamous cell carcinoma of the mouth
squamous cell carcinoma of oral cavity
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|otorhinolaryngologic disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma arising from the oral cavity. It affects predominantly adults in their fifth and sixth decades of life and is associated with alcohol and tobacco use. Human papillomavirus is present in approximately half of the cases. It is characterized by a tendency to metastasize early to the lymph nodes. When the tumor is small, patients are often asymptomatic. Physical examinatio...

diseases.name: Oral candidiasis
diseases.definition: Infection of the mucosal lining of the mouth with the fungus Candida albicans.

diseases.name: Oral crohn disease
diseases.group: hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|immune system disorder
diseases.definition: Crohn's disease affecting the mouth.

diseases.name: Optic perineuritis
diseases.definition: A rare ophthalmic disorder characterized by idiopathic orbital inflammation in which the specific target tissue is the optic nerve sheath. Patients typically present with ocular pain, pain on eye movement, visual symptoms with loss of vision progressing over several weeks, dyschromatopsia, and variable visual field defects. Orbital signs and symptoms may be present and include ptosis, ophthalmo...

diseases.name: Optic pathway glioma
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Optic pathway glioma (OPG) is a benign tumor that develop along the optic nerve (chiasm, tracts, and radiations) characterized by impairment or loss of vision and may be accompanied by diencephalic symptoms such as reduced growth and alteration in sleeping patterns. OPG are often linked to neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1).

diseases.name: Optic papillitis
synonyms: papilledema associated with increased intracranial pressure
papilledema associated with decreased intraocular pressure
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|inflammatory disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Swelling of the optic disk, usually in association with increased intracranial pressure, characterized by hyperemia, blurring of the disk margins, microhemorrhages, blind spot enlargement, and engorgement of retinal veins. Chronic papilledema may cause optic atrophy and visual loss. (Miller et al., Clinical Neuro-Ophthalmology, 4th ed, p175)

diseases.name: Optic nerve sheath meningioma
synonyms: meningioma of the optic nerve sheath
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A meningioma that affects the sheath of the optic nerve.

diseases.name: Optic nerve astrocytoma
synonyms: astrocytoma (excluding glioblastoma) of cranial nerve II
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A astrocytoma (excluding glioblastoma) that involves the cranial nerve II.

diseases.name: Optic disk drusen
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Optic disk bodies composed primarily of acid mucopolysaccharides that may produce pseudopapilledema (elevation of the optic disk without associated intracranial hypertension) and visual field deficits. Drusen may also occur in the retina (see retinal drusen). (Miller et al., Clinical Neuro-Ophthalmology, 4th ed, p355)

diseases.definition: A rare form of hereditary optic atrophy, seen in only 4 families to date, with an onset in early childhood, characterized by progressive loss of visual acuity, significant optic nerve pallor and occasionally additional neurological manifestations, with females being unaffected.
