diseases.name: Optic atrophy 10 with or without ataxia, intellectual disability, and seizures
synonyms: optic atrophy 10 with or without ataxia, mental retardation, and seizures
RTN4IP1-related optic atrophy with or without neurological features
RTN4IP1-optic atrophy 10 with or without ataxia, impaired intellectual development and seizures
diseases.group: hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: An optic atrophy caused by a variation in the RTN4IP1; the optic atrophy can be associated with neurological involvement, including intellectual disability, ataxia, seizures.

diseases.name: Optic atrophy
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: A disorder characterized by loss of optic nerve fibers. It may be inherited or acquired. Acquired causes include ischemia, optic nerve neuropathy, glaucoma, trauma, radiation, brain tumors, and multiple sclerosis. It leads to vision disturbances.

diseases.name: Opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome
diseases.group: syndromic disease|nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Opsoclonus myoclonus syndrome (OMS) is a rare neuroinflammatory disease of paraneoplastic, parainfectious or idiopathic origin, characterized by opsoclonus, myoclonus, ataxia, and behavioral and sleep disorders.

diseases.name: Opsismodysplasia
diseases.definition: Opsismodysplasia is a skeletal dysplasia characterized by congenital dwarfism and facial dysmorphism.

diseases.name: Oppositional defiant disorder
diseases.definition: A behavior disorder characterized by a persistent pattern of defiant, disobedient, and hostile behavior towards authority figures, manifested by a frequent loss of temper, arguing, becoming angry or vindictive, or other negativistic behaviors.

diseases.name: Opisthorchiasis
diseases.definition: Infection with flukes of the genus Opisthorchis.

diseases.name: Opioid-induced constipation
diseases.definition: A constipation disorder caused by use of opioids. OIC may present immediately when a patient takes the opioid, or it may present gradually during opioid therapy.

diseases.name: Opioid abuse
diseases.definition: A substance abuse that involves the recurring use of opioid drugs despite negative consequences.

diseases.name: Opiate dependence
diseases.definition: Disorders related or resulting from abuse or mis-use of opioids.

diseases.name: Ophthalmoplegic neuromuscular disorder with abnormal mitochondria
synonyms: ophthalmoplegic neuromuscular disorder with abnormal mitochondria

diseases.name: Ophthalmoplegia, familial total, with iris transillumination
synonyms: ophthalmoplegia, familial total, with iris transillumination

diseases.name: Ophthalmoplegia, external, with rib and vertebral anomalies
Ophthalmoplegia totalis with ptosis and miosis
synonyms: ophthalmoplegia totalis with ptosis and miosis

diseases.name: Ophthalmomyiasis
diseases.definition: An myiasis caused by infection with Oestrus ovis.

diseases.name: Ophthalmomandibulomelic dysplasia
diseases.definition: Ophthalmomandibulomelic dysplasia is characterized by complete blindness due to corneal opacities, difficult mastication due to temporomandibular fusion and anomalies of the arms.

diseases.name: Ophthalmic herpes zoster
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|nervous system disorder|infectious disease
diseases.definition: Virus infection of the Gasserian ganglion and its nerve branches characterized by pain and vesicular eruptions with much swelling. Ocular involvement is usually heralded by a vesicle on the tip of the nose. This area is innervated by the nasociliary nerve.

diseases.name: Ophthalmia neonatorum
diseases.group: reproductive system disorder|infectious disease|inflammatory disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Inflammation of the conjunctiva in a newborn due to chemical or infectious causes. Aseptic conjunctivitis is often related to the use of prophylactic medications for infectious conjunctivitis. Septic conjunctivitis is related to perinatal exposure to microorganisms.

diseases.name: Open-angle glaucoma
diseases.definition: Chronic outflow obstruction of the eye's drainage canals that can lead to increased internal eye pressure and optic nerve damage.

diseases.name: Open iniencephaly
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Oocyte maturation defect 2
synonyms: inherited oocyte maturation defect caused by mutation in TUBB8
diseases.definition: Any inherited oocyte maturation defect in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the TUBB8 gene.

diseases.name: Onychomatricoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A neoplasm involving a UBERON:0002283.

diseases.name: Onychogryposis, pedal, with keratosis plantaris and coarse hair
synonyms: onychogryposis, pedal, with keratosis plantaris and coarse hair

diseases.name: Onychodystrophy, osteodystrophy, impaired intellectual development, and seizures syndrome
Onychocytic matricoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Onychocytic matricoma is a rare tumor of the nail that is generally benign. Affected people often experience thickening of the involved portion of the nail. The tumor may be pigmented (melanonychia - a black or brown pigmentation of the normal nail plate) or non-pigmented. The exact underlying cause of onychocytic matricoma is currently unknown. It generally occurs sporadically in people with n...

diseases.name: Oncocytic neoplasm
diseases.definition: A usually benign neoplasm composed of large cells with abundant eosinophilic granular cytoplasm. Representative examples include oncocytic neoplasms of the thyroid gland, and kidney. (NCI05)

diseases.name: Oncocytic breast carcinoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|breast disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A rare breast adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of neoplastic oncocytic cells. The oncocytic cells comprise more than 70 percent of the malignant cellular population.

diseases.name: Onchocerciasis
diseases.definition: Onchocerciasis is a form of filariasis, caused by the parasitic worm Onchocerca volvulus, transmitted by the black fly. The infection can either be asymptomatic or manifest as an ocular disease (river blindness) with itchy eyes, erythema, photophobia, onchodermatitis or onchocercal skin disease (classified into acute papular, chronic papular, lichenified, atrophic, and depigmentated) and onchoc...

diseases.name: Omphalocele-diaphragmatic hernia-cardiovascular anomalies-radial ray defect syndrome
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|cardiovascular disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Omphalocele, diaphragmatic hernia, and radial ray defects
synonyms: omphalocele, diaphragmatic hernia, and radial ray defects

diseases.name: Omphalocele, autosomal
synonyms: omphalocele due to duplication of 1p31.3, isolated cases
diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Omphalocele, x-linked
diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Omphalocele syndrome, shprintzen-goldberg type
diseases.definition: Shprintzen-Goldberg omphalocele syndrome is a very rare inherited malformation syndrome characterized by omphalocele, scoliosis, mild dysmorphic features (downslanted palpebral fissures, s-shaped eyelids and thin upper lip), laryngeal and pharyngeal hypoplasia and learning disabilities.

diseases.name: Omphalocele
diseases.definition: Omphalocele is an embryopathy classified in the group of abdominal celosomias and is characterized by a large hernia of the abdominal wall, centered on the umbilical cord, in which the protruding viscera are protected by a sac.

diseases.name: Omodysplasia
diseases.definition: Omodysplasia is a rare skeletal dysplasia characterized by severe limb shortening and facial dysmorphism. Two types of omodysplasia have been described: an autosomal recessive or generalized form (also referred to as micromelic dysplasia with dislocation of radius) marked by severe micromelic dwarfism with predominantly rhizomelic shortening of both the upper and lower limbs, and an autosomal d...

diseases.name: Olivopontocerebellar atrophy-deafness syndrome
diseases.definition: Olivopontocerebellar atrophy-deafness syndrome is characterized by infancy-onset olivopontocerebellar atrophy, sensorineural deafness and speech impairment. It has been described in less than 15 children. Most cases were sporadic, but autosomal recessive inheritance was suggested in three cases.

diseases.name: Olivopontocerebellar atrophy
diseases.definition: A group of sporadic and inherited neurodegenerative disorders affecting the cerebellum, pons, and inferior olives.

diseases.name: Oligospermia
diseases.definition: Decreased number of spermatozoa in the semen.

diseases.name: Oligomeganephronia
diseases.definition: Oligomeganephronia is a developmental anomaly of the kidneys, and the most severe form of renal hypoplasia, characterized by a reduction of 80% in nephron number and a marked hypertrophy of the glomeruli and tubules.

diseases.name: Oligohydramnios
diseases.definition: A lower than normal quantity of amniotic fluid in the amniotic sac as compared to normal values. Typically associated with an amniotic fluid index (AFI) of less than 5 cm or a single maximum vertical pocket (MVP) of less than 2 cm.

diseases.name: Oligodontia-cancer predisposition syndrome
synonyms: autosomal dominant ectodermal dysplasia-cancer predisposition syndrome

diseases.name: Oligodendroglioma, idh-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted, grade 3
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An IDH-mutant, and 1p/19q-codeleted oligodendroglioma that is characterized as grade 3 tumors associated with a more rapid growth. Grade 3 tumors appear to have abnormalities on chromosomes 9 or 10, along with unusual amounts of growth factors and proteins, which are thought to contribute to the more rapid growth of these gliomas.

diseases.name: Oligodendroglioma, idh-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted grade 2
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An IDH-mutant, and 1p/19q-codeleted oligodendroglioma that is characterized as a well differentiated tumor lacking anaplastic features (brisk mitotic activity, microvascular proliferation, necrosis).

diseases.name: Oligodendroglioma
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A well-differentiated (WHO grade II), diffusely infiltrating neuroglial tumor, typically located in the cerebral hemispheres. It is composed predominantly of cells which morphologically resemble oligodendroglia. The neoplastic cells have rounded homogeneous nuclei and, on paraffin sections, a swollen, clear cytoplasm ('honeycomb' appearance). (Adapted from WHO)

diseases.name: Oligocone trichromacy
diseases.group: hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Oligocone trichromacy is a rare non-progressive form of cone photoreceptor dysfunction characterized by reduced visual acuity, normal retinal appearance, absent or reduced cone responses on electroretinography but normal color vision.

diseases.name: Oligoastrocytoma
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A WHO grade II tumor composed of a conspicuous mixture of two distinct neoplastic cell types morphologically resembling the tumor cells in oligodendroglioma and diffuse astrocytoma. (WHO)

diseases.name: Oligoasthenoteratozoospermia
diseases.definition: A form of male infertility that is characterized by a combination of low number or oligozoospermia, poor motility or asthenozoospermia, and abnormal shape or teratozoospermia of sperms. OAT is the most common cause of male subfertility.

diseases.name: Oligoarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis without anti-nuclear antibodies
synonyms: pauciarticular chronic arthritis without anti-nuclear antibodies
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|inflammatory disease

diseases.name: Oligoarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis with anti-nuclear antibodies
synonyms: pauciarticular chronic arthritis with anti-nuclear antibodies
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|inflammatory disease

diseases.name: Oligoarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Oligoarticular juvenile arthritis is the most common form of juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA), representing nearly 50% of cases.

diseases.name: Olfactory groove meningioma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A meningioma that affects the olfactory sulcus.

diseases.name: Olecranon bursitis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: A bursitis that involves the olecranon.

diseases.name: Oesophagostomiasis
diseases.definition: Infection of the intestinal tract with worms of the genus oesophagostomum. This condition occurs mainly in animals other than humans.

diseases.name: Odontotrichomelic syndrome
synonyms: tetramelic deficiencies, ectodermal dysplasia, deformed ears, and other abnormalities
diseases.definition: Odontotrichomelic syndrome is characterized by malformations of all four extremities, hypoplastic nails, ear anomalies, hypotrichosis, abnormal dentition, hyperhidrosis and nasolacrimal duct obstruction. So far, it has been described in less than 10 patients. Transmission is autosomal recessive.

diseases.name: Odontomicronychial dysplasia
diseases.definition: Odontomicronychial dysplasia is a rare, hereditary ectodermal dysplasia syndrome characterized by involvement of teeth and nails - precocious eruption and shedding of deciduous dentition, precocious eruption of secondary dentition with short, rhomboid roots, and short, thin, slow growing nails.

diseases.name: Odontomatosis-aortae esophagus stenosis syndrome
diseases.definition: Odontoma-dysphagia syndrome is a malformation syndrome, characterized by odontomas (undifferentiated mass of the esophagus) and severe dysphagia.

diseases.name: Odontoma
diseases.definition: A benign, slow growing, and painless hamartomatous tumor occurring in tooth-bearing areas of the jaws. According to the presence or absence of tooth-like structures, it is classified as complex type or compound type. Odontoma of complex type is characterized by the presence of enamel and dentin and the absence of tooth-like structures. It is treated with local excision. If it is incompletely re...

diseases.name: Odontoleukodystrophy
diseases.definition: A leukodystrophy characterized by progressive ataxia beginning during infancy, a pyramidal syndrome and dental agenesis. The syndrome has been described in four children born to consanguineous parents. The mode of transmission is autosomal recessive.

diseases.name: Odontoid hypoplasia
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: An often asymptomatic developmental abnormality of the cervical spine. It is characterized by the hypoplasia of the odontoid which appears as a stubby peg of an odontoid process. Symptoms may develop after minor trauma and include localized neck pain, atlantoaxial instability, and transient or permanent neurologic manifestations.

diseases.name: Odontohypophosphatasia
diseases.group: hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A particular form of hypophosphatasia (HPP) characterized by reduced activity of unfractionated serum alkaline phosphatase, premature exfoliation of primary and/or permanent teeth and/or severe dental caries, in the absence of skeletal system abnormalities. It can inherited via either autosomal dominant or autosomal recessive inheritance.

diseases.name: Odontochondrodysplasia 2 with hearing loss and diabetes
synonyms: ondontochondrodysplasia 2 with hearing loss and diabetes

diseases.name: Odontochondrodysplasia 1
diseases.definition: A very rare syndrome associating chondrodysplasia with dentinogenesis imperfecta.

diseases.name: Odonto-tricho-ungual-digito-palmar syndrome
diseases.definition: Odonto-tricho-ungual-digito-palmar syndrome is characterized by neonatal teeth, trichodystrophy and malformations of the hands and feet. To date, it has been reported in 21 patients and is transmitted as an autosomal dominant trait.

diseases.name: Odonto-onycho-dermal dysplasia
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: A form of ectodermal dysplasia characterized by hyperkeratosis and hyperhidrosis of the palms and soles, atrophic malar patches, hypodontia, conical teeth, onychodysplasia, and dry and sparse hair.

diseases.name: Odonto-onycho dysplasia-alopecia syndrome
diseases.definition: Odonto-onycho dysplasia-alopecia syndrome is a rare, genetic ectodermal dysplasia syndrome characterized by almost total alopecia with only sparse, thin, brittle, slow-growing scalp hair, fair and sparse eyebrows and eyelashes, absent axillary and pubic hair, fragile and brittle fingernails, thick and brittle toenails (both with a subungual corneal layer), hypodontia, microdontia, widely spaced...

diseases.name: Oculotrichodysplasia
diseases.definition: Oculotrichodysplasia is characterized by retinitis pigmentosa, trichodysplasia, dental anomalies, and onychodysplasia. It has been described in two siblings (brother and sister) born to first cousin parents. Transmission appears to be autosomal recessive.

diseases.name: Oculotrichoanal syndrome
diseases.group: hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: oculopharyngodistal myopathy 5
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder

diseases.name: Oculopharyngodistal myopathy 4
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder

diseases.name: Oculopharyngodistal myopathy 3
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder

diseases.name: Oculopharyngodistal myopathy 2
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder

diseases.name: Oculopharyngodistal myopathy 1
synonyms: faciooculolaryngopharyngeal myopathy with distal and respiratory involvement
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder

diseases.name: Oculopharyngodistal myopathy
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder
diseases.definition: Oculopharyngodistal myopathy (OPDM) is a rare, adult-onset hereditary muscle disease. People with OPDM present with progressive eye and throat (pharyngeal) problems and involvement of the muscles of the lower legs and arms. Symptoms may include eyelid drooping (ptosis), swallowing difficulty, hoarse and nasal voice, leg and arm weakness, as well as muscle wasting in the face and in the legs and...

diseases.name: Oculopharyngeal muscular dystrophy 2
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system

diseases.name: Oculopharyngeal muscular dystrophy 1
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system

diseases.name: Oculopharyngeal muscular dystrophy
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Oculopharyngeal muscular dystrophy (OPMD) is an adult-onset progressive myopathy characterized by progressive eyelid ptosis, dysphagia, dysarthria and proximal limb weakness.

diseases.name: Oculootodental syndrome
diseases.definition: Oculootodental syndrome is a contiguous gene syndrome comprising otodental syndrome (characterized by globodontia and sensorineural high-frequency hearing deficit) associated with eye abnormalities including, typically, iris and chorioretinal coloboma, as well as, on occasion, microcornea, microphtalmos, lenticular opacity, lens coloboma and iris pigment epithelial atrophy.

diseases.name: Oculoosteocutaneous syndrome
diseases.definition: A syndrome is characterized by congenital anodontia, a small maxilla, short stature with shortened metacarpals and metatarsals, sparse hair, albinoidism and multiple ocular anomalies. It has been described in three siblings (one brother and two sisters). Transmission is autosomal recessive.

diseases.name: Oculomotor nerve cancer
synonyms: primary malignant neoplasm of oculomotor nerve
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A cancer involving a oculomotor nerve.

diseases.name: Oculomaxillofacial dysostosis
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Oculomaxillofacial dysostosis is a rare, genetic bone developmental disorder characterized by short stature, orbital region and ocular abnormalities (e.g. asymmetric orbits, anophthalmia, down-slanted and S-shaped palpebral fissures, sparse eyebrows/eyelashes, abnormal eyelids, ectropion, symblepharon, corneal leukoma), abnormal nose (e.g. broad and abnormally modeled nasal root, bridge and tip...

diseases.name: Oculogyric crisis
diseases.definition: A focal dystonia that is characterized by a prolonged involuntary upward deviation of the eyes.

diseases.name: Oculoglandular tularemia
diseases.definition: A tularemia that results in inflammation of eye and swelling of lymph glands in front of the ear.

diseases.name: Oculogastrointestinal muscular dystrophy
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Oculogastrointestinal muscular dystrophy is an extremely rare autosomal recessively inherited neuromuscular disease characterized by ocular manifestations such as ptosis and diplopia followed by chronic diarrhea, malnutrion and intestinal peudo-obstruction.

diseases.name: Oculodentodigital dysplasia, autosomal recessive
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Autosomal recessive form of oculodentodigital dysplasia.

diseases.name: Oculodentodigital dysplasia
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Oculodentodigital dysplasia (ODDD) is characterized by craniofacial, neurologic, limb and ocular abnormalities.

diseases.name: Oculodental syndrome, rutherfurd type
diseases.group: syndromic disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Oculodental syndrome, Rutherfurd type is a rare genetic disorder that is primarily characterized by the classical triad of gingival fibromatosis, non-eruption of tooth and corneal dystrophy (bilateral corneal vascularization and opacity). Abnormally shaped teeth have also been reported. The syndrome is transmitted as an autosomal dominant trait.

diseases.name: Oculocutaneous albinism type 7
synonyms: oculocutaneous albinism caused by mutation in LRMDA
diseases.definition: Oculocutaneous albinism type 7 (OCA7), formerly called OCA5, is a form of oculocutaneous albinism (OCA) characterized by skin and hair hypopigmentation, nystagmus and iris transillumination.

diseases.name: Oculocutaneous albinism type 6
diseases.definition: A form of oculocutaneous albinism characterized by light hair at birth that darkens with age, white skin, transparent irides, photophobia, nystagmus, foveal hypoplasia and reduced visual acuity.

diseases.name: Oculocutaneous albinism type 5
diseases.definition: Oculocutaneous albinism type 5 (OCA5) is a type of oculocutaneous albinism found in one Pakistani family to date, characterized by white skin, golden hair, photophobia, nystagmus, foveal hypoplasia and impaired visual acuity, that affects males and females equally, and that has been mapped to a locus on chromosome 4q24 but whose gene has not yet been discovered.

diseases.name: Oculocutaneous albinism type 4
synonyms: oculocutaneous albinism caused by mutation in SLC45A2
diseases.definition: Oculocutaneous albinism type 4 (OCA4) is a type of OCA characterized by varying degrees of skin and hair hypopigmentation, numerous ocular changes and misrouting of the optic nerves at the chiasm.

diseases.name: Oculocutaneous albinism type 3
synonyms: oculocutaneous albinism caused by mutation in TYRP1
diseases.definition: Type 3 oculocutaneous albinism (OCA3) is a form of oculocutaneous albinism (OCA) characterized by rufous or brown albinism and occurring mainly in the African population.

diseases.name: Oculocutaneous albinism type 2
synonyms: albinism, oculocutaneous, type II, modifier of
diseases.definition: Oculocutaneous albinism type 2 (OCA2) is a type of OCA and the most common form of OCA seen in the African population, characterized by variable hypopigmentation of the skin and hair, numerous characteristic ocular changes and misrouting of the optic nerves at the chiasm.

diseases.name: Oculocutaneous albinism type 1b
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Oculocutaneous albinism type 1B (OCA1B) is a type of OCA1 characterized by skin and hair hypopigmentation, nystagmus, reduced iris and retinal pigment and misrouting of the optic nerves.

diseases.name: Oculocutaneous albinism type 1a
synonyms: oculocutaneous albinism caused by mutation in Tyr
oculocutaneous albinism caused by mutation in TYR
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Oculocutaneous albinism type 1A (OCA1A) is the most severe form of OCA, where no melanin is produced, and is characterized by white hair and skin, blue, fully translucent irises, nystagmus and misrouting of the optic nerves.

diseases.name: Oculocutaneous albinism type 1
diseases.definition: Type 1 oculocutaneous albinism (OCA1) describes a group of tyrosine related OCAs that includes OCA1A, OCA1B, type 1 minimal pigment oculocutaneous albinism (OCA1-MP) and type 1 temperature sensitive oculocutaneous albinism (OCA1-TS).

diseases.name: Oculocutaneous albinism
diseases.definition: Oculocutaneous albinism (OCA) describes a group of inherited disorders of melanin biosynthesis characterized by a generalized reduction in pigmentation of hair, skin and eyes and variable ocular findings including nystagmus, reduced visual acuity and photophobia. Variants include OCA1A (the most severe form), OCA1B, OCA1-minimal pigment (OCA1-MP), OCA1-temperature sensitive (OCA1-TS), OCA2, OCA...

diseases.name: Oculocerebrorenal syndrome
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Oculocerebrorenal syndrome of Lowe (OCRL) is a multisystem disorder characterized by congenital cataracts, glaucoma, intellectual disabilities, postnatal growth retardation and renal tubular dysfunction with chronic renal failure.

diseases.name: Oculocerebrofacial syndrome, kaufman type
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Oculocerebrodental syndrome
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Oculocerebrocutaneous syndrome
synonyms: orbital cyst with cerebral and focal dermal malformations
diseases.definition: Oculocerebrocutaneous syndrome (OCCS) is a rare congenital disorder associated with an intellectual disability and is typically characterized by the triad of eye, central nervous system and skin malformations.

diseases.name: Oculocerebral hypopigmentation syndrome, cross type
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Oculocerebral hypopigmentation syndrome, Cross type is a rare congenital syndrome characterized by cutaneous and ocular hypopigmentation, various ocular anomalies (e.g. corneal and lens opacity, spastic ectropium, and/or nystagmus), growth deficiency, intellectual deficit and other progressive neurologic anomalies such as spastic tetraplegia, hyperreflexia, and/or athetoid movements. The clinic...

diseases.name: Oculoauriculovertebral spectrum with radial defects
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Oculoauriculovertebral spectrum (OAVS) with radial defects is a rare branchial arches and limb primordia development disorder characterized by variable degrees of uni- or bilateral craniofacial malformation and radial defects that result in extremely variable phenotypic manifestations. Characteristic features include low postnatal weight, short stature, vertebral defects, hearing loss, and faci...

diseases.name: Oculoauriculofrontonasal syndrome
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Oculoauricular syndrome
diseases.group: syndromic disease|hereditary disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Oculoauricular syndrome, Schorderet type is a rare, genetic developmental defect during embryogenesis characterized by various ophthalmic anomalies (including congenital microphthalmia, microcornea, cataract, anterior segment dysgenesis, ocular coloboma and early onset rod-cone dystrophy), and abnormal external ears (low-set pinna with crumpled helix, narrow intertragic incisure, abnormal bridg...

diseases.name: Oculo-palato-cerebral syndrome
diseases.definition: Oculopalatocerebral syndrome is characterized by the association of four anomalies: intellectual deficit, microcephaly, palate anomalies and ocular abnormalities.

diseases.name: Ocular tuberculosis
diseases.definition: Tuberculous infection of the eye, primarily the iris, ciliary body, and choroid.

diseases.name: Ocular toxoplasmosis
diseases.definition: Ocular toxoplasmosis is an infection in the eye caused by the parasite, Toxoplasm a gondii. Toxoplasmosis is the most common cause of eye inflammation in the world. Toxoplamosis can beacquired or present at birth (congenital), having crossed the placenta from a newly infected mother to her fetus. Most humans acquire toxoplasmosis by eating raw or undercooked meat, vegetables or milk products, o...

diseases.name: Ocular surface squamous neoplasia
diseases.group: disorder of visual system|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Ocular siderosis
diseases.definition: A hemosiderosis that involves the camera-type eye.

diseases.name: Ocular onchocerciasis
synonyms: onchocerciasis of eyeball of camera-type eye
diseases.definition: Onchocerciasis affecting the eye.

diseases.name: Ocular motor apraxia, cogan type
diseases.definition: Ocular motor apraxia, Cogan type is characterized by impairment of voluntary horizontal eye movements and compensatory head thrust. Around 50 cases have been described so far. The oculomotor manifestations tend to improve with age but the syndrome may also be associated with learning and speech difficulties, or, in some cases, cerebral malformations. Both sporadic and familial forms have been d...

diseases.name: Ocular melanoma with extraocular extension
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|disorder of visual system|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A melanoma arising from and extending beyond the structures of the eye.

diseases.name: Ocular hypotension
diseases.definition: Abnormally low intraocular pressure often related to chronic inflammation (uveitis).

diseases.name: Ocular hypertension
diseases.definition: Abnormally high intraocular pressure.

diseases.name: Ocular dysgenesis caused by defects in pax6 regulation
diseases.definition: Any eye disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variant in the PAX6 gene itself or a variant within another locus that results in defective regulation of the PAX6 gene.

diseases.name: Ocular cystinosis
diseases.group: hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Ocular cystinosis is the benign, adult form of cystinosis, a metabolic disease characterized by an accumulation of cystine crystals in the cornea and conjunctiva responsible for tearing and photophobia and associated with no other additional manifestations.

diseases.name: Ocular cicatricial pemphigoid
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|immune system disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Ocular cicatricial pemphigoid (OCP) is a form of mucous membrane pemphigoid (a group of rare, chronic autoimmune disorders) that affects the eyes. In the early stages, people with OCPgenerally experience chronic or relapsing conjunctivitis that is often characterized by tearing, irritation, burning, and/or mucus drainage. If left untreated, OCP can progress to severe conjunctiva scarring and vi...

diseases.name: Ocular albinism with late-onset sensorineural deafness
diseases.group: hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Ocular albinism with late-onset sensorineural deafness (OASD), is a rare, X-linked inherited type of ocular albinism described in one African kindred (7 males over 3 generations) to date, characterized by severe visual impairment, translucent pale-blue iridies, a reduction in the retinal pigment and moderately severe deafness by middle age (fourth to fifth decade of life). It is unclear whether...

diseases.name: Ocular albinism
diseases.group: hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Albinism affecting the eye in which pigment of the hair and skin is normal or only slightly diluted. The classic type is X-linked (Nettleship-Falls), but an autosomal recessive form also exists. Ocular abnormalities may include reduced pigmentation of the iris, nystagmus, photophobia, strabismus, and decreased visual acuity.

diseases.name: Ocular adnexal lymphoma
diseases.definition: A non-Hodgkin lymphoma arising from the conjunctiva, lacrimal gland, lacrimal drainage apparatus, eyelids, or other orbital tissues around the eye. The vast majority of cases are extranodal marginal zone lymphomas of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue, however, other histologic types of lymphomas can originate from ocular adnexal tissues, including rare cases of NK/T-cell lymphomas of nasal type.

diseases.name: Occupational dermatitis
diseases.definition: Contact dermatitis associated with allergens or irritants found in the workplace.

diseases.name: Occupational asthma
diseases.definition: Asthma attacks caused, triggered, or exacerbated by OCCUPATIONAL EXPOSURE.

diseases.name: Occupation-related stress disorder
diseases.definition: The response people may have when presented with work demands and pressures that are not matched to their knowledge and abilities and which challenge their ability to cope.

diseases.name: Occult small cell lung carcinoma
synonyms: occult small cell carcinoma of the lung
occult small cell carcinoma of lung
diseases.group: respiratory system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A small cell lung carcinoma detectable by sputum cytology only. The primary tumor is undetectable radiographically or during bronchoscopy; therefore, it can not be assessed.

diseases.name: Occult macular dystrophy
diseases.group: hereditary disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system
diseases.definition: Occult macular dystrophy is a rare, genetic retinal dystrophy disease characterized by bilateral progressive decline of visual acuity, due to retinal dysfunction confined only to the macula, associated with normal fundus and fluorescein angiograms and severely attenuated focal macular and multifocal electroretinograms.

diseases.name: Occlusion of tributary of retinal vein
synonyms: venous tributary branch occlusion of retina
diseases.group: cardiovascular disorder|nervous system disorder|disorder of visual system

diseases.name: Occlusion of gallbladder
diseases.definition: Blockage of the normal flow of the contents of the gallbladder.

diseases.name: Occipital lobe neoplasm
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A neoplasm involving a occipital lobe.

diseases.name: Occipital horn syndrome
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|metabolic disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Occipital horn syndrome (OHS) is a mild form of Menkes disease (MD), a syndrome characterized by progressive neurodegeneration and connective tissue disorders due to a copper transport defect.

diseases.name: Occipital encephalocele
diseases.group: nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Obstructive sleep apnea syndrome
diseases.definition: Cessation of air flow during sleep due to upper airway obstruction.

diseases.name: Obstructive nephropathy
diseases.definition: Renal damage and impaired renal function secondary to urinary tract obstruction.

diseases.name: Obstructive jaundice
diseases.definition: A finding indicating increased bilirubin levels in the blood and urine, due to intrahepatic or extrahepatic obstruction of the biliary system.

diseases.name: Obstructive hydrocephalus
diseases.definition: An abnormal accumulation of cerebrospinal fluid within the ventricles of the brain that occurs as a consequence of an obstruction at any location within the ventricular system that prevents cerebrospinal fluid flowing into the subarachnoid space.

diseases.name: Obsessive-compulsive personality disorder
diseases.definition: A disorder characterized by an enduring pattern of inflexibility, extreme orderliness, and perfectionism which interfere with efficiency and which may manifest in many different contexts, including work and leisure activities, financial matters, and issues of morality or ethics.

diseases.name: Obsessive-compulsive disorder
diseases.definition: A disorder characterized by the presence of persistent and recurrent irrational thoughts (obsessions), resulting in marked anxiety and repetitive excessive behaviors (compulsions) as a way to try to decrease that anxiety.

diseases.name: Obesity-hypoventilation syndrome
diseases.definition: Hypoventilation syndrome in very obese persons with excessive adipose tissue around the abdomen and diaphragm is characterized by diminished to absent ventilatory chemoresponsiveness; chronic hypoxia; hypercapnia; polycythemia; and long periods of sleep during day and night (hypersomnolence). It is a condition often related to obstructive sleep apnea but can occur separately.

diseases.name: Obesity-colitis-hypothyroidism-cardiac hypertrophy-developmental delay syndrome
diseases.definition: Obesity-colitis-hypothyroidism-cardiac hypertrophy-developmental delay syndrome is characterized by precocious obesity, congenital hypothyroidism, neonatal colitis, cardiac hypertrophy, craniosynostosis and developmental delay. It has been described in two brothers, one of whom died within the first month of life. The parents of the two children were nonconsanguineous and in good health, howeve...

diseases.name: Obesity due to prohormone convertase i deficiency
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|nutritional disorder|endocrine system disorder
diseases.definition: Prohormone convertase-I deficiency is the rarest form of monogenic obesity. The disorder is characterized by severe childhood obesity, hypoadrenalism, reactive hypoglycaemia, and elevated circulating levels of certain prohormones.

diseases.name: Obesity due to pro-opiomelanocortin deficiency
synonyms: obesity, adrenal insufficiency, and red hair due to POMC deficiency
diseases.definition: Pro-opiomelanocortin (POMC) deficiency is a form of monogenic obesity resulting in severe early-onset obesity, adrenal insufficiency, red hair and pale skin.

diseases.name: Obesity due to melanocortin 4 receptor deficiency
diseases.definition: Melanocortin 4 receptor (MC4R) deficiency is the commonest form of monogenic obesity identified so far. MC4R deficiency is characterized by severe obesity, an increase in lean body mass and bone mineral density, increased linear growth in early childhood, hyperphagia beginning in the first year of life and severe hyperinsulinaemia, in the presence of preserved reproductive function.

diseases.name: Obesity due to leptin receptor gene deficiency
synonyms: obesity, morbid, due to leptin receptor deficiency
obesity due to leptin receptor gene deficiency
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|nutritional disorder|endocrine system disorder

diseases.name: Obesity due to congenital leptin deficiency
synonyms: obesity, morbid, due to leptin deficiency
diseases.group: hereditary disease|reproductive system disorder|nutritional disorder|endocrine system disorder
diseases.definition: Congenital leptin deficiency is a form of monogenic obesity characterized by severe early-onset obesity and marked hyperphagia.

diseases.name: Nystagmus 1, congenital, x-linked
synonyms: congenital nystagmus caused by mutation in FRMD7
diseases.definition: Any congenital nystagmus in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the FRMD7 gene.

diseases.name: Nutmeg liver
diseases.group: digestive system disorder|cardiovascular disorder|endocrine system disorder

diseases.name: Nut midline carcinoma
synonyms: nuclear protein in testis midline carcinoma
Midline carcinoma of children and Young adults with NUT rearrangement
diseases.definition: A rare, highly aggressive and lethal carcinoma that affects children and young adults. It arises from midline epithelial structures, most commonly the head, neck, and mediastinum. It is a poorly differentiated carcinoma and is characterized by mutations and rearrangement of the NUT gene. A balanced translocation t(15;19) is present that results in the creation of a fusion gene involving the NUT...

diseases.name: Null syndrome
diseases.definition: The null syndrome is part of the Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease (PMD) spectrum and is characterized by mild PMD features associated with demyelinating peripheral neuropathy.

diseases.name: Null pituitary adenoma
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|reproductive system disorder|nervous system disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Nuclear senile cataract
diseases.definition: A senile cataract that involves the lens nucleus.

diseases.name: Nuclear cataract
diseases.definition: A cataract (disease) that involves the lens nucleus.

diseases.name: Noxacusis
diseases.group: auditory system disorder|nervous system disorder|otorhinolaryngologic disease
diseases.definition: Noxacusis/pain hyperacusis is characterized by individuals who experience otalgia or pain (e.g., dull ache, burning, sharp, stabbing pain and throbbing pain) in response to everyday sounds. This differs clinically from those whose primary symptom is the perception of everyday sounds as excessively loud (termed loudness hyperacusis).

diseases.name: Norovirus infectious disease
diseases.definition: Infections caused by viruses of the genus in the family caliciviridae, which is associated with epidemic gastroenteritis in humans.

diseases.name: Normophosphatemic familial tumoral calcinosis
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|hereditary disease|metabolic disease|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Normal pressure hydrocephalus
diseases.definition: A form of compensated hydrocephalus characterized clinically by a slowly progressive gait disorder (see gait disorders, neurologic), progressive intellectual decline, and urinary incontinence. Spinal fluid pressure tends to be in the high normal range. This condition may result from processes which interfere with the absorption of csf including subarachnoid hemorrhage, chronic meningitis, and o...

diseases.name: Normal breast-like subtype of breast carcinoma
synonyms: normal breast-like subtype of breast carcinoma
normal breast-like subtype of breast cancer
diseases.definition: A biologic subset of breast carcinoma defined by high expression of many genes expressed by adipose and other non-epithelial tissues.

diseases.name: Noonan syndrome 12
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|cardiovascular disorder|immune system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis

diseases.name: Nontoxic goiter
diseases.definition: Sporadic enlargement of the thyroid gland that is not associated with changes in thyroid function or malignancy.

diseases.name: Nonsyndromic genetic hearing loss
diseases.group: auditory system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder
diseases.definition: A disease characterized by hearing loss that is not part of a larger syndrome.

diseases.name: Nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 8
synonyms: inherited isolated nail anomaly caused by mutation in COL7A1
diseases.definition: Any inherited isolated nail anomaly in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the COL7A1 gene.

diseases.name: Nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 7
synonyms: congenital onychodysplasia of the index fingers

diseases.name: Nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 4
synonyms: isolated congenital anonychia caused by mutation in RSPO4
diseases.definition: Any isolated congenital anonychia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the RSPO4 gene.

diseases.name: Nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 3
synonyms: inherited isolated nail anomaly caused by mutation in PLCD1
diseases.definition: Any inherited isolated nail anomaly in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the PLCD1 gene.

diseases.name: Nonsyndromic congenital nail disorder 1
synonyms: inherited isolated nail anomaly caused by mutation in FZD6
diseases.definition: Nail dysplasia is an idiopathic nail dystrophy, beginning in early childhood, and characterized by excessive longitudinal striations and loss of nail luster affecting all 20 nails.

diseases.name: Nonpapillary renal cell carcinoma
synonyms: renal cell carcinoma, clear cell, somatic
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor

diseases.name: Nonobstructive coronary artery disease
diseases.definition: A coronary artery disease that is characterized by atherosclerotic plaque that would not be expected to obstruct blood flow or result in anginal symptoms and stenosis of coronary artery less than 50 percent.

diseases.name: Nonmucinous bronchioloalveolar adenocarcinoma
diseases.group: respiratory system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A bronchiolo-alveolar adenocarcinoma that is characterized by cells with cuboidal or columnar morphology with eosinophilic or clear cytoplasm and shows Clara cell or type 2 pneumocyte differentiation.

diseases.name: Noninvasive malignant thymoma

The symptoms are generally the same with those of immunoglobulin-secreting myeloma; however, the incidence of renal insufficiency is lower in non-secretory myeloma. The diagnosis can be missed because of the absence of ...

diseases.name: Non-psychogenic polydipsia

diseases.name: Non-neoplastic nevus
diseases.definition: A abnormal, congenital formation or mark on the skin or neighboring mucosa that does not show neoplastic growth.

diseases.name: Non-neonatal early infantile epileptic encephalopathy
diseases.definition: Non-neonatal early-onset epileptic encephalopathy is a form an of age-related epileptic encephalopathies, characterized by the onset of seizures later than the first 4 weeks of life but within the first three months. Seizures can be generalized or lateralized, independent of the sleep cycle and can occur multiple times per day, leading to psychomotor impairment and death.

diseases.name: Non-keratinizing sinonasal squamous cell carcinoma
diseases.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma of the sinonasal tract characterized by a plexiform or ribbon-like growth pattern, cytological atypia, and lack of histological evidence of keratinization.

diseases.name: Non-involuting congenital hemangioma
diseases.definition: Non-involuting congenital hemangioma (NICH) is a rare type of infantile hemangioma, which is a tumor that forms from the abnormal growth of blood vessels in the skin. NICH looks like an oval,purplish mark or bump that can occur on any part of the body. NICH is present from birth (congenital) and increases in size as the child grows. Unlike other hemangiomas, NICH do not disappear spontaneously ...

diseases.name: Non-immune hydrops fetalis
diseases.definition: Non-immune hydrops fetalis (NIHF), a form of HF, is a severe fetal condition defined as the excessive accumulation of fetal fluid within the fetal extravascular compartments and body cavities, and is the end-stage of a wide variety of disorders.

diseases.name: Non-hypoproteinemic hypertrophic gastropathy
diseases.definition: Non-hypoproteinemic hypertrophic gastropathy is a rare gastroesophageal disease characterized by diffusely enlarged gastric folds, excessive mucus secretion, normal serum protein and gastric TGF-alpha levels. Patients typically present anemia, abdominal pain not related to eating or bowel habits and absence of peripheral edema.

diseases.name: Non-histaminic angioedema
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|cardiovascular disorder|immune system disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Angioedema is characterized by the occurrence of transitory and recurrent subcutaneous and/or submucosal edemas resulting in swelling and/or abdominal pain.

diseases.name: Non-gestational choriocarcinoma
diseases.definition: A highly malignant choriocarcinoma derived from the non-placental origin such as the totipotent cells in the testis, the ovary, and the pineal gland. It produces high levels of chorionic gonadotropin and can metastasize widely through the bloodstream to the lungs, brain, liver, bone, and other viscera by the time of diagnosis.

diseases.name: Non-distal trisomy 9q
diseases.definition: Non-distal trisomy 9q is a rare chromosomal anomaly syndrome, resulting from the partial trisomy of the long arm of chromosome 9, with a highly variable phenotype principally characterized by developmental delay, short stature, intellectual disability, and craniofacial dysmorphism (e.g. microcephaly, broad forehead, low set ears, epicanthus, prominent nose, and retrognathia). Cardiac, ocular, t...

diseases.definition: Non-distal trisomy 13q is a rare chromosomal anomaly disorder, resulting from the partial duplication of the proximal long arm of chromosome 13, with a highly variable phenotype principally characterized by increased polymorphonuclear leucocyte projections and persistence of fetal hemoglobin, as well as growth and developmental delay and craniofacial dysmorphism (incl. microcephaly, depressed n...

diseases.name: Non-distal trisomy 10q
diseases.definition: Non-distal trisomy 10q is a rare chromosomal anomaly syndrome, resulting from the partial duplication of the long arm of chromosome 10, characterized by mild to moderate developmental delay, postnatal growth retardation, central hypotonia, craniofacial dysmorphism (incl. microcephaly, prominent forehead, flat, thick ear helices, deep-set, small eyes, epicanthus, upturned nose, bow-shaped mouth,...

diseases.definition: Non-distal monosomy 10q is a rare chromosomal anomaly syndrome, resulting from a partial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 10, with a highly variable phenotype principally characterized by developmental delays (usually of language and speech), variable cognitive impairment and neurobehavioral abnormalities such as autism spectrum disorders and attention deficit disorder. Macrocephaly and m...

diseases.name: Non-compaction cardiomyopathy
diseases.definition: Left ventricular non-compaction (LVNC) is characterized by prominent left ventricular trabeculae and deep inter-trabecular recesses. The myocardial wall is often thickened with a thin, compacted epicardial layer and a thickened endocardial layer. In some patients, LVNC is associated with left ventricular dilatation and systolic dysfunction, which can be transient in neonates.

diseases.definition: A milder form of congenital adrenal hyperplasia characterized by decreased activity of an enzyme in the steroidogenic pathway, typically presenting later in life, that does not require life-long cortisol replacement.

Non-amyloid FGP and immunotactoid glomerulopathy (ITG) are oft...

diseases.name: Non-acquired combined pituitary hormone deficiency
diseases.definition: Congenital hypopituitarism is characterized by multiple pituitary hormone deficiency, including somatotroph, thyrotroph, lactotroph, corticotroph or gonadotroph deficiencies, due to mutations of pituitary transcription factors involved in pituitary ontogenesis.

diseases.name: Non-24-hour sleep-wake syndrome
synonyms: circadian rhythm sleep disorder, free-running type
circadian rhythm sleep disorder, free running type
diseases.definition: Non-24-hour sleep-wake disorder (non-24 disorder), also known as hypernychthemeral syndrome, is a circadian rhythm sleep disorder characterized by non-synchronization to a 24-hour day leading to insomnia and daytime sleepiness with sometimes severe associated manifestations.

diseases.name: Non specific chronic endometritis
diseases.definition: Chronic endometritis characterized by the presence of plasmacytic infiltrates in the endometrium. There are no granulomas present.

diseases.name: Nominal aphasia
diseases.definition: Impaired ability to retrieve words; in particular, an inability to recall the names of objects and people.

diseases.name: Noma
diseases.definition: Noma is a gangrenous disease that causes severe destruction of the soft and osseous tissues of the face.

diseases.name: Noise induced hearing loss

diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|connective tissue disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Nodular non-suppurative panniculitis, known as Weber-Christian disease (WCD), is a rare skin disorder characterized by recurring inflammation in the subcutaneous layer of fat.

diseases.name: Nodular malignant melanoma
synonyms: nodular malignant melanoma of the skin
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: An aggressive form of melanoma, frequently metastasizing to the lymph nodes. It presents as a papular or nodular raised skin lesion. It comprises approximately 10-15% of melanomas. Morphologically, it often displays an epithelioid appearance.

diseases.name: Nodular lymphocyte predominant hodgkin lymphoma
synonyms: Hodgkin lymphoma nodular lymphocyte predominant type, NOS
diseases.definition: A monoclonal B-cell neoplasm characterized by a nodular, or a nodular and diffuse proliferation of scattered large neoplastic cells known as popcorn or lymphocyte predominant cells (LP cells)- formerly called L&H cells for lymphocytic and/or histiocytic Reed-Sternberg cell variants. The LP cells lack CD15 and CD30 in nearly all instances. Patients are predominantly male, frequently in the 30-50...

diseases.name: Nodular lichen myxedematosus
diseases.definition: Nodular lichen myxedematosus is a rare form of localized lichen myxedematosus characterized by the development of skin-coloured mucinous nodules on the limbs and trunk, with mild or absent papular eruption.

diseases.name: Nodular fasciitis
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|inflammatory disease|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A self-limiting, rapidly growing, non-encapsulated benign neoplasm that arises from the soft tissues. It is characterized by the presence of plump spindle-shaped fibroblasts, multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, chronic inflammatory infiltrate, red blood cell extravasation, and high mitotic activity.

diseases.name: Nodular cutaneous amyloidosis
diseases.definition: Primary localized cutaneous nodular amyloidosis (PLCNA) is the most rare form of primary cutaneous amyloidosis, a skin disease characterized by the accumulation of amyloid deposits in the dermis, characterized clinically by yellowish waxy crusted nodules and papules on the face, lower extremities, trunk, scalp, and genitalia and histologically by the localized deposition of immunoglobulin-deriv...

diseases.name: Nodular basal cell carcinoma
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A basal cell carcinoma of the skin that often appears as elevated nodules which may become ulcerated.

diseases.name: Nodal marginal zone b-cell lymphoma
diseases.group: immune system disorder|hematologic disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Nodal marginal zone B-cell lymphoma is a rare, indolent B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, characterized by abnormal clonal proliferation of mature B-lymphocytes with involvement of the lymph nodes, sometimes the bone marrow, and rarely the blood. Clinically it presents with disseminated peripheral, abdominal and/or thoracic lymphadenopathy. Cytopenia and bulky tumors (greater than 5 cm) are rare. As...

diseases.name: Nocturnal paroxysmal dystonia
diseases.definition: A parasomnia characterized by paroxysmal episodes of choreoathetotic, ballistic, dystonic movements, and semipurposeful activity. The episodes occur during non-rapid eye movement sleep and typically recur several times per night.

diseases.name: Nocturnal enuresis, 2
diseases.definition: Nocturnal enuresis where the child has been dry for at least 6 months but enuresis has recurred.

diseases.definition: A chronic asthma that is characterized by significant decline in pulmonary function and increase of airway inflammation at night. During sleep, recumbent posture causes a reduction in the lung volumes, respiratory muscle tone, and lung compliance. diseases.name: Nocardiosis
diseases.definition: Nocardiosis is a local (skin, lung, brain) or disseminated (whole body) acute, subacute, or chronic bacterial infection.

diseases.name: Nipple duct carcinoma

diseases.name: Neutropenia-monocytopenia-deafness syndrome
diseases.definition: Neutropenia-monocytopenia-deafness syndrome is characterized by neutropenia with myeloid marrow hypoplasia, monocytopenia, and congenital deafness. It has been described in three siblings who suffered recurrent bacterial infections.

diseases.definition: Neurally mediated hypotension is a sudden drop in blood pressure while an individual stands up. It occurs when there is an abnormal reflex interaction between the heart and the brain, both of which usually are structurally normal

diseases.name: Neuralgic amyotrophy
diseases.definition: Neuralgic amyotrophy (NA) is an uncommon disorder of the peripheral nervous system characterized by the sudden onset of extreme pain in the upper extremity followed by rapid multifocal motor weakness and atrophy and a slow recovery in months to years. NA includes both an idiopathic (INA, also known as Parsonage-Turner syndrome) and hereditary (HNA) form.

diseases.name: Nephrosis-deafness-urinary tract-digital malformations syndrome
diseases.group: syndromic disease|disorder of development or morphogenesis
diseases.definition: Nephrosis-deafness-urinary tract-digital malformations syndrome is characterized by anomalies of the urinary tract, thumbs and big toes, deafness and nephrosis. It has been described in five brothers. The mode of transmission has not been clearly established but seems to be either autosomal recessive or X-linked dominant.

diseases.name: Nephrosclerosis
diseases.definition: Hardening of the kidney due to infiltration by fibrous connective tissue (fibrosis), usually caused by renovascular diseases or chronic hypertension. Nephrosclerosis leads to renal ischemia.

diseases.name: Nephropathy, progressive tubulointerstitial, with cholestatic liver disease
synonyms: nephropathy, progressive tubulointerstitial, with cholestatic liver disease

diseases.name: Nephropathy - deafness - hyperparathyroidism syndrome
diseases.definition: Nephropathy-deafness-hyperparathyroidism syndrome is characterized by renal failure without haematuria, parathyroid hyperplasia and sensorineural deafness. It has been described in five children born to consanguineous patents. The mode of inheritance appears to be autosomal recessive.

diseases.name: Nephropathic infantile cystinosis
diseases.definition: Nephropathic infantile cystinosis is the most common and severe form of cystinosis, a metabolic disease characterized by an accumulation of cystine inside the lysosomes that causes damage in different organs and tissues, particularly in the kidneys and eyes.

diseases.name: Nephropathic cystinosis
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive condition caused by mutation(s) in the CTNS gene, encoding cystinosin. It is a sub-type of cystinosis, in which accumulation of cystine in the kidney results in renal dysfunction.

diseases.name: Nephronophthisis 1
synonyms: nephronophthisis (disease) caused by mutation in NPHP1
diseases.definition: Progressive tubulointerstitial nephritis inherited in an autosomal recessive manner. It is caused by mutations in the NPHP1 gene. Patients present with anemia, polyuria, and polydipsia during childhood. The progressive bilateral kidney damage results in renal failure.

diseases.name: Nephronophthisis
diseases.definition: Progressive tubulointerstitial injury, inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern, caused by mutations in genes involved in ciliary function, which may result in an end stage renal failure.

diseases.name: Nephroma
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A kidney benign neoplasm that is located in the kidney cortex.

diseases.name: Nephrogenic systemic fibrosis
diseases.definition: Nephrogenic systemic fibrosis (NSF) is a rare systemic fibrosing condition observed in renally impaired patients and characterized by a hardening and thickening of the skin with fibrotic plaques or papules, pruritus, joint pain and stiffness, muscle weakness, limitation of range of motion, and yellowed eyes. It is generally associated with administration of gadolinium-based magnetic resonance i...

diseases.name: Nephrogenic syndrome of inappropriate antidiuresis
synonyms: nephrogenic syndrome of inappropriate antidiuresis, X-linked recessive
diseases.definition: Nephrogenic syndrome of inappropriate antidiuresis (NSIAD) is a rare genetic disorder of water balance, closely resembling the far more frequent syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic secretion (SIAD), and characterized by euvolemic hypotonic hyponatremia due to impaired free water excretion and undetectable or low plasma arginine vasopressin (AVP) levels.

diseases.name: Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus-intracranial calcification syndrome
diseases.definition: This syndrome is characterized by nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, intracerebral calcifications, intellectual deficit, short stature and facial dysmorphism.

diseases.name: Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus
diseases.definition: Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus (NDI) is characterized by polyuria with polydipsia, recurrent bouts of fever, constipation, and acute hypernatremic dehydration after birth that may cause neurological sequelae. Polyuria may exceed 10 liters in children.

diseases.name: Nephrogenic adenoma of urinary bladder
synonyms: nephrogenic adenoma of the urinary bladder
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A metaplastic lesion of the urothelium found in the urinary bladder. It is characterized by the presence of aggregates of cuboidal or hobnail cells and represents a reaction of the urothelium to injury caused by instrumentation, surgery or calculi.

diseases.name: Nephrogenic adenoma of the urethra
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A metaplastic lesion of the urothelium found in the urethra. It is characterized by the presence of aggregates of cuboidal or hobnail cells and represents a reaction of the urothelium to injury caused by instrumentation, surgery or calculi.

diseases.name: Nephrogenic adenofibroma
diseases.group: urinary system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign, solitary, and partially cystic neoplasm arising from the kidney. It occurs in children and adults. Presenting symptoms include hematuria and polycythemia. It is characterized by the presence of epithelial nodules embedded in a stroma containing spindle cells.

diseases.name: Neovascular glaucoma
diseases.definition: Neovascular glaucoma is the most common type of secondary glaucoma, usually caused by diabetic retinopathy, central retinal vein occlusion and carotid artery obstruction but sometimes by trauma, uvietis or ocular tumors, and characterized by severe eye pain, synechial angle glaucoma, high intraocular pressure and leading to loss of vision.

diseases.name: Neoplastic meningitis
synonyms: metastatic malignant neoplasm in the leptomeninges
diseases.definition: Metastatic neoplasm in which the tumor cells spread to leptomeninges (pia and arachnoid) and subarachnoid space. The most common primary tumors metastasizing to the leptomeninges are breast and lung carcinomas, melanoma, aggressive non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and acute lymphocytic leukemia.

diseases.name: Neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation
synonyms: tumour with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation
tumor with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation
neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation
diseases.definition: A soft tissue neoplasm composed of perivascular epithelioid cells. Representative examples include angiomyolipoma, clear cell-sugar-tumor of the lung, and lymphangioleiomyomatosis.

diseases.name: Neoplasm of aortic body
diseases.group: hereditary disease|cardiovascular disorder|nervous system disorder|endocrine system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: A benign or malignant extra-adrenal parasympathetic paraganglioma that arises from paraganglia adjacent to the base of the heart and great vessels.

diseases.name: Neonatal-onset severe multisystemic autoinflammatory disease with increased il18
Neonatal-onset encephalopathy with rigidity and seizures
synonyms: neonatal-onset encephalopathy with rigidity and seizures
diseases.definition: A rare genetic neurological disorder characterized by neonatal onset of rigidity and intractable seizures, with episodic jerking already beginning in utero. Affected infants have small heads, remain visually inattentive, do not feed independently, and make no developmental progress. Frequent spontaneous apnea and bradycardia usually culminate in cardiopulmonary arrest and death in infancy, alth...

diseases.name: Neonatal-onset developmental and epileptic encephalopathy
diseases.definition: A complex neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by a neonatal onset of recurrent seizures, an abnormal neonatal electroencephalographic background with multifocal epileptiform discharges, excessive discontinuity, and/or burst-suppression patterns, and encephalopathy. Seizures may be pharmacoresistant or responsive. Developmental delays persist but vary in severity. In some individuals, subs...

diseases.name: Neonatal thyrotoxicosis
diseases.definition: A hypermetabolic syndrome characterized by tachycardia, palpitations, tremor, weight loss, and moist skin that is caused by the elevation of thyroid hormone levels in the serum of the newborn infant or thyroid-axis receptor activation, most commonly due to transplacental passage of thyroid stimulating globulins.

diseases.name: Neonatal severe primary hyperparathyroidism
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|endocrine system disorder|cancer or benign tumor
diseases.definition: Neonatal severe primary hyperparathyroidism (NSHPT) is characterized by severe hypercalcemia ( 3.5 mM) from birth and associated with major hyperparathyroidism.

diseases.name: Neonatal sepsis
diseases.definition: Bacterial infection in the bloodstream of newborn infants younger than 28 days old.

diseases.name: Neonatal myasthenia gravis
diseases.definition: A disorder of neuromuscular transmission that occurs in a minority of newborns born to women with myasthenia gravis. Clinical features are usually present at birth or develop in the first 3 days of life and consist of hypotonia and impaired respiratory, suck, and swallowing abilities. This condition is associated with the passive transfer of acetylcholine receptor antibodies through the placent...

diseases.name: Neonatal lupus erythematosus
diseases.definition: A self-limited skin rash that appears in the neonatal period and usually resolves in four to six months after birth. It is caused by placental transfer of maternal autoantibodies, usually anti-Ro antibody. In a minority of cases, it is associated with congenital heart block, hepatitis, or thrombocytopenia. The mothers of the affected babies may be asymptomatic or suffer from systemic lupus eryt...

diseases.name: Neonatal leukemia
diseases.definition: Leukemia that occurs during the neonatal period.

diseases.name: Neonatal jaundice due to abo incompatibility
diseases.definition: Jaundice that appears during the neonatal period due to high levels of unconjugated bilirubin that are a result of maternal-fetal ABO incompatibility.

diseases.name: Neonatal iodine exposure
diseases.definition: A rare endocrine disease characterized by the appearance of transient hypothyroidism, usually in preterm newborns, following long or short-term topical iodine exposure. Parenteral exposure from iodinated contrast agents may similarly alter thyroid function in term neonates.

diseases.name: Neonatal intrahepatic cholestasis due to citrin deficiency
synonyms: neonatal intrahepatic cholestasis due to citrin deficiency
neonatal intrahepatic cholestasis caused by citrin deficiency
diseases.definition: Neonatal intrahepatic cholestasis due to citrin deficiency is a mild subtype of citrin deficiency characterized clinically by low birth weight, failure to thrive, transient intrahepatic cholestasis, multiple aminoacidemia, galactosemia, hypoproteinemia, hepatomegaly, decreased coagulation factors, hemolytic anemia, variable but mostly mild liver dysfunction, and hypoglycemia.

diseases.name: Neonatal inflammatory skin and bowel disease
synonyms: inflammatory skin and bowel disease, neonatal
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|digestive system disorder|immune system disorder
diseases.definition: Neonatal inflammatory skin and bowel disease is a rare, life-threatening, autoinflammatory syndrome with immune deficiency disorder characterized by early-onset, life-long inflammation, affecting the skin and bowel, associated with recurrent infections. Patients present perioral and perianal psoriasiform erythema and papular eruption with pustules, failure to thrive associated with chronic mala...

diseases.name: Neonatal ichthyosis-sclerosing cholangitis syndrome
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|endocrine system disorder|inflammatory disease
diseases.definition: Neonatal ichthyosis-sclerosing cholangitis (NISCH syndrome) is a very rare complex ichthyosis syndrome characterized by scalp hypotrichosis, scarring alopecia, ichthyosis and sclerosing cholangitis.

diseases.name: Neonatal hemochromatosis
diseases.definition: Neonatal hemochromatosis is a disease in which too much iron builds up inthe body. In this form of hemochromatosis the iron overload begins before birth. This disease tends to progress rapidly and is characterized by liver damage that is apparent at birth or in the first day of life. There are a number of other forms of hemochromatosis. To learn more about these other forms click on the disease...

diseases.name: Neonatal glycine encephalopathy
diseases.definition: Neonatal glycine encephalopathy is a frequent, usually severe form of glycine encephalopathy (GE) characterized by coma, apnea, hypotonia, seizure and myoclonic jerks in the neonatal period, and subsequent developmental delay.

diseases.name: Neonatal encephalopathy with non-epileptic myoclonus
diseases.definition: A disorder characterized onset at birth of profound encephalopathy with hypotonia, Respiratory insufficiency central hypoventilation, a persistent suppression burst pattern of EEG background, and recurrent bouts of myoclonus that are not accompanied by epileptic discharges on electroencephalography. Evolution to pharmacoresistant seizures is common and continued profound global developmental de...

diseases.name: Neonatal encephalomyopathy-cardiomyopathy-respiratory distress syndrome
diseases.group: hereditary disease|metabolic disease|nervous system disorder|disorder of development or morphogenesis|mitochondrial disease

diseases.name: Neonatal diabetes, congenital sensorineural hearing loss and congenital cataracts
diseases.definition: Neonatal diabetes, congenital sensorineural hearing loss and congenital cataracts is characterized by the three primary phenotypes of neonatal diabetes, congenital sensorineural hearing loss and congenital cataracts. Cases have reported additional varying phenotypes, including optic atrophy, hypothyroidism, severe neonatal hypotonia in males, developmental delay, facial abnormalities, and a few...

diseases.name: Neonatal diabetes mellitus with congenital hypothyroidism
synonyms: neonatal diabetes mellitus with congenital hypothyroidism
diseases.group: hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|metabolic disease|endocrine system disorder
diseases.definition: A rare genetic disease characterized by intrauterine growth retardation, permanent neonatal diabetes mellitus, and congenital hypothyroidism. Additional manifestations include congenital glaucoma, hepatic disease (hepatitis, fibrosis, and cirrhosis), polycystic kidneys, exocrine pancreatic dysfunction, sensorineural hearing impairment, developmental delay, and mild facial dysmorphism (such as f...

diseases.name: Neonatal diabetes mellitus
synonyms: diabetes mellitus syndrome in newborn infant
diseases.group: hereditary disease|digestive system disorder|metabolic disease|endocrine system disorder
diseases.definition: Neonatal diabetes mellitus presents as hyperglycemia, failure to thrive and, in some cases, dehydration and ketoacidosis which may be severe with coma, in a child within the first months of life.

diseases.name: Neonatal dermatomyositis
diseases.group: integumentary system disorder|musculoskeletal system disorder|connective tissue disorder|immune system disorder|inflammatory disease

diseases.name: Neonatal dacryocystitis
diseases.definition: Inflammation of the lacrimal sac in a newborn due to blocked drainage of tears or infection.

diseases.name: Neonatal candidiasis
diseases.definition: A fungal infection by any of the Candida species in a newborn infant up to 28 days old.

diseases.name: Neonatal brainstem dysfunction
diseases.definition: Neonatal brainstem dysfunction is a rare neurologic disease characterized by the association of suction-swallowing dysfunction, abnormal laryngeal sensitivity and motility (manifesting with dyspnea or obstructive apnea-hypopnea), gastroesophageal reflux (generally resistant to medication) and cardiac vagal overactivity (e.g. brachycardia, vasovagal episodes) of varying degrees of severity. Impa...

diseases.name: Neonatal alloimmune neutropenia
diseases.definition: A rare acquired neutropenia characterized by isolated neutropenia in a newborn due to maternal alloimmunization against human neutrophil antigens (HNA) inherited from the father and present on fetal neutrophils, and subsequent increased breakdown of the latter. The condition is self-limiting and resolves after several weeks. It usually presents with only mild bacterial infections or may even be...

diseases.name: Neonatal abstinence syndrome
diseases.definition: A constellation of neurobehavioral features observed in a neonate following antenatal exposure to drugs including opioids, benzodiazepines, and selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors.

diseases.name: Neonatal marfan syndrome
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|syndromic disease|hereditary disease|connective tissue disorder|cardiovascular disorder
diseases.definition: Neonatal Marfan syndrome is a rare, severe and life-threatening genetic disease, occurring during the neonatal period, characterized by classical Marfan syndrome manifestations in addition to facial dysmorphism (megalocornea, iridodonesis, ectopia lentis, crumpled ears, loose redundant skin giving a 'senile' facial appearance), flexion joint contractures, pulmonary emphysema, and a severe, rapi...

diseases.name: Nemaline myopathy 9
synonyms: nemaline myopathy caused by mutation in KLHL41
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder
diseases.definition: Any nemaline myopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the KLHL41 gene.

diseases.name: Nemaline myopathy 8
synonyms: nemaline myopathy caused by mutation in KLHL40
diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder
diseases.definition: An autosomal recessive myopathy caused by mutations in the KLHL40 gene, encoding Kelch-like protein 40. The phenotype is highly variable, and as such attempts at classification by clinical features is not optimal. Generally, affected individuals have generalized muscle weakness, and typically involves proximal muscles, the face, bulbar and respiratory muscles.

diseases.name: Nemaline myopathy 7

diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder

diseases.group: musculoskeletal system disorder|hereditary disease|nervous system disorder
